raw.description:
Job Title: Officer, Marketing & Events (EN-7)

Organizational Unit: Communications

Reports To: Chief Communications Officer

Supervises: This position does not supervise staff.

Location: Equality Now is a remote organization. This position may be based in Poland, Ireland, Moldova, Brazil.

MISSION OBJECTIVE:

To expand Equality Now's reach and strengthen relationships with priority audiences through effective marketing, events and external engagement. Working across Communications, Development and Advocacy, the role helps translate organisational priorities into compelling audience experiences and clear pathways for involvement that support advocacy, fundraising and long-term engagement.

PORTFOLIO OVERVIEW:

Officer, Marketing & Events sits within Equality Now's worldwide Communications Team. The portfolio covers major events and convenings, including the annual Gala; multi-channel marketing and audience acquisition; ambassador and talent stewardship; corporate, cultural and professional partnerships; and the promotion of strategic campaigns, products and knowledge.

The role also maintains audience and event data, supports CRM-based follow-up and cross-team hand-offs, and uses engagement data to improve future activity. It has a particular focus on growing and diversifying Equality Now's audiences, including the new and 'unusual suspect' audiences identified in the organisational strategy.

MAJOR DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

Purpose: Coordinates Connected Workflows

Marketing campaigns

  • Deliver marketing activity that supports the acquisition and deeper engagement of priority audiences, including Equality Now's Professionals Network, prospective funders, corporate audiences, senior decision-makers and other high-value supporters agreed with Development and Advocacy colleagues.
  • Help grow Equality Now's total addressable audience by identifying practical ways to reach people beyond our existing supporter base, particularly the 'unusual suspect' audiences prioritised in the organisational strategy across paid advertising, social acquisition, email, events, partnerships, external platforms and other appropriate channels, working within agreed campaign objectives, audiences and budgets.
  • Support the marketing and audience development of the Equal Justice Academy, working with relevant programme, Digital and Communications colleagues to increase awareness, participation and ongoing use.
  • Work with Digital, Advocacy Communications and Production colleagues to ensure Equality Now's knowledge products are packaged, promoted and distributed to the audiences most likely to use, share or act on them.
  • Help connect launches, knowledge products, events, partnerships and campaigns into coherent audience journeys rather than one-off moments, ensuring there is a clear next action for priority audiences.

Audience Data and Relationship Management

  • Maintain accurate and useful audience, stakeholder, ambassador and event data in Equality Now's CRM and agreed planning systems, ensuring records are current, appropriately segmented and usable across teams.
  • Build a practical understanding of who is in Equality Now's audience database, how different groups are engaging, where there are gaps and which contacts may be ready for deeper Development, Advocacy, partnership or ambassador engagement.
  • Work closely with Development, Advocacy and Communications colleagues to clarify relationship ownership, audience segments and appropriate outreach pathways so teams understand which contacts sit within their portfolios and where cross-team opportunities exist.
  • Ensure new contacts generated through events, campaigns, partnerships and external engagement are captured promptly and routed into appropriate supporter or stakeholder journeys.

Monitoring, Learning and Data Management

  • Maintain agreed KPI trackers and compile regular reporting on event attendance, audience acquisition, engagement, conversion, relationship progression, campaign performance and other agreed indicators.
  • Use campaign, event and CRM data to identify clear patterns, gaps and practical opportunities to improve targeting, follow-up, audience journeys and future activity.
  • Gather qualitative feedback from events, partners, ambassadors and priority audiences and feed useful learning into future planning.
  • Support good data-management and data-protection practice and ensure stakeholder, participant and talent information is handled appropriately.

Engagement: Align

Content creation

  • Produce and coordinate campaign materials including invitations, landing-page copy, email communications, presentations, partner materials, promotional assets and briefing information, working with Digital and Production colleagues to maintain brand and messaging quality.

Ambassadors and Talent

  • Work with Advocacy, Development, Executive Office, regional teams and other colleagues to identify ambassadors and external voices aligned to Equality Now's focus areas, geographies and wider organisational priorities.
  • Provide day-to-day coordination of Equality Now's ambassador and talent programme, maintaining accurate lists, relationship histories, interests, availability and previous engagement so that suitable people can be identified quickly for events, campaigns, speaking opportunities and advocacy moments.
  • Act as a consistent relationship point for agreed ambassadors and talent, coordinating communications, opportunities, briefings and follow-up and helping create clear pathways for people to deepen or broaden their involvement with Equality Now.

Strategic Partnerships

  • Research and coordinate agreed corporate brand, cultural and organisational partnership opportunities that can expand Equality Now's audience, strengthen campaigns or create new routes into high-value supporter and stakeholder groups.
  • Prepare concise background information, partnership materials and activation plans for review by the relevant manager, with strategic negotiation, major commitments and high-risk decisions retained by senior colleagues.

Delivery: Sustain Service

Events and Convenings

  • Coordinate the practical planning and delivery of Equality Now events, including the annual Gala and other in-person, virtual and hybrid events that support advocacy, fundraising, audience engagement and brand development.
  • Coordinate event logistics including venues, production suppliers, speakers and talent, invitations, briefing materials, run-of-show documents, travel and accommodation requirements, event communications and on-the-day delivery.
  • Support PR and promotional activity around the Gala and other events or campaigns where earned media can extend reach, coordinating with Media colleagues on assets, talent information, schedules and follow-up.
  • Project-manage assigned events from planning through delivery and follow-up, maintaining project plans, critical paths, task trackers, schedules and clear ownership so that colleagues and suppliers meet agreed deadlines. Inclusive of event administration including supplier liaison, contracts, purchase and payment processes, invoices, budgets, approvals, guest and speaker information, registration and other event records, escalating material risks or changes to the relevant manager.
  • Work across Communications, Development, Advocacy and relevant regional or focus-area teams to ensure each event has clear objectives, audiences, messaging, follow-up and relationship outcomes.

Event Marketing, External Moments and Follow-up

  • Coordinate event marketing across email, social, digital, paid and partner channels, working closely with Digital, Production, Media and other colleagues to maximise attendance, reach and post-event engagement.
  • Support Equality Now's presence at external convenings and high-value moments by coordinating materials, schedules, speaking opportunities, relationship follow-up and opportunities to extend the organisation's visibility.
  • Maintain an organisation-wide calendar of priority events and convenings, identifying moments where Equality Now can bring together priority audiences through repeatable, human-centred event formats and experiences.
  • Capture attendee, engagement and follow-up data after events and ensure agreed actions, new contacts and relationship opportunities are recorded and routed to the appropriate internal owner.

POSITION REQUIREMENTS & TARGET SKILLS PROFILE:

Substantive Knowledge

  • Working knowledge of integrated marketing communications, audience acquisition, event delivery and relationship-based engagement, gained through relevant practical experience.
  • Understanding of how events, marketing, partnerships and ambassador activity can support organisational reputation, advocacy, audience growth and fundraising.
  • Working understanding of audience segmentation, supporter journeys, CRM data and how communications activity can move people from awareness to deeper engagement.
  • Awareness of good practice in brand marketing, digital acquisition, partnerships, event promotion and stakeholder engagement.
  • An interest in social justice, human rights and Equality Now's mission, strategy and operating environment.

Communication Skills

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to produce clear audience-facing copy, event communications, campaign materials and concise stakeholder information.
  • Strong interpersonal skills and confidence building professional relationships with speakers, talent, ambassadors, partners, suppliers, donors and other external stakeholders.
  • Ability to adapt communications for different audiences while working within agreed messaging, brand and reputational guidance.
  • Tact and cultural awareness when working across countries, cultures and professional contexts.

Execution Skills

  • Strong event and project-management skills, with the ability to maintain plans, task trackers, deadlines, budgets, contracts, invoices and multiple workstreams simultaneously.
  • Experience coordinating in-person, virtual and/or hybrid events and working with venues, production partners, suppliers, speakers or talent.
  • Ability to deliver multi-channel marketing and audience-acquisition activity within agreed plans, processes and budgets.
  • Ability to coordinate cross-functional activity, keep colleagues and suppliers on track, identify delivery risks and escalate decisions outside agreed parameters.
  • Strong attention to detail and confidence maintaining accurate relationship, campaign and event records.
  • Ability to collect, organise and interpret routine marketing, CRM and event-performance data and identify clear trends or follow-up actions.
  • Ability to work flexibly when events or global time zones require work outside standard hours.

Targeted Specialised Knowledge

  • Experience using CRM, email marketing, audience-management or event-management systems.
  • Experience supporting paid, social, email or partnership-based audience acquisition campaigns.
  • Experience creating or coordinating content and assets for email, website, social media, events and partner channels.
  • Experience working with ambassadors, talent, creators, speakers, corporate partners or other external relationship groups is desirable.
  • Familiarity with tools such as Google Workspace, Canva and online event/webinar platforms.
  • Knowledge of data protection and good practice in managing stakeholder and supporter information.
  • Experience working in an international, charitable, campaigning or mission-led organisation is desirable.

CONSULTANCY FEE RANGE (Annual, Gross): USD $27,000 - $34,074.
The final consultancy fee within this range will be determined based on factors including geographic location, relevant experience, demonstrated skills, qualifications, and the agreed scope and duration of services.

Consultant fees are set with consideration for the scope of work, level of expertise, and market benchmarks, and are intended to reflect the independent and professional nature of consultancy engagements.

HOW TO APPLY

Please visit: and submit a resume/CV and cover letter. The applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis, and the application period closes at
11:59 p.m. Eastern Time on November 13, 2026.

Due to the volume of applicants anticipated for this role, only shortlisted candidates will be contacted for an interview.

Equality Now is strong because it is diverse. We actively seek a diverse applicant pool and encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply. Equality Now offers a competitive compensation package, including base salary, savings, health and vacation benefits, and is an Equal Opportunity employer. Equality Now employees are selected on the basis of ability without regard to race, colour, religious beliefs, sex, gender identity and expression, language, political or other opinion, nationality, ethnic or social origin, disability, pregnancy, mental status, HIV status, age, marital status, or sexual orientation.

We welcome all kinds of diversity. Candidates are selected on the basis of ability, in accordance with all country and location-specific laws.

Salary: $27,000 - $34,074

AtVeralto, our unifying purpose of Safeguarding the World’s Most Vital Resources™ is more than words:it’sa proven path towards positive change, improvement for our planet, and development for yourself.

Whetherwe’reensuring the continued availability of clean drinking water, protecting our waterways, or enhancing the traceability, color accuracy, and packaging of everyday essentials, the work we do every day contributes to a safer world and a more sustainable future.

When you joinVeralto’svibrant global network of 14 operating companies and 17,000 associates, you join a unique culture and work environment where purpose meets possibility: where the work you do has an everyday impact on the resources and essentials we all rely on, and where you’ll have boundless opportunities to deepen your skillset, pursue your ambitions, and grow your career.

We offer:

  • A remote-friendly work environment based in Mexico, with the opportunity to partner across global HR teams.

  • Ongoing investment in your career through dedicated training, on-the-job development, and coaching.

  • The opportunity to shape global HR processes that improve associate, leader, and HR team experiences.

  • Total rewards that support your success at work and beyond, including health benefits, paid time off, and annual bonus eligibility aligned to local policy.

About the role:

Reporting to the Director, Process & Policy Excellence, the HR Process Owneris responsible forleading the end-to-end lifecycle of global HR functional processes, including Standard Work documentation, implementation, adoption, measurement, controls, and continuous improvement. This role partners closely with Centers of Excellence, HR Shared Services, HR, business leaders, Legal, IT, data/privacy partners, and regional stakeholders tooptimizeand govern global HR processes that drive consistent, high-quality talent outcomes acrossVeralto.

This position is part of the HR Shared Services / HR Policy & Process Excellence team,locatedin LATAM, and will be remote.

In this role, a typical day will look like:

  • Translating global process design, policy intent, and business outcomes into scalable process standards, decision frameworks, operating routines, and clear execution requirements.

  • Owning lifecycle execution for assigned global HR processes, which may include Compensation Planning, Performance Management, Talent Assessment, Equity nomination, and Benefits Annual Enrollment processes.

  • Managing project plans, operating cadences, daily management routines, stakeholder follow-ups, risk and issue tracking, and escalations to ensure milestones and deliverables are completedtimely, accurately, and compliantly at scale.

  • Establishing andmaintainingprocess governance, including decision rights, intake and prioritization routines, approval pathways, version control, audit routines, escalation mechanisms, KPI reporting, and alignment to legal, regulatory, and data privacy requirements.

  • Partnering with Workday Solutions Architecture, IT, HR Shared Services, and Data & Application teams to enable scalable process design, automation, reporting, data quality, release management, and outbound integrations.

  • Building andmaintainingStandard Work, knowledge content, training materials, job aids, quick-reference guides, playbooks, controls, and process maps that enable consistent execution across regions and functions.

  • Driving continuous improvement informed by Voice of the Customer, cycle performance, stakeholder feedback, data quality trends, and digital, automation, AI-enabled, and self-service opportunities.

  • Leading vendor-management activities, including performance oversight, issue resolution, contract and service expectation alignment, and sustained value alignment.

  • Developing communication andchange-managementplans to support cycle launches and enhancements, build stakeholder readiness, and increase end-user adoption.

The essential requirements of the job include:

  • BA/BS degree or equivalent experience, plus 7+ years of experience in HR Operations, HR Shared Services, HR Transformation, or business process management.

  • Demonstrated accountability for end-to-end HR process execution in a global or matrixed environment.

  • Experience collaborating at enterprise level with Centers of Excellence, HR Shared Services, IT, Legal, Data/Privacy, and regional teams to design, implement, govern, and continuously improve HR processes.

  • Experience developing and presenting process performance reports, dashboards, KPIs,adoptionmetrics, data-quality measures, service outcomes, or compliance reporting to senior stakeholders.

  • Experience with Workday or a comparable enterprise HRIS platform, plus professional fluency in English.

It would be a plus if you also have:

  • Experience supporting global HR cycles such as Compensation Planning, Performance Management, Talent Assessment, Equity programs, or Benefits Annual Enrollment.

  • Familiarity with continuous improvement methodologies such as Lean, Kaizen, or Six Sigma.

  • Experience applying digital, automation, analytics, AI-enabled, or self-service solutions to improve HR processes.

Our industry-leading companies with globally recognized brands are building on a long-established legacy of innovation and customer trust to create a safer, cleaner, more vibrant future.

Veralto’s Water Quality companies, Aquatic Informatics, ChemTreat, Hach, Kipp &Zonen, McCrometer, Ott, Sea-Bird Scientific, Trojan Technologies, and XOS, manage, treat, purify, and protect the global water supply, from municipal and wastewater treatment facilities to lakes, rivers, watersheds, and oceans. And our Product Quality & Innovation companies, Esko, Linx,TraceGainsVideojet, and X-Rite Pantone, protect the world’s food, medicine, and essentials by tracking and authenticating the billions of goodsthat travel the global supply chain every day.Veraltois headquartered in Waltham, Massachusetts, with 300+ locations worldwide.

Join us and help families amplify and simplify their financial lives with confidence.

No fee was paid for participation in the ranking, however, Mercer Advisors has paid a fee to Barron’s to use the ranking in marketing. Please see important information about the ranking criteria methodology here.

Job Summary:

Mercer Advisors is seeking a Director, Endowments & Foundations to help lead the day-to-day execution, growth, and client experience of our institutional nonprofit practice, reporting to the Managing Director of Institutional Partnerships. Mercer Advisors has served nonprofit organizations since our founding in 1985, and our Endowments & Foundations practice today serves 225+ nonprofit clients across the country.

This is a senior execution-focused role, partnering closely with the Managing Director on practice strategy while carrying direct accountability for new business development, client service delivery, and team coordination. The Director will support the practice's growth agenda, contribute to business planning and resource decisions, help build the marketing and thought-leadership engine, originate and close institutional mandates alongside the Institutional sales team, and oversee day-to-day service and retention of the existing client base. Success in this role requires fluency in institutional investment strategy, nonprofit governance and fiduciary practice, and strong execution discipline within a defined strategic mandate set by firm leadership.

Essential Job Functions for this role include:

Strategic Support & Business Planning

  • Support the Managing Director in shaping practice strategy, including market segmentation, service model design, and multi-year growth roadmap
  • Contribute to P&L reporting and analysis in partnership with the Managing Director and firm finance
  • Provide input on the business case for practice investment (headcount, technology, marketing spend); help manage resources against the approved plan
  • Surface adjacent growth opportunities, including new institutional sub-verticals, partnership channels, and inorganic opportunities, for evaluation by the Managing Director and firm leadership

New Business Development

  • Partner with the Institutional sales team and Managing Director to originate and close discretionary OCIO and advisory mandates with endowments, private and community foundations, educational institutions, faith-based organizations, healthcare nonprofits, and other tax-exempt institutions
  • Build and deepen relationships with executive directors, CFOs, CEOs, investment committees, finance committees, and boards of directors
  • Support the practice's sales strategy, contributing to pipeline development and conversion; report progress against shared targets
  • Execute portions of complex, consultative, long-cycle sales processes including RFPs and finalist presentations, in coordination with the Managing Director
  • Develop tailored value propositions in collaboration with the broader team, aligned to each organization's governance model, investment objectives, spending needs, and long-term mission
  • Build and manage relationships with OCIO search consultants, nonprofit intermediaries, and centers of influence that influence buyer criteria and selection outcomes

Client Oversight & Service Delivery

  • In partnership with the Head of Endowments & Foundations practice, oversee the service and retention of the practice's existing nonprofit client relationships, ensuring consistent delivery of the firm's fiduciary standard of care across the client base
  • Monitor client health and retention metrics; intervene directly in at-risk relationships and escalate systemic service issues
  • Define and continuously improve the practice's client experience standards, including reporting cadence, committee meeting support, and onboarding
  • Marketing, Events & Thought Leadership
  • Help build and execute the practice's annual strategic marketing plan in partnership with the firm's marketing organization, including segmentation, campaign strategy, content calendar, and lead generation targets

raw.excerpt: Summary The AI Integration & Automation Developer designs, builds, tests, and supports AI-enabled integrations and automation solutions that improve the efficiency, scalability, and quality of Managed Services operations.
raw.description:
Summary


The AI Integration & Automation Developer designs, builds, tests, and supports AI-enabled integrations and automation solutions that improve the efficiency, scalability, and quality of Managed Services operations. This role is delivery-focused and hands-on, translating operational problems into practical automation and AI workflow solutions that reduce manual effort, improve service consistency, and create measurable business value.

This position requires strong critical thinking, curiosity about emerging AI automation capabilities, and the ability to evaluate where AI, orchestration, scripting, workflow automation, or traditional process improvement will drive the best outcome. The developer will work closely with technical and operational stakeholders and may receive dotted-line technical guidance from the AI Integration & Automation Engineer.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

AI Integration & Automation Development

  • Designs, develops, and maintains AI-enabled automations, integrations, and workflow solutions supporting Managed Services.
  • Builds practical AI orchestration patterns that connect systems, data, prompts, APIs, scripts, and operational workflows.
  • Develops automation solutions that reduce manual work, improve service delivery speed, increase consistency, or create measurable cost avoidance.
  • Creates reusable components, connectors, scripts, and workflow patterns that can be leveraged across multiple use cases.
  • Supports implementation of internal AI Orchestration capabilities and related automation services as part of the Managed Services automation portfolio.

Critical Thinking & Operational Problem Solving

  • Analyzes operational pain points and determines whether AI, automation, integration, process improvement, or a combination of approaches is the best solution.
  • Identifies automation opportunities that address systemic problems, not only isolated manual tasks.
  • Balances experimentation with production stability, supportability, security, and operational readiness.
  • Uses data, outcome measures, and stakeholder feedback to validate whether automation work is creating efficiency gains or business value.

AI Automation Delivery & Support

  • Develops LLM-enabled workflows, agentic automation patterns, and AI-assisted operational processes with appropriate guardrails and fallback logic.
  • Integrates with enterprise tools, monitoring platforms, ITSM systems, cloud services, and internal applications as needed.
  • Troubleshoots automation defects, integration failures, and AI workflow issues, driving durable fixes and continuous improvement.
  • Documents solution design, configuration, support steps, ownership, and knowledge articles to reduce key-person dependency.
  • Participates in testing, UAT, release readiness, change control, and production support activities for automation solutions.

Managed Services, ITIL & Collaboration

  • Applies awareness of Managed Services delivery models, ITIL processes, and operational impact when designing automation solutions.
  • Collaborates with engineers, service owners, process owners, developers, and stakeholders to understand requirements and validate outcomes.
  • Communicates technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Stays current on emerging AI automation development practices, AI orchestration patterns, LLM tooling, integration frameworks, and service operations trends.

General

  • Demonstrates and actively promotes an understanding and commitment to the mission of Logicalis through behaviors consistent with the organization's values.
  • Maintains a working knowledge of applicable Federal, State, and Local laws and regulations as well as policies and procedures of Logicalis in order to ensure adherence in a manner that reflects honest, ethical, and professional behaviors.
  • Supports and conducts self in a manner consistent with customer service expectations.

Supervisory Responsibilities


This job has no supervisory responsibilities. The role may receive dotted-line technical guidance from senior AI automation resources and may collaborate with other developers, engineers, and process owners.

Qualifications


To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.


Education/Experience/Technical Requirements/Certifications


Equivalent combination accepted.

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information technology, software engineering, or related field, or equivalent experience.

Experience / Technical Requirements

  • 5+ years of experience developing automations, integrations, scripts, workflows, or application solutions in enterprise or services environments.
  • Hands-on experience with automation development using tools or languages such as Python, PowerShell, JavaScript, APIs, workflow platforms, or low-code/no-code automation tools.
  • Experience designing or supporting AI-enabled workflows, LLM-driven processes, AI agents, orchestration patterns, or intelligent automation solutions.
  • Understanding of prompt design, structured outputs, human-in-the-loop patterns, guardrails, fallback logic, and practical considerations for production AI use cases.
  • Experience integrating with operational platforms such as ITSM tools, monitoring/observability tools, cloud platforms, ticketing systems, knowledge bases, or internal business applications.
  • Ability to analyze business or operational processes and convert requirements into working automation solutions.
  • Working knowledge of Managed Services operations, ITIL practices, or service management processes is preferred.
  • Experience with cloud environments such as Azure, AWS, or GCP is preferred.
  • Experience with data pipelines, vector databases, embeddings, event-driven workflows, or containerized environments is a plus.
  • Strong troubleshooting skills with the ability to identify root causes, evaluate trade-offs, and implement sustainable fixes.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills with the ability to work across technical and operational teams.

Certifications

  • Certifications related to AI, automation, cloud platforms, ITIL, or service management are preferred but not required.

(Examples may include Microsoft Azure AI Engineer, Azure Administrator Associate, AWS certifications, ITIL Foundation, or relevant automation/platform certifications.)

Other Skills and Abilities

  • Critical thinker with the ability to challenge assumptions, evaluate options, and recommend practical solutions.
  • Curious and current on emerging AI automation development practices, orchestration frameworks, and service operations technology trends.
  • Outcome-oriented mindset focused on measurable efficiency gains, cost avoidance, quality improvement, and operational scalability.
  • Ability to operate as a hands-on developer while collaborating effectively with senior technical resources and business stakeholders.
  • Strong documentation discipline, including solution design, support procedures, ownership details, release notes, and knowledge articles.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment while maintaining quality and production stability.
  • Comfortable experimenting, learning quickly, failing fast, and iterating toward durable solutions.

Physical Demands


The physical demands described here are representative of those that should be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

While performing the duties of this Job, the employee is constantly required to sit, talk, see, hear, and use hands and arms. The employee is frequently required to stand; move about, climb steps or balance and stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl. The employee may occasionally lift and/or move up to 10 pounds.

The above statements describe the general nature and level of work being performed by individuals assigned to this classification. This is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities and duties required of personnel so classified.

Logicalis is an Equal Opportunity Employer. It is our policy to employ people who are qualified by reason of education, training, experience, and demonstrated performance. We value inclusion and belonging at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity and gender expression, marital status, age, height, weight, disability, veteran status, or any other reason prohibited by applicable federal or state laws.

Salary Compensation Range: $77,517 - $100,000/yr.

We are the tech powerhouse building products at the intersection of gaming, entertainment, and technology. We think fast, take ownership, and we are not afraid to try things that haven't been done before because our products are exactly that: first on the market, built by people who prefer to challenge the status quo rather than follow a trend.

Founded in Malta in 2018, we’ve grown into a global, remote-first team across more than 30 countries.

In a nutshell

As part of our Talent team, you’ll actively identify very niche talent across the industry, bring a creative approach to sourcing, and discover passive candidates by focusing on search across different platforms, not only LinkedIn.

What you’ll do:

  • Proactively source talent across various roles in our global team

  • Use advanced search techniques and sourcing tools to map candidate pools and uncover hard-to-find profiles.

  • Think outside the box by exploring non-traditional sourcing platforms such as Reddit, X (formerly Twitter), Discord, and niche gaming communities.

  • Craft personalized, compelling outreach campaigns that drive high response rates.

  • Collaborate closely with Heads of Talent across our brands to understand specific role requirements and refine candidate profiles.

  • Maintain thorough and accurate records within our ATS and talent pipeline.

Requirements

  • At least 1 year of experience in talent sourcing or recruiting within the iGaming industry.

  • Hands-on experience with talent sourcing tools, advanced search, and sourcing for niche roles.

  • Experience in finding talent across alternative channels (e.g., Reddit, X, Discord).

  • Proactive approach to work, persistence, and high organizational skills.

  • An eager-to-learn mindset with continuous curiosity about innovative sourcing strategies.

How do we work?

The work here is flexible, and freedom is real, but so is responsibility. You'll work on exciting, innovative products, build from scratch, and see the real impact of what you create.

You'll work alongside highly skilled people and grow your expertise through genuine autonomy (the kind that means you're trusted). Once a year, we travel together as a team somewhere out of the ordinary and take a break from Slack and async chats.

From day one, we'll set you up properly with a home office budget tailored to what you need, and we'll keep supporting you as you grow in your role.

Our Mission

At Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life. We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real-world problems with cutting-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. If you’re ready to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who are just as passionate as you are, you’re in the right place.

Who We Are

In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!

This role is remote, but distance is no barrier to impact. Our hybrid teams collaborate across geographies to solve big problems, stay close to our customers, and grow together. You will be part of a culture that values trust, accountability, and shared success where your work truly matters.

Job Summary

The Technical Marketing Creative team brings complex cybersecurity stories to life through compelling, accessible, and visually ambitious creative work. As a Technical Marketing Creative Producer, you will partner closely with product experts to translate highly technical ideas into engaging visual experiences spanning video, motion design, and branded content. Operating like an internal creative studio, you will leverage strong storytelling, design thinking, production craft, and emerging AI tools to move quickly from idea to execution. We are seeking a conceptual thinker and hands-on creative who is curious about new technologies and excited to elevate the quality of technical marketing.


Key Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with creative leads and experts to turn complex cybersecurity topics into compelling creative concepts.
  • Participate in brainstorming sessions and workshops, developing multiple approaches to creative briefs.
  • Develop creative treatments, moodboards, storyboards, scripts, and pitch decks to communicate visual direction.

  • Help establish the visual language and art direction for campaigns, video series, and new initiatives.
  • Use generative AI and emerging tools to explore concepts, prototype ideas, and accelerate workflows.
  • Support video production when needed, including shoots, lighting, camera, audio, and on-camera talent.
  • Work collaboratively with other creatives and stakeholders from initial concept through final delivery.

  • Maintain a high bar for craft, storytelling, and brand consistency across every project.
  • Stay curious about new creative techniques, technologies, and cultural trends to bring fresh ideas.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • 2 to 5 years of professional creative experience in advertising, agency, in-house, or production studio environments.
  • Strong portfolio demonstrating visual storytelling, editing, and creative thinking.
  • Strong working knowledge of Adobe Creative Cloud applications.
  • Experience developing creative concepts and communicating ideas through treatments, moodboards, storyboards, or presentations.
  • Strong eye for composition, typography, pacing, design, and visual storytelling.
  • Ability to move comfortably between conceptual work and hands-on execution.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills.
  • Curiosity and willingness to learn technical subject matter and translate it for broader audiences.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects and adapt quickly as priorities evolve.
  • Ability to travel for work and shoots.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Demonstrated strength in an additional creative discipline such as motion design, 3D, VFX, or art direction.
  • Familiarity with generative AI tools and an interest in integrating AI into creative workflows.
  • Collaborative, experimental mindset with a willingness to explore unprecedented ideas.

Category: Medical Device

Location:


We are seeking a talented and self-driven Project Manager to lead cross-functional programs within the medical device industry, ensuring projects are executed on time, within scope, and in compliance with regulatory and quality standards. This role requires strong leadership, organizational, and technical acumen to manage complex product development and lifecycle initiatives that support business objectives and patient safety.
The ideal candidate possesses a balance of strategic thinking and executional excellence, with the ability to collaborate across R&D, Quality, Regulatory, Manufacturing, and Supply Chain teams. The Project Manager will be responsible for coordinating all aspects of project planning, execution, risk management, and reporting while ensuring adherence to FDA, ISO 13485, and global medical device regulations.
Key Responsibilities:
  • Lead the planning and execution of medical device product development and commercialization projects from concept through launch.
  • Define project scope, objectives, deliverables, and success criteria in collaboration with cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Develop and maintain detailed project plans, timelines, resource allocations, and budgets.
  • Ensure alignment between project goals and organizational strategy through effective stakeholder management.
  • Serve as the primary liaison among R&D, Quality, Regulatory, Manufacturing, and Supply Chain teams to ensure seamless project execution.
  • Coordinate and track cross-functional deliverables, facilitating effective communication and issue resolution.
  • Lead project team meetings, design reviews, and phase-gate reviews, ensuring all actions and decisions are documented.
  • Drive accountability across teams to meet milestones and maintain compliance with design control and quality system requirements.
  • Ensure all project activities align with Design Control (21 CFR 820.30), ISO 13485, ISO 14971, and other applicable standards.
  • Partner with Regulatory and Quality teams to support technical documentation, risk management, and DHF maintenance.
  • Manage change control processes and ensure that design and process changes are properly evaluated, documented, and approved.
  • Identify potential project risks and mitigation strategies, maintaining proactive issue resolution throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Monitor project budgets, costs, and resource utilization, providing regular updates to leadership.
  • Ensure timely escalation of risks, delays, or quality concerns that could impact project deliverables.
  • Support the development and implementation of best practices, templates, and processes to enhance project management effectiveness.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives related to project governance, documentation, and cross-functional collaboration.
  • Leverage project metrics and lessons learned to improve execution efficiency and product quality outcomes.
Must-Have Qualifications:
  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Life Sciences, Project Management, Business, or a related field.
  • Proven experience managing projects in a regulated medical device, biotechnology, or pharmaceutical environment.
  • Strong understanding of product development processes, design control, and risk management (ISO 14971).
  • Proficiency with project management tools such as MS Project, Smartsheet, or equivalent.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple complex projects simultaneously.
  • Excellent communication, documentation, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Strong problem-solving, analytical, and organizational abilities.

Preferred Qualifications:
  • PMP, PRINCE2, or equivalent Project Management certification.
  • Experience with new product introduction (NPI), process validation (IQ/OQ/PQ), or post-market engineering projects.
  • Familiarity with MDSAP, EU MDR, and other international medical device frameworks.
  • Experience in Agile or hybrid project management environments.
  • Knowledge of resource planning, cost control, and vendor management in regulated product development.
This is intended for inclusion in Pharmavise’s talent database to build a qualified pool of professionals for future medical device client requisitions.

The Opportunity

Ulteig is currently seeking talented and motivated Studies level engineering candidates to support power system studies and transmission planning projects within the renewable energy and power markets

What You'll Do

The Studies Engineer for the dynamic studies team is expected to perform the following tasks:
  • Develop PSSE, PSLF, TSAT, and PSCAD models of renewable plants
  • Perform model quality tests and model benchmarking for various software models
  • Understand dynamic model block diagrams and tune parameters to meet regional model performance requirements
  • Design and model custom master plant controls for large multi-resource renewable projects (PV, BESS, Datacenters)
  • Research and test relatively new available models of datacenter loads and understand the challenges posed to the grid
  • Work closely with the business development team to understand customer needs and application
  • Work with SCADA engineers in charge of building and implementing master plant controls
  • Support proposal efforts by demonstrating theoretical renewable generation and datacenter co-located plant operation
  • Model master plant control in parallel with the design of master plant control to understand and mitigate any challenges
  • Respond quickly to customer design changes, questions, and deadlines, and maintain a flexible attitude toward the work
  • Stay current with regulatory changes, new grid codes, and evolving ISO/RTO requirements related to grid interconnections
  • Conduct various dynamic simulations including voltage and frequency ride through, voltage step change, frequency step change, SCR tests, and fault analyses
  • Support model validation and model benchmarking
  • Stay up to date on new industry guidance and standards for modeling and requirements for inverter-based resources and datacenters
  • Help develop tools to automate and streamline model quality tests and analyses

What We Expect from You

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering required, ABET accredited program, or equivalent required
  • A minimum of 5 years of working experience directly related to power systems or control systems
  • Experience with Matlab Simulink
  • Experience with dynamic analysis utilizing PSS®E and PSCAD software, preferred
  • Experience in conducting analysis on multi-resource renewable projects, preferred
  • Experience developing custom user-defined models in PSS®E or PSCAD software, preferred
  • Experience with programming in Python, preferred
  • Actively manages individual workload, adapts to changing requirements, maintains flexibility
  • Must be a self-starter and willing to identify improvements and implement them, utilizing support from others
  • Must be comfortable asking questions to team when learning new skills · Must be analytical, self-motivated, and possess the ability to work in a fast-paced environment while maintaining a positive, enthusiastic attitude
  • Excellent presentation and verbal/written communications skills
  • Demonstrates strong interpersonal skills with the ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships with staff, management, clients and external agencies
  • Innovative mindset
  • Permanent authorization to work in the U.S

Ulteig is a purpose driven organization that has built a culture focused on people – both our clients and our employees for over 75 years. Sophos is a cybersecurity leader defending 600,000 organizations globally with an AI-driven platform and expert-led services. Sophos meets organizations wherever they are in their security maturity and grows with them to defeat cyberattacks. Its solutions combine machine learning, automation, and real-time threat intelligence with frontline human expertise from Sophos X-Ops to deliver advanced, 24/7 threat monitoring, detection, and response.
Sophos offers industry-leading managed detection and response (MDR) alongside a comprehensive portfolio of cybersecurity technologies — including endpoint, network, email, and cloud security, extended detection and response (XDR), identity threat detection and response (ITDR), and next-gen SIEM. Together with expert advisory services, these capabilities help organizations proactively reduce risk and respond faster, with the visibility and scalability needed to stay ahead of evolving threats.
Sophos goes to market with a global partner ecosystem, including Managed Service Providers (MSPs), Managed Security Service Providers (MSSPs), resellers and distributors, marketplace integrations, and cyber risk partners, giving organizations the flexibility to choose trusted relationships when securing their business. Sophos is headquartered in Oxford, U.K. More information is available at .

Role Summary

The Renewals Representative is a quota-carrying overlay sales role, responsible for partnering with a small number of Account Managers/Executives to jointly achieve overall renewal and expansion sales targets. The Renewals Rep will focus on reaching renewal rate, renewal ACV and renewal billings targets in a prescribed territory, while supporting and enabling expansion motions in partnership with the AM/AE. As customers have acquired Sophos solutions, it is necessary that we continue to ensure those customers realize the value expected from their purchase and renew and ideally expand that business relationship together. The Renewals Rep will be responsible for managing the pipeline of renewals opportunities that are not already being driven by their AM/AE partners in a prescribed territory.

What You Will Do

  • Closely collaborate with Account Manager/Executive teammates in shared territories to divide and conquer to maximize NRR
  • Team to achieve agreed-to quarterly renewal and expansion sales goals, develop strong relationships with key partners, buyers and influencers and leverage these during the renewals sales process.
  • Maintain strong partner and customer relationships, understand their business needs, and align them with Sophos solutions.
  • Identify customer renewal risks and collaborate with channel partners, sales teammates, and the customer success team to coordinate activities to mitigate the risk.
  • Work closely with customers, channel partners and internal teams to acquire the documentation necessary for Sophos to correctly recognize revenue transactions.
  • Support and manage the end-to-end renewals process, including maintaining an accurate renewals opportunity forecast status in SFDC

raw.excerpt: Job DescriptionPOSITION OVERVIEWThe Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM)Analyst serves as a core member of Momentive Software's Cybersecurity, Risk & Compliance organization.
raw.description:
Job Description

POSITION OVERVIEW

The Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM)Analyst serves as a core member of Momentive Software's Cybersecurity, Risk & Compliance organization. This role is responsible for maintaining and maturing Momentive's enterprise-wide third-party risk program, ensuring that all vendors, platforms, and service providers meet the Firm's cybersecurity, privacy, resiliency, and regulatory requirements.

The Analyst partners closely with Client Success, Cybersecurity Engineering, TVM, Legal, Procurement, Product, and the CISO to evaluate vendor risk, maintain continuous oversight of third-party controls, and support Momentive's compliance obligations — including SOC 2 Type II and PCI DSS. The role also supports TVM notifications to clients who manage their own cybersecurity posture, ensuring clear, accurate, and timely communication of vulnerabilities and remediation expectations.

This position requires strong analytical capability, deep familiarity with cybersecurity frameworks, and the ability to translate complex risk issues into actionable guidance for business and technical stakeholders.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Third-Party Risk Management Program

  • Maintain Momentive's global inventory of third-party providers, applications, and services from onboarding through termination.
  • Lead vendor cybersecurity assessments, coordinating with Cybersecurity Engineering, Legal, and business owners to evaluate risk and required controls.
  • Assess vendor maturity using NIST CSF, CIS, CMMC, GDPR, PCI DSS, SOC 2, and other frameworks.
  • Oversee vendor SLAs, RPO/RTO commitments, breach notification requirements, and cybersecurity insurance documentation.
  • Ensure thorough documentation of findings, recommendations, and remediation plans for all vendor assessments.
  • Serve as a liaison to internal and external auditors for vendor-related controls and evidence collection.

Support for PCI DSS & SOC 2 Type II Audits

  • Provide evidence, documentation, and control validation related to third-party dependencies for Momentive's SOC 2 Type II and PCI DSS assessments.
  • Ensure vendor controls align with Momentive's ISMS, contractual obligations, and certification requirements.
  • Partner with the GRC team to maintain audit-ready documentation, including policies, standards, procedures, and risk treatment plans.
  • Track vendor exceptions and compensating controls, ensuring audit defensibility and continuous improvement.

TVM Notifications & Client Support

  • Collaborate with the Threat & Vulnerability Management (TVM) team to support vulnerability notifications to clients who manage their own cybersecurity controls.
  • Ensure communications are accurate, timely, and aligned with Momentive's contractual commitments and industry best practices.
  • Provide consultative guidance to clients regarding risk impact, remediation expectations, and recommended cybersecurity practices.
  • Maintain documentation and metrics related to client notifications, follow-up actions, and closure.

Governance, Risk & Compliance Integration

  • Contribute to the continual improvement of Momentive's ISMS by aligning vendor risk processes with Firm policies, standards, and procedures.
  • Provide input on control selection, risk treatment plans, and metrics used to monitor the effectiveness of Momentive's cybersecurity controls.
  • Maintain situational awareness of emerging threats, regulatory changes, and industry trends affecting third-party risk.
  • Support DR/BCP planning as it relates to vendor dependencies and resiliency requirements.

Stakeholder Engagement & Leadership

  • Act as a key point of contact when business units identify vendor-related risk; coordinate with Legal, Cybersecurity, and leadership on risk reduction strategies.
  • Promote a positive, enterprise-wide cybersecurity culture through outreach, training, and awareness activities.
  • Provide exemplary service to internal and external stakeholders, demonstrating professionalism, empathy, and expertise.
  • Mentor team members and contribute to the development of internal training materials and documentation.

SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

Required

  • 5+ years of experience in cybersecurity, risk management, audit, or compliance.
  • Deep understanding of regulatory requirements including PCI DSS, SOC 2, GDPR, GLBA, HIPAA, SOX, and HITRUST.
  • Experience evaluating both legacy and modern cloud technologies (AWS, GCP, Azure).
  • Strong knowledge of APIs, application cybersecurity, encryption, endpoint, and network cybersecurity concepts.
  • Familiarity with SIEM, IDS, log management, vulnerability management, and threat intelligence.
  • Ability to assess vendor controls, map them to frameworks, and articulate risk to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Strong project management, multitasking, and organizational skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

Preferred

  • Experience supporting SOC 2 Type II and PCI DSS audits.
  • Experience with EGRC/ITGRC platforms (e.g., Jira Service Manager GRC, Archer, OneTrust, LogicGate).
  • Certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CISA, CRISC, CTPRA, or CTPRP.

About Us

Momentive Software amplifies the impact of over 20,000 purpose-driven organizations in over 30 countries, with over $11 billion raised and 55 million members served to date. Mission-driven nonprofits and associations rely on Momentive’s cloud-based software and services to address their most pressing challenges – from engaging their communities to simplifying operations and growing revenue. Designed to help organizations connect more, manage more, and ultimately expect more, Momentive's solutions are built with reliability at the core and strategically focus on fundraising, learning, events, careers, volunteering, accounting, and association management. Momentive partners with organizations that believe "good enough" is never enough – so they can bring on better outcomes for everyone they serve. Learn more at momentivesoftware.com.

Why Work Here?

At Momentive Software, we’re a team of passionate problem-solvers, innovators, and volunteers who believe in using technology to make a real difference. We dream big, support each other, and take pride in creating solutions that help our customers drive meaningful change. If you’re looking for a place where your work matters and your ideas are valued, you’ll find it here.

Medical, Dental & Vision Benefits

401(k) Savings Plan with Company Match

Flexible Planned Paid Time Off

Generous Sick Leave

Inclusive & Welcoming Environment

Purpose-Driven Culture

Work-Life Balance

Commitment to Community Involvement

Employer-Paid Parental Leave

Employer-Paid Short-Term Disability

Remote Work Flexibility

Momentive Software actively embraces diversity and equal opportunity in a meaningful way. We are committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. The more inclusive we are, the better our work will be, which is why we do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, marital status, age, national origin, ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, pregnancy, genetic information, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status, or any other status protected under federal, state, or local law.

All persons hired will be required to verify identity, minimum age of 18, eligibility to work in the United States (without sponsorship), and to complete the required employment eligibility verification form upon hire.

raw.excerpt: Company Overview Chipply is the industry's preferred web store platform that gives the power to team dealers, custom apparel decorators, and corporate suppliers to launch online stores with confidence and grow their GMV efficiently.
raw.description:
Company Overview

Chipply is the industry's preferred web store platform that gives the power to team dealers, custom apparel decorators, and corporate suppliers to launch online stores with confidence and grow their GMV efficiently.

Primary Purpose and Function

Chipply is hiring an Internal Forward Deployed AI Engineer to embed with our internal teams and ship AI-powered solutions that reduce manual work, accelerate decision making, and improve productivity across the company. This role reports to the CEO and is responsible for building real, production-grade engineering work — agents, integrations, and deterministic tooling — directly on top of the systems Chipply already runs on.

This is a hands-on engineering role, not an orchestration or admin role. You will not be configuring SaaS platforms from the ground up. Instead, you will inspect the systems we already use (HubSpot, Microsoft 365, Confluence, Slack, and others), understand what APIs, webhooks, and MCP surfaces they expose, and partner with each department to design and build the AI agents, integrations, and automations that plug into them. Where AI is the right tool, you build with AI. Where a deterministic solution is better, you build that instead. The judgment to know the difference is part of the job.

This is also an intentionally evolving role. The scope of AI in the business will change as tools, models, and capabilities mature, and you must be comfortable defining the work as you go, reshaping priorities frequently, and building capabilities from the ground up. You will report directly to the CEO and partner closely with leadership, Engineering, Finance, Sales, Marketing, Customer Support, and Product to identify high-impact opportunities and ship the engineering work that captures them.

Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and maintain AI agents, integrations, and automations that reduce manual work, eliminate bottlenecks, and improve productivity across every department at Chipply.
  • Inspect Chipply's internal SaaS platforms (HubSpot, Microsoft 365, Confluence, Slack, and others) to understand what APIs, webhooks, and MCP connectors they expose, and use those surfaces to build the integrations each team needs.
  • Partner with leadership and department heads to identify and prioritize high-impact opportunities by mapping existing workflows and pinpointing where engineering effort — AI-powered or deterministic — will deliver measurable improvement.
  • Write production code. Build multi-tool and multi-agent systems that connect Chipply's internal platforms into seamless end-to-end processes. Make sound judgment calls on when AI is the right tool and when a deterministic solution is a better fit.
  • Build evals and monitoring for AI systems you ship, so output quality is measurable rather than assumed.
  • Serve as Chipply's internal AI champion by leading education, training, and adoption efforts, and by acting as the go-to engineering resource for AI questions, best practices, and emerging use cases.
  • Establish and maintain responsible AI governance, including guidelines for data handling, privacy, model and tool selection, output quality monitoring, and ethical use.
  • Continuously evaluate emerging AI tools, agent frameworks, model providers, and orchestration libraries; pilot promising technologies and recommend adoption decisions based on impact, cost, and fit.
  • Measure and report on the ROI of the systems you ship, tracking time saved, error reduction, cost impact, and quality improvements.
  • Develop and maintain documentation for the systems, integrations, and AI workflows you build so institutional knowledge scales with the company.
  • Serve as a liaison across Engineering, Finance, Sales, Marketing, Customer Support, and Product to align on technology needs and ship workflow improvements end to end.
  • Monitor security and compliance across the integrations and AI systems you build, collaborating with engineering and leadership to ensure data protection best practices are followed.
  • Continuously redefine the scope, priorities, and deliverables of the role as Chipply's needs and the broader AI ecosystem evolve.

Requirements

Qualifications

  • Five to eight years of professional software engineering experience, with a meaningful portion of that time spent shipping production code against third-party APIs and SaaS platforms.
  • Strong programming fundamentals in at least one modern language commonly used for AI and integration work (Python and TypeScript preferred). Comfortable writing, testing, deploying, and operating code in production.
  • Hands-on experience building against the APIs of business SaaS platforms — HubSpot, Microsoft Graph / Microsoft 365, Slack, Confluence, or comparable systems. You should be able to read API docs, evaluate auth and rate-limit constraints, and design a robust integration on top of them.
  • Demonstrated experience building with large language models in production: prompt and context design, tool use / function calling, retrieval, evaluation, and cost and latency tradeoffs.
  • Hands-on experience with AI agent frameworks and MCP (Model Context Protocol) connectors, or comparable multi-step automation that spans multiple systems. You should be able to explain when an agent is the right architecture and when a deterministic pipeline is better.
  • Practical experience building with a major LLM provider (Claude, OpenAI, Gemini, Copilot, or similar). Chipply primarily uses Claude, but experience with any production-grade LLM platform is welcome.
  • Familiarity with business process automation tools (HubSpot workflows, Zapier, Make.com, n8n) — not as your primary craft, but enough to know when an off-the-shelf automation is the right answer instead of new code.
  • Strong problem-solving and debugging skills, with the ability to diagnose issues across distributed systems and design iterative, scalable solutions.
  • Excellent project management skills, with the ability to balance multiple priorities, meet deadlines, and ship continuous improvements without losing the thread on quality.
  • Self-starter who is comfortable with ambiguity, thrives in fast-moving environments, and is energized by a role whose scope will evolve significantly over time.
  • Strong cross-functional communication skills, with the ability to translate technical
  • capabilities into business outcomes for non-technical stakeholders, and to translate business problems into technical specs.
  • Curiosity and discipline to stay current on a rapidly changing AI landscape and translate emerging trends into practical applications for Chipply.
  • Excellent interpersonal and collaboration skills, with strong organizational habits and attention to detail.
  • Ability to maintain confidentiality and exercise discretion when handling sensitive company and customer data.
  • Knowledge of security best practices for API integrations, secrets management, and AI system data handling is preferred.
  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, information systems, or a related field is preferred but not required; equivalent professional engineering experience is welcome.

Benefits

Company Benefits

  • Medical Insurance
  • Dental Insurance
  • Vision Insurance
  • Paid Parental Leave
  • 401(k) with Employer Match

﻿

Culture & Values

raw.description:
Why Mozilla?

Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy-minded web browser. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we’re shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. Our work focuses on diverse areas including AI, social media, security and more. And we’re doing this while never losing our focus on our core mission – to make the internet better for people.

About this team:

The Firefox team is a community of engineers who care deeply about delivering the fastest, friendliest, most usable browser possible. We are responsible for making the things you see in the browser work securely, quickly, and well! The Desktop integrations team is a cross-functional team that focuses on updates, installs and integrating Firefox with different OS platforms. As part of the Desktop Integrations team, you will be responsible for all things related to OS integration (particularly Windows and macOS) and helping us grow our user base.

Our team is geographically distributed, and working in the open is the norm. We contribute to the code driving the Firefox browser on all desktop platforms.

About the role:

A Software Engineer is an early-career individual contributor who is growing in their ability to take on more complex tasks. At Mozilla, this role involves working on engineering projects that typically span several weeks and require collaboration with peers. Software Engineers at this level contribute to implementation, ask thoughtful questions, and raise blockers early. They communicate clearly within their team, follow team processes, and steadily build expertise in their domain.

What you’ll do:

  • Assist in the development and maintenance of Firefox features related to installs, updates, and OS integrations.
  • Work on improvements to the Firefox installation and update process with guidance from senior engineers.
  • Support efforts to solve platform-specific challenges on Windows and/or macOS, particularly where Firefox must interact directly with the operating system.
  • Collaborate with your manager and teammates to define and scope tasks, with regular check-ins to share progress and ask for support when needed.
  • Participate in code reviews to grow your understanding and contribute to a high-quality codebase.
  • Help identify and fix bugs that improve the Firefox experience for our global user base.
  • Engage with a distributed team and contribute positively to our open and inclusive work environment.

What you’ll bring:

  • Some experience with systems-level programming on a major platform (e.g., Windows, macOS).
  • Proficiency with C/C++ programming.
  • Willingness to communicate clearly, ask questions, and seek feedback.
  • Ability to contribute to collaborative projects and steadily build up your technical and problem-solving skills.
  • A growth mindset and enthusiasm for contributing to impactful software.

Bonus Points

  • Exposure to or experience with Rust.
  • Familiarity with Linux, or macOS internals.
  • Exposure to or familiarity with native Windows or macOS APIs (such as Win32 or Cocoa)
  • Previous participation in open source projects or a strong interest in learning how to contribute.

We value a variety of voices within our team and at Mozilla. You don't need to check every box on this list to apply.

What you’ll get:

  • Generous performance-based bonus plans to all regular employees - we share in our success as one team
  • Rich medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • Generous retirement contributions with 100% immediate vesting (regardless of whether you contribute)
  • Quarterly all-company wellness days where everyone takes a pause together
  • Country specific holidays plus a day off for your birthday
  • One-time home office stipend
  • Annual professional development budget
  • Quarterly well-being stipend
  • Considerable paid parental leave
  • Employee referral bonus program
  • Other benefits (life/AD&D, disability, EAP, etc. - varies by country)

About Mozilla

Mozilla exists to build the Internet as a public resource accessible to all because we believe that open and free is better than closed and controlled. When you work at Mozilla, you give yourself a chance to make a difference in the lives of Web users everywhere. And you give us a chance to make a difference in your life every single day. Join us to work on the Web as the platform and help create more opportunity and innovation for everyone online.

Commitment to diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging

Mozilla understands that valuing diverse creative practices and forms of knowledge are crucial to and enrich the company’s core mission. We encourage applications from everyone, including members of all equity-seeking communities, such as (but certainly not limited to) women, racialized and Indigenous persons, persons with disabilities, persons of all sexual orientations, gender identities, and expressions.

We will ensure that qualified individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodations to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment, as appropriate. Location: Remote within the United States (Eligible applicants must be physically based within the US.)
Time Commitment: This is a project-based position with defined deliverables; time commitment per week during the project duration may vary.

Organization Overview

The Elba Hope Foundation is a nonprofit organization. At our heart lies a steadfast commitment to sustainable progress and better futures for Africans and the African Diaspora through the interconnected tools of agriculture, conservation, food security, education, youth advocacy, and social justice. Our mission is to drive transformative change by fostering innovation, empowering communities, and forming strategic partnerships that will have a lasting impact on these sectors, both today and for future generations.

Position Overview

Your role will focus on:

  • Owning the day-to-day delivery of EHF's 2026 End of Year Campaign and turning the existing strategy into a clear, executable Asana workplan.
  • Coordinating EHF team members, creative partners, and vendors so work moves forward on schedule, outstanding inputs are chased, and blockers are resolved quickly.
  • Managing production of campaign content and collateral across digital, donor-facing, and physical channels.
  • Building repeatable campaign systems, assets, and learnings that EHF can carry into 2027.

Key Responsibilities

Campaign Management

  • Translate the existing EOY campaign plan and Executive Director direction into a master roadmap in Asana with owners, deadlines, dependencies, and approval points.
  • Maintain the Asana tracker as the source of truth and actively follow up on outstanding inputs, deadlines, approvals, and deliverables.
  • Run a weekly campaign coordination meeting and surface blockers, risks, and decisions before they affect the campaign timeline.
  • Manage the campaign schedule through January follow-up activity and keep the work focused on one coherent institutional story across visibility, stewardship, and fundraising moments.

Content, Creative & Vendor Production

  • Manage production across email, social, web, campaign landing pages, the year-end newsletter, Impact Report, EOY recap content, donor materials, and gifting.
  • Prepare creative briefs and coordinate graphic designers, video editors, printers, fulfillment vendors, and other production partners.
  • Collect and organize required campaign inputs, including impact data, program updates, photography, video, copy, and donor information.
  • Draft or refine campaign copy as needed, consolidate feedback, manage revision rounds, and ensure final materials are proofed, approved, and delivered on time.

Donor & Fundraising Coordination

  • Work with EHF's Development Assistant and Development team on individual-giving tests, Giving Tuesday, audience segmentation, donor messaging, acknowledgements, and follow-up.
  • Work with Operations to confirm donation links, landing pages, campaign tracking, UTMs or equivalent attribution, and reporting are ready before launch.
  • Support a light-touch introduction of Friends of Hope during the campaign without turning it into a full launch.
  • Coordinate EOY gifting production, including recipient inputs, notes or inscriptions, approvals, inventory, shipping, and fulfillment milestones.

Reporting & Handoff

  • Provide a concise weekly status update covering completed work, next milestones, outstanding approvals, blockers, risks, and decisions required.
  • Track agreed campaign measures and document which messages, audiences, channels, and creative approaches performed most effectively.
  • Submit a final campaign wrap report with results, lessons learned, reusable assets and systems, and recommendations for 2027.
  • Complete a final debrief and hand back campaign files, trackers, templates, and vendor information in an organized format.

Major Deliverables

  • Master campaign roadmap and live Asana tracker
  • Integrated campaign messaging and content calendar
  • End-of-year giving campaign and approved individual-giving tests, including Giving Tuesday
  • Donation pathway and landing-page coordination
  • Year-end newsletter, Impact Report, and EOY recap or 'EHF Wrapped' content
  • Private donor and partner messaging and EOY gifting coordination
  • Organized campaign asset bank, reusable templates, and documented workflows
  • Final campaign report and 2027 recommendations

Timeline, Reporting & Working Model

  • Project-based, flat-fee engagement beginning as soon as possible in October 2026 and continuing through January 2027. Fee will be based on final scope of work ($4,000 - $4,500 total).
  • First priority: convert the existing campaign brief into the final Asana operating plan and establish the campaign critical path.
  • Weekly virtual coordination meeting, written status update, and live Asana tracker throughout the engagement.
  • The Campaign Manager owns execution, production management, coordination, and follow-through. The role does not own EHF's broader development strategy, donor relationship management, or ongoing stewardship program, and is not expected to serve as the primary graphic designer or video editor.
  • EHF retains final approval over organizational positioning, donor strategy, material budget or scope changes, and high-risk external communications. Within agreed guardrails, the Campaign Manager is expected to move routine execution forward without repeated approval.

Application Instructions

Please submit your resume and a brief cover letter describing your experience and fit for the role. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis until the position is filled.

We are seeking candidates who bring a deep contextual understanding of Africa and a strong alignment with our mission and values. This may come through lived experience, long-term professional engagement, or meaningful personal connection to the regions and communities we serve. Our work is rooted in respect for local leadership, cultural knowledge, and community-driven solutions, and we prioritize applicants who demonstrate humility, accountability, and a clear commitment to working in partnership with diverse stakeholders.

The Elba Hope Foundation is an Equal Opportunity Employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristic.
