raw.excerpt: Why AssemblyAIAssemblyAI builds the best-in-class Voice AI models powering the next generation of voice applications.
raw.description:
Why AssemblyAI

AssemblyAI builds the best-in-class Voice AI models powering the next generation of voice applications. Our models serve 600M+ inference calls monthly, process 1M+ hours of audio daily, and power 2 billion+ end-user experiences. The Voice AI space is at an inflection point; we’re looking for folks truly excited to join a small team and help define the future of the industry.

We are one of the most capital-efficient AI companies on the planet - with under 100 people generating roughly $600K ARR per employee, we sit among the top 5 most revenue-dense teams within the fastest-growing AI companies today. That's not an accident; it's a deliberate choice to stay lean, move fast, and give every person on the team outsized ownership and impact. With thousands of customers including Granola, Fireflies, Figure AI, and CallRail, the company has real scale - processing over 2 million hours of audio daily and handling more than 1 million API calls every day. This is a rare growth-stage opportunity where the business is proven and the trajectory is steep, but the team is still small enough that your fingerprints are on everything.

If you've ever felt buried under layers of bureaucracy, starved of real ownership, or frustrated watching your work disappear into a slow-moving org, AssemblyAI is built differently. The company operates as a true meritocracy, with no heavy planning or approval processes and no gatekeeping on the tools or information you need. For anyone who genuinely cares about voice AI, not as a trend to chase, but as a technology to build, this is the place where the most interesting problems at the most interesting scale are being solved by a team small enough that you'll actually know everyone's name.

We’re committed to creating a space where our employees can bring their full selves to work and have equal opportunity to succeed. No matter your race, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, origin, ability, age, veteran status, if joining this mission speaks to you, we encourage you to apply!

About the role:

AssemblyAI is building the leading Voice AI infrastructure platform, and our go-to-market team is growing fast. We’re looking for a GTM Recruiter to help us hire the Account Executives, BDRs, Customer Success, Forward Deployed Engineers, and Marketers who bring our models to developers and enterprises around the world.

You’ll own a portfolio of GTM reqs from first conversation to signed offer, working closely with our GTM Recruiting Lead and hiring managers across Sales, Customer Solutions, and Marketing. It’s a high-volume, high-bar role: we’re hiring a lot of people, and every one of them needs to be great.

AI is one of the most competitive talent markets in tech. Great GTM people have a lot of options, and many of them aren’t actively looking. This role is about finding them, starting real conversations, and showing them why AssemblyAI is worth the move.

What You’ll Do

  • Own full-cycle recruiting for 5-6 open GTM roles at a time, from intake and sourcing through offer and close
  • Source proactively through LinkedIn Recruiter, Juicebox, referrals, communities, events, and AI-assisted tools
  • Leverage modern AI tools to accelerate market research, craft tailored candidate messaging, and optimize workflow velocity
  • Run Zoom screens that assess for what matters in each role (pipeline generation, technical fluency, coachability) and share crisp, decision-ready feedback
  • Partner with hiring managers to calibrate profiles, run interview loops in Greenhouse, and keep decisions moving
  • Manage offers end to end, including OTE and commission conversations, competing offers, and closing
  • Keep Greenhouse clean and current so the team can trust the funnel data
  • Deliver a candidate experience people talk about — fast, transparent, and human, whether or not they join
  • You’ll thrive here if you enjoy building, move quickly, and like finding creative ways to solve hard hiring problems.

What You’ll Need

raw.description:
About CoVet

At CoVet, we're building AI-powered tools that help veterinary professionals spend less time on paperwork and more time caring for animals.

Veterinary teams are stretched thin. Long hours, administrative burden, and burnout are challenges across the industry. We're on a mission to change that. Our AI copilot helps veterinary professionals save time, improve workflows, and focus on what matters most: delivering exceptional patient care.

We're a globally distributed team united by a shared mission to support veterinary professionals through thoughtful technology. We move quickly, collaborate openly, and believe great ideas can come from anyone.

If you're excited by the opportunity to shape the future of veterinary medicine while working alongside an ambitious and supportive team, we'd love to meet you.

About the role

We're looking for a Product Designer, Design Systems & Delivery who's passionate about creating seamless, consistent, and intuitive product experiences.

In this role, you'll bridge the gap between design and development, working closely with Product and Engineering to ensure great ideas translate into polished, user-friendly features. From maintaining design consistency to improving the little details that make a big difference, you'll play a key role in shaping the CoVet experience.

This is an opportunity to make a meaningful impact at a fast-growing company, helping veterinary professionals reclaim valuable time in their day.

Exciting Opportunities in this Role

  • Champion Design Quality: Review UI/UX implementations, identify inconsistencies, and document actionable improvements.
  • Drive Design Consistency: Maintain and evolve our design system, promoting reusable components and cohesive experiences across features.
  • Improve the User Experience: Own small-scale UI enhancements inspired by customer feedback, support tickets, and usability insights.
  • Collaborate Across Teams: Partner with Product and Engineering to solve design challenges, prioritize requests, and keep releases moving.
  • Turn Feedback Into Action: Translate user insights and post-launch feedback into meaningful product improvements.
  • Support Product Delivery: Make thoughtful design decisions quickly while maintaining quality in a fast-paced development environment.

Qualifications

We're more interested in finding the right person than checking every box.

  • 3+ years of experience in digital product design, ideally in a fast-paced SaaS or tech environment.
  • Strong Figma skills, including components, variants, tokens, and design systems.
  • Experience reviewing UI implementations and creating clear, actionable design tickets or bug reports.
  • Strong visual and interaction design skills, with attention to responsive behaviour, accessibility, and edge cases.
  • Experience collaborating with Product and Engineering through short release cycles.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities, make independent decisions, and communicate clearly.

Nice to Have

  • Front-end development knowledge (HTML, CSS, JavaScript).
  • Familiarity with Linear, Amplitude, or similar tools.
  • Experience with QA processes and product testing.
  • Experience using AI tools to streamline design workflows.
  • Spanish language proficiency.

About You

You'll thrive in this role if you:

  • Have an eye for detail: You spot the little inconsistencies others might miss and love making things better.
  • Take ownership: You're proactive, resourceful, and follow through from identifying a problem to delivering a solution.
  • Move fast and adapt: You're comfortable with shifting priorities, quick decisions, and short release cycles.
  • Love consistency: You believe great design is intuitive, scalable, and built on thoughtful patterns.
  • Are a team player: You communicate clearly, collaborate naturally, and enjoy solving problems together.
  • Put users first: You're motivated by creating experiences that make people's lives easier, one improvement at a time.

Why Join Us

  • Flexible remote-first work environment
  • Competitive compensation
  • Generous vacation and time-off policies
  • Opportunities for professional development and career growth
  • A culture built on trust, collaboration, and impact

Compensation

We believe in paying our team members fairly and competitively. Compensation is determined based on factors such as experience, skills, qualifications, and local market benchmarks.

As a globally distributed company, salary ranges are localized to reflect the market for comparable roles in a candidate's country or region. We'll discuss compensation expectations and provide transparency around our approach throughout the interview process.

CoVet is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We're committed to building a diverse, inclusive, and welcoming workplace where everyone can do their best work. If you require accommodations at any stage of the recruitment process, please let us know. We're happy to work with you to ensure an accessible and positive candidate experience.

Portfolio & Asset Management

  • Manage a high-volume portfolio of residential REO assets across multiple markets nationwide.

  • Monitor portfolio performance metrics, service level agreements (SLAs), timelines, and key operational benchmarks.
  • Analyze market conditions, inventory trends, property performance, and buyer demand to optimize pricing and sales strategies.
  • Provide regular reporting, forecasting, and recommendations to clients and leadership regarding asset performance and market conditions.

Property Oversight & Value Optimization

  • Evaluate asset-specific opportunities to increase net recovery through repairs, renovations, occupancy strategies, and targeted marketing initiatives.
  • Review and approve property budgets, vendor recommendations, preservation costs, and capital improvement requests.
  • Partner with property management, field services, and vendor networks to ensure assets are maintained, secured, and positioned for sale while minimizing expenses and liability exposure.
  • Identify and escalate asset-related risks, compliance issues, operational challenges, and process improvements.

Sales & Disposition Management

  • Oversee the disposition process from pre-listing through closing, ensuring timely execution and compliance with client requirements.
  • Determine appropriate marketing channels, including traditional MLS listings, online auction offerings, and bulk sale strategies.
  • Evaluate offers, negotiate contract terms, secure required approvals, and facilitate successful transaction closings.
  • Collaborate with sales, marketing, and product teams to increase asset visibility and drive buyer engagement.

Valuation & Market Analysis

  • Review broker price opinions (BPOs), appraisals, comparative market analyses, and valuation reports to support pricing decisions.
  • Partner with valuation providers and appraisal teams to reconcile property values and challenge assumptions when appropriate.
  • Conduct financial and market analysis to support strategic recommendations and portfolio planning.

Client & Stakeholder Management

  • Serve as a trusted advisor for investors, clients, servicing partners, brokers, and buyers throughout the asset lifecycle.
  • Maintain proactive communication regarding portfolio performance, asset strategy, market conditions, and transaction status.
  • Develop strong working relationships with internal and external stakeholders to drive operational excellence and customer satisfaction.
  • Support client meetings, portfolio reviews, and business development initiatives as needed.

Systems & Compliance

  • Maintain accurate asset records, documentation, and transaction activity within Equator and other asset management platforms.
  • Ensure compliance with investor guidelines, regulatory requirements, company policies, and established procedures.
  • Monitor foreclosure timelines, title issues, and transaction milestones to mitigate delays and reduce risk.

Required Experience

  • 3+ years of experience in REO asset management, default servicing, real estate disposition, or related real estate operations.
  • Experience managing institutional or large-scale residential real estate portfolios.
  • Proven experience negotiating real estate transactions and managing assets through disposition.

Knowledge & Skills

  • Strong knowledge of foreclosure, REO, loss mitigation, title, escrow, and residential real estate transaction processes.
  • Working knowledge of HUD, FHA, VA, GSE, and investor servicing requirements.
  • Understanding of real estate auction platforms and disposition strategies, including online auction sales.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret market trends, property valuations, and financial data.
  • Excellent negotiation, communication, relationship management, and problem-solving abilities.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite, Equator, and other real estate asset management systems.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Hubzu, RES.NET, Equator, or similar REO disposition platforms.
  • Experience managing bulk sales, portfolio sales, or institutional investor relationships.
  • Knowledge of property preservation, field services, and vendor management practices.

Success Measures

  • Portfolio liquidation performance
  • Client SLA compliance
  • Net recovery and loss severity reduction
  • Days on market reduction
  • Investor and client satisfaction
  • Offer-to-close conversion rates
  • Operational accuracy and compliance standards

Why Join Hubzu?

At Hubzu, you'll play a direct role in transforming distressed real estate assets into opportunities for buyers, investors, and communities. You'll work with industry-leading technology, data-driven disposition strategies, and a collaborative team dedicated to maximizing asset performance and delivering outstanding client results.

WORKING AT ALTISOURCE ADVANTAGES

Prosperity

  • Competitive salary of $60,000 with additional commission
  • 401k plans – we want to empower you to prepare for your future

Good Health

  • Comprehensive Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance plans
  • Life insurance, short-term, and long-term disability

Happiness

  • Paid holidays, plus 19 days PTO first year for a total of 28 paid days off per year
  • Employee Discounts on movie tickets, Verizon cell phone service, Microsoft Office, and more!

Are you up to the challenge? Apply today!

Altisource’s vision to drive innovation that powers the mortgage and real estate lifecycle is made possible by an inclusive culture that celebrates the diverse voices of our employees. We believe that diversity in gender, age, religion, ethnicity, sexual orientation, identity, physical ability, neurodiversity, socioeconomic background, and experience, fosters creativity, challenges groupthink, and makes our company stronger. At Altisource, anyone can prosper and have a positive impact on our path toward success, irrespective of their background.

We are committed to fair and impartial hiring, training, and growth opportunities. We also provide employee training to help foster their ability to work with one another in an inclusive manner. Altisource is an equal opportunity employer, and our employment decisions are based on merit, qualifications, and business needs.

Altisource Portfolio Solutions S.A. (NASDAQ: ASPS) is an integrated service provider and marketplace for the real estate and mortgage industries. Combining operational excellence with a suite of innovative products and technologies, Altisource helps solve the demands of the ever-changing market. Additional information is available at altisource.com.

raw.description:
Major League Hacking Streamers are community members who present technical topics at our digital events. They are passionate hackers and community members who love to teach and support peers of all skill levels. They are passionate about developer education and creative in their presentation style.

Becoming a Streamer

Why should I become a Streamer?

As a Streamer, you'll be deeply involved in our dynamic digital events like Global Hack Week, preparing presentations that are both engaging and educational. If you are passionate about Developer Evangelism/DevRel, if you're an aspiring content creator, or if you were always tutoring your classmates on tricky topics, becoming a Streamer might be a great fit.

You must be 18 or over for this position.

Is this a paid position?

Yes. We want to provide an opportunity for any student hacker to fully focus on giving back to the hackathon community without having to worry about how they can afford to do so. We view your work as a Streamer as an alternative to a campus job or becoming a T.A. We pay all Streamers in USD. Our rates are adjusted by purchasing power parity depending on what country you're based in. We use OECD data.

What does the workload look like for a Streamer?

Streamers are expected to produce a minimum of two technical streams (approximately 4 hours of content) per event in which you participate. You will be expected to participate in a minimum of 6 events a year. You will be responsible for the preparation of your streams (including any slides or visual aids) as well as your audio/visual setup.

What experience are you looking for?

You should be passionate about developer education. Strong public speaking and communication skills are required, as are exceptional time management skills. A teaching or content creation background helps, but isn’t a requisite.

What does the application process look like?

The application process starts by applying via the form here. We’ll send you a writing assignment to assess your ability to scope, prepare, and deliver a presentation on stream. Candidates who pass the writing assignment will be invited to an interview in which you'll be asked to present part of your presentation as if you were streaming to an MLH audience.

Requirements

  • Need To Have

    • High quality A/V setup

    • Solid organizational skills; able to set your own schedule and abide by it

    • Passion for developer education

    • Creative and somewhat improvisational; comfortable on stream

    • Based in EMEA or APAC or willing to work those hours

    Nice to Have

    • Experience with public speaking OR online content creation

    • Teaching experience is a major plus

    A Successful Streamer Will:

    • Stream regularly, producing a minimum of two technical streams for every GHW in which you participate.

    • Participate in at least 50% of GHWs in 2025.

    • Consistently provide stream availability in a timely fashion when requested (even when it’s zero)

    • Stream from a reliable A/V setup (no outages on stream)

    • Balance entertainment with education; cover interesting topics while making themselves approachable and relatable

    • Avoid “dead air” during streams; fill time with valuable “MLHy” content

    • Act as the “MLHer in Charge” when streaming; monitor attendee behavior and take action as necessary to protect the experience for everyone.

raw.description:
Especialista Gestão Projetos I

Global Conservation Strategy Analyst

1 - Um Resumo do que buscamos

Você está buscando uma carreira com propósito e atuação direta na conservação? No papel de Especialista Gestão de Projetos I, precisamos que você, fundamentada (o) nas boas práticas de gerenciamento de projetos, programas e portfólio internacionalmente reconhecidas, implemente iniciativas em gestão de projetos e programas na Amazônia Brasileira em direção aos objetivos 2030 de conservação da TNC, sempre alinhada (o) às diretrizes definidas pela organização.

2 – Descrição de Cargo

Geral

A/O Especialista (o) Gestão Projetos I é responsável por executar a gestão técnica de múltiplas iniciativas, projetos e programas, assegurando coerência entre prioridades, uso eficiente de recursos, utilizando as diretrizes definidas pela liderança para as especificidades dos projetos e programas.

Atua na gestão diária dos projetos, desenvolvendo planos de ação, monitorando a execução e apontando soluções para desafios operacionais que impactem o andamento das iniciativas.

Específica

A estratégia de Áreas Públicas e Água Doce contribui para a proteção e a melhoria da gestão de territórios e sistemas de água doce prioritários na Amazônia Brasileira. Sua atuação integra processos de proteção e designação de áreas públicas, reconhecimento de direitos territoriais, fortalecimento da governança local, conectividade socioecológica, restauração, uso sustentável e proteção de rios, lagos, áreas úmidas e outros ecossistemas de água doce. Nesse contexto, a posição apoiará a gestão de um portfólio de projetos implementados em diferentes territórios e escalas, incluindo Unidades de Conservação de uso economico sustentável e proteção integral, Florestas públicas não destinadas e outras categorias alternativas de proteção, incluindo sistemas fluviais. Tudo isso será possível porque vamos buscar a:

  • Implementação das metas 2030 da TNC

Em alinhamento com as diretrizes institucionais e com a Teoria da Mudança da estratégia, a posição apoiará a conexão entre as atividades e entregas dos projetos, os Resultados Intermediários e os Objetivos associados às Metas 2030 da TNC. Para isso, aplicará metodologias e instrumentos de gestão que permitam acompanhar sistematicamente o ciclo de vida dos projetos, desde o planejamento até a implementação, reportes e o encerramento. Também apoiará a definição e o monitoramento de indicadores, metas, fontes de dados, responsáveis e meios de verificação, de forma a demonstrar o progresso da estratégia e avaliar se suas premissas e relações causais estão funcionando conforme esperado.

• Excelência Operacional

A posição será responsável por manter os projetos e planos de trabalho atualizados no Smartsheet, organizando atividades, entregas, marcos, cronogramas, responsáveis, dependências, riscos e informações orçamentárias. Deverá integrar o acompanhamento físico, financeiro e de resultados, produzindo dashboards, reportes periódicos e sínteses executivas que evidenciem avanços, atrasos, lacunas de dados, riscos críticos e decisões necessárias. Também contribuirá para a organização e validação das evidências de progresso, assegurando qualidade, consistência, rastreabilidade e preparação do portfólio para processos de data quality, peer review, auditoria e prestação de contas a financiadores.

  • Fortalecimento de Cultura e Pessoas

Fomentaremos a cultura de Gestão de Projetos e Programas no dia a dia da equipe, disseminando boas práticas e lições aprendidas para aprendizado e evolução da organização.

3 – Responsabilidades e Escopo

Gerais

  • Executar a gestão de projetos e programas alinhados às metodologias e diretrizes de definidas pela organização.
  • Monitorar projetos e programas em múltiplas frentes ou territórios de conservação:
    •

o Garantir consistência metodológica, alinhamento técnico-operacional e qualidade das entregas.

o Acompanhar orçamentos programáticos, usando recursos de forma eficiente, com conformidade financeira e alinhando a execução dos planos de trabalho às expectativas dos financiadores.

o Avaliar impactos operacionais, riscos e interdependências entre atividades e projetos, propondo ajustes e soluções no nível técnico.

  • Elaboração de análises, relatórios e informações estratégicas para apoio à tomada de decisão da liderança.
  • Facilitar a integração entre áreas, programas, parceiros externos e stakeholders relevantes.
  • Apoiar tecnicamente profissionais envolvidos nas iniciativas (sem gestão formal de equipes).
  • Tomar decisões técnico-operacionais, respeitando as diretrizes estabelecidas pela liderança.
  • Tomar decisões técnicas dentro de um escopo definido, com base em análise e experiência, sob orientação da supervisão.
  • Representar institucionalmente a TNC, em fóruns e espaços de articulações multissetoriais, em alinhamento com sua supervisão.
  • Seguir e promover o Código de Conduta e os procedimentos internos da TNC, assegurando conformidade com valores institucionais, políticas internas, requisitos legais, segurança, uso de recursos e prestação de contas.
  • Garantir a integridade, organização e confidencialidade de informações, assegurando precisão e rastreabilidade dos dados gerados no contexto dos projetos.
  • Realizar viagens conforme necessidade.
  • As atividades podem ocorrer em condições climáticas e de terreno variadas, incluindo locais remotos e fisicamente desafiadores.
    •

Específicas

  • Articular e engajar com parceiros internos e externos para promoção de capacitações na área de Gestão.
  • Compartilhar de boas práticas na equipe, aprendizado e sugestões de pivotagem, quando necessário.
  • Buscar novos frameworks, ferramentas e ritos para contribuição com o aprendizado e evolução das práticas estabelecidas pela liderança e co-criar novas soluções, quando aplicável.
    •

4 – O que você trará

Description

Remedio is transforming how organizations reduce cyber risk.

While most security tools focus on finding problems, Remedio focuses on fixing them.

Our Autonomous Remediation Platform helps enterprises continuously and safely reduce exposure by remediating vulnerabilities and misconfigurations, closing patching gaps, hardening systems, enforcing compliance, governing applications, and controlling AI risk.

By combining deep dependency awareness, pre-execution validation, automated remediation, and instant rollback, Remedio enables organizations to eliminate risk across endpoints, servers, applications, and AI systems - without disrupting business operations.

Founded in 2019, Remedio spent its first years as a bootstrapped, profitable company, building a strong enterprise customer base before raising a $65M Series A led by Bessemer Venture Partners.

Today, more than 300 enterprise organizations trust Remedio to protect over 3M devices worldwide, including Amazon, Colgate-Palmolive, Kansas Health, Coca Cola Hellenic Bottling Company, and many more.

As we continue expanding our platform and growing our global business, we're looking for exceptional people who want to take ownership, solve meaningful challenges, and help shape the next chapter of Remedio's journey.

Responsibilities

Remedio is growing fast, and we're adding a Regional Sales Director to bring our Autonomous Remediation Platform to enterprises across the US

Security teams already have plenty of tools that find problems. What they're missing is a safe way to fix them at scale without breaking production. Detection is nice. Correction is what makes you secure. That's why enterprise buyers take the meeting, and it's what you'll be selling.

As Regional Sales Director, you'll own new business, selling to CISOs and IT and security leaders who are tired of chasing alerts. You won't be starting from a blank page. You'll carry a platform already trusted by more than 300 enterprises and 3M devices, backed by leading investors, and you'll have the proof points to open doors.

You'll work alongside experienced leadership, Solutions Engineers, marketing, and our channel team, all focused on helping you win. If you want a high-impact seat on a team that's growing quickly, with real influence on how we go to market and the upside to match, come join us.

﻿Sales Territory: Western US

﻿Location: Remote-US

﻿What you'll do

  • Drive new business. Build and execute a regional plan focused on new logos and revenue growth, with a clear view of your target accounts and buying centers.
  • Create pipeline your way. Combine outbound, networking, events, and partner introductions, backed by marketing and Solutions Engineers who want you to win.
  • Build a local partner network that sells with you. Develop relationships with security resellers, VARs, MSSPs, and system integrators who bring you into deals and co-sell with you.
  • Lead the full enterprise sale. Own strategic deals from first conversation through technical validation, negotiation, and close, working with stakeholders across security, IT, and risk.
  • Win on safety as well as speed. Earn trust on the question IT operations asks first: will this break production? Show how pre-execution validation and instant rollback answer it.
  • Forecast with confidence. Keep Salesforce current, call your number accurately, and flag risk early.
  • Shape how we go to market. Partner with leadership, marketing, and channel teams, and bring back what you hear in the field on objections, competitors, and pricing. It will change what we do.

What your first 90 days looks like?

We'll set you up with a clear path and the support to follow it:

  • First 30 days: get up to speed on the platform and our buyers, and build your territory plan and a list of target accounts.
  • First 90 days: build pipeline, with qualified opportunities, active partner conversations, and your first POV underway.

Requirements

  • 8+ years selling enterprise cybersecurity or IT infrastructure software, with a record of consistently exceeding quota.
  • Senior-level experience owning and growing a large territory or region, with a history of opening new markets and winning new logos.
  • Established relationships with security resellers, VARs, and partners in your region, and deals you've closed through them.
  • Domain depth in vulnerability management, exposure management, misconfiguration, or patch management.
  • Experience selling complex solutions to CISOs and to IT and security leadership.
  • A structured sales method (we use MEDDICC) and the pipeline discipline to back it up.
  • A startup or high-growth mindset: urgency, self-direction, and energy for building something new.

Nice to have

  • You've built or scaled a regional sales presence.
  • You've mentored sellers or channel partners.
  • You already know enterprise security buyers in the region.
  • You know the endpoint security, EDR/XDR, or exposure management ecosystems.
  • You've worked with MSSPs and global system integrators.

  • Maintain accurate documentation of all patient interactions

Requirements

Must-Have

  • Experience working directly with US-based patients, clients, or customers by phone

Humane World for Animals, a global leader in animal advocacy and protection, is seeking a Specialist, Public Policy – Puppy Mills for the Companion Animals department. In this position you will help lead efforts on state and local legislation and work to defeat harmful legislation affecting the welfare of animals.

Responsibilities:

  • Coordinates and/or assists on state and local legislative efforts by providing information, public speaking engagements, garnering endorsements from elected officials and supporters, organizing volunteers, speaking to media, and phone banking;
  • Lobbying elected officials and testifying to government committees to encourage them to pass positive legislation and ordinances that support animal welfare or to oppose harmful legislation;
  • Collaborates with State Directors to develop and implement tactics to advance animal protection practices in their respective states;
  • Develops campaign materials such as reports, fact sheets, op-eds, talking points, and online materials to be distributed to the public that supports and/or explains legislation;
  • Provides initial analysis of legislation to determine the impact on campaign goals and submit legislation for APL review;
  • Collects, organizes, and maintains information regarding laws, ordinances, and legislative efforts;
  • Performs other duties or responsibilities, as assigned.

Qualifications and Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Political Science, Law, Public Policy, or a related field or equivalent work experience required. Advanced degree in law or public policy preferred;
  • A minimum of three (3) years of experience in public policy advocacy, public policy research, or legislative affairs required;
  • Experience working on animal welfare issues, specifically puppy mills, a plus;
  • Experience lobbying is a plus;
  • Strong knowledge and understanding of public policy advocacy and research;
  • Working knowledge of local policymaking, structure, and legislative processes;
  • Must be willing and able to travel;
  • Must be willing and able to work outside normal business hours on occasion;
  • Strong knowledge of Microsoft Suite (Word, PowerPoint, Excel, Outlook);
  • Comfortable in a fast-paced environment with frequent deadlines; high energy, self-motivated and proactive;
  • Ability to multitask, and be flexible with regard to workload and assignments.
  • Ability to exercise sound judgment;
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills;
  • Attention to detail and commitment to excellence demonstrated by the delivery of quality and timely outcomes;
  • Ability to work both independently and as an effective team member in a team environment;
  • Strong interest in animal protection issues required.

This is a full-time remote position based in the United States. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, and disability, marital or parental status or protected veteran status. raw.title: Supply Chain Forecasting & Data Analyst (Guatemala)
raw.excerpt: ABOUT THE COMPANYSavvital is a forward-thinking organization that provides diversified services to small and medium-sized businesses in the international market, enabling them to build their future while benefiting from our customized solutions.
raw.description:
ABOUT THE COMPANY

Savvital is a forward-thinking organization that provides diversified services to small and medium-sized businesses in the international market, enabling them to build their future while benefiting from our customized solutions. Our team of educated experts are motivated individuals excited to handle tasks that add real capacity to a client's workday.

Our mission is to provide affordable solutions to growing companies through strategic task delegation. We envision creating an ecosystem that resonates with the human touch every business needs.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for a highly analytical Supply Chain Forecasting & Data Analyst to support a growing supply chain and distribution operation.

This is a hands-on analytical role focused on turning historical sales and order data into demand forecasts, inventory insights, and actionable business recommendations.

You’ll work with large transactional datasets and be responsible for cleaning and validating data, identifying demand patterns, building forecasting models, analyzing SKU and customer behavior, and translating your findings into recommendations that business stakeholders can understand and act on.

This is not a data-entry or basic reporting role.

We’re looking for someone who can take raw, imperfect data, figure out what it is telling us, determine the right analytical approach, and build a reliable model from the ground up.

WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING

Demand Forecasting & Analysis

  • Analyze historical sales and order data to identify demand patterns and purchasing behavior.
  • Develop SKU-level and customer-level demand forecasts.
  • Build rolling 12 to 18-month demand forecasts using historical purchasing trends.
  • Analyze year-over-year demand and growth patterns.
  • Annualize year-to-date usage where appropriate.
  • Identify consistent, seasonal, sporadic, declining, and growing demand patterns.
  • Account for differences in units of measure, product categories, and customer purchasing behavior.
  • Identify unusual changes in demand, including spikes, drops, and zero-usage products.

Excel Modeling

  • Build scalable forecasting and inventory analysis models in Microsoft Excel.
  • Use advanced Excel functionality to transform raw transactional data into meaningful insights.
  • Develop formulas, calculations, PivotTables, lookups, and analytical logic to support forecasting.
  • Create recommendation logic that can identify opportunities such as:
  • Validate with Customer
  • Increase Stocking
  • Maintain Current Stocking
  • Evaluate for Reduction
  • Build exception reporting and alerts for products requiring additional review.
  • Test forecasting methodologies on representative datasets before scaling them more broadly.
  • Document formulas, assumptions, calculations, and methodology so models can be reviewed and maintained.

Data Management & Quality

  • Extract, organize, clean, and validate large datasets from ERP and other business systems.
  • Work with raw transactional data and identify inconsistencies, missing information, duplicates, and data-quality issues.
  • Determine how data issues may impact forecasting and analytical results.
  • Establish appropriate data-cleaning and validation processes.
  • Communicate data-quality concerns clearly to relevant stakeholders.

Inventory & Supply Chain Insights

  • Analyze demand trends to support inventory and stocking decisions.
  • Identify SKUs that may require increased or reduced stocking levels.
  • Evaluate customer purchasing behavior and its potential impact on inventory requirements.
  • Identify products with declining, inconsistent, or unusual demand.
  • Support inventory planning and replenishment decisions through data-driven analysis.
  • Develop insights that help balance product availability with inventory efficiency.

Reporting & Business Insights

  • Create clear and easy-to-understand reports showing historical usage, demand trends, forecasts, and recommendations.
  • Translate complex analysis into practical commercial recommendations.
  • Present findings in a way that can be understood by non-technical stakeholders.
  • Highlight key trends, exceptions, risks, and opportunities rather than simply presenting raw numbers.
  • Support the development of customer-facing inventory and demand reports.

Collaboration & Ownership

  • Work independently while collaborating with business and supply chain stakeholders.
  • Take ownership of analytical projects from raw data through final recommendations.
  • Ask the right questions when requirements or datasets are unclear.
  • Explain your analytical approach and reasoning clearly.
  • Adapt forecasting methodology when business requirements or data patterns change.
  • Communicate progress, challenges, and findings effectively.

REQUIREMENTS

  • 3+ years of experience in supply chain analytics, demand planning, forecasting, inventory planning, operations analytics, or a closely related analytical field.
  • Hands-on experience with demand forecasting and/or supply planning.
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel.
  • Strong experience with:
  • PivotTables
  • XLOOKUP / INDEX-MATCH
  • SUMIFS and advanced Excel formulas
  • Data cleaning and transformation
  • Trend analysis
  • Growth-rate calculations
  • Forecasting models
  • Large datasets
  • Experience extracting, cleaning, and analyzing data from ERP systems.
  • Ability to build analytical models from raw transactional data rather than simply maintaining existing reports.
  • Strong understanding of SKU-level demand and inventory concepts.
  • Strong analytical reasoning and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to work independently with incomplete, inconsistent, or imperfect data.
  • Strong written and spoken English.
  • Ability to communicate analytical findings clearly to non-technical stakeholders.

PREFERRED EXPERIENCE

Experience with any of the following would be an advantage:

  • Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central
  • Power BI
  • Inventory optimization
  • Demand planning
  • Supply planning
  • Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP)
  • Manufacturing
  • Wholesale or distribution
  • Industrial supply chains
  • Customer-level forecasting
  • Inventory replenishment models
  • Exception and anomaly reporting
  • Customer-facing inventory or demand reporting

Experience working with ERP-generated sales-order data and building forecasting or inventory models from transactional data is particularly valuable.

TOOLS

Required:

  • Microsoft Excel

Preferred:

  • Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central
  • Power BI

Experience with other ERP, BI, analytics, or cloud data platforms is also welcome.

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

We’re looking for someone who can do more than build spreadsheets.

The ideal candidate is someone who:

  • Thinks analytically: Can look beyond the numbers and identify what they actually mean.
  • Builds from scratch: Comfortable starting with raw data and developing a model independently.
  • Questions the data: Doesn't automatically assume that every number is correct.
  • Understands forecasting: Can explain why a particular methodology makes sense for a particular dataset.
  • Thinks commercially: Understands how forecasts and demand patterns translate into inventory and business decisions.
  • Communicates clearly: Can explain complex analysis without overwhelming stakeholders with technical details.
  • Takes ownership: Can work independently without needing step-by-step instructions.
  • Pays attention to detail: Understands that small data issues can lead to significant forecasting errors.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

Within the initial engagement, you should be able to take raw sales and order history and build a reliable forecasting model that helps answer questions such as:

  • What is this customer likely to purchase over the next 12–18 months?
  • Which SKUs are trending upward or downward?
  • Which products may require increased stocking?
  • Which products may be overstocked based on declining customer usage?
  • Which demand changes are unusual enough to require customer validation?
  • What data or assumptions could affect the reliability of the forecast?

Success isn't simply producing an Excel workbook.

It means producing analysis that leads to clear, practical recommendations and giving stakeholders enough context to understand why those recommendations were made.

A NOTE ON EXPERIENCE

We’re looking for candidates with genuine forecasting and analytical experience, but we’re more interested in what you have actually built and worked on than simply the title on your resume.

If you've personally built forecasting models, worked with large ERP datasets, analyzed customer or SKU-level demand, or turned raw transactional data into inventory recommendations, we want to hear about it.

Be prepared to walk us through a real example of your work, including:

What data you started with → how you cleaned it → how you analyzed it → how you built the model → how you validated it → what recommendation or business decision came from it.

COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

  • Base Salary: Market Competitive (determined by experience).
  • Allowances: Premium Internet, Electricity, and Wellbeing allowances.
  • Growth: Annual performance-based increments and structured career progression.
  • Bonuses: Individual performance and team-based target bonuses.

“Our motto from our inception has been to put our employees first! We value the uniqueness and experience each individual brings to the organization.”

raw.description:
About BigHand

BigHand offers technology solutions for busy legal professionals that provide data and insights to increase value and profits. Through our expert knowledge and innovative technology, we enable our customers to achieve enhanced efficiency, better decision-making and harness their competitive edge.

We build with tomorrow in mind, transforming ideas into action and empowering our customers to succeed in a world of constant change. We make big happen for our customers.

We are a business driven by our values and have these at the centre of everything we do. Our BigHanders are dedicated to building a culture where We Win Together, We Love to Learn, We Do the Right Thing, We Own It and We Find the Fun.

About the role

As a Solutions Consultant, you will play a crucial role in driving sales productivity and growth within your designated region. Your primary focus will be on increasing overall sales billings per salesperson by delivering exceptional support, strategic insights, and tailored solutions.

In this position, you will serve as a key liaison between Sales, Marketing, Onboarding, Delivery, and Customer Services to ensure alignment and collaboration across functions. You will drive a consultative selling approach by equipping teams with essential insights, competitive positioning, and curated content that fosters effective customer engagement. Job Title: Commercial Insurance Producer

﻿Company: Allegiance Insurance Company
Location: Remote (United States)
Type: Full-Time
Compensation: Base Salary to $60,000+ annually, plus uncapped commission on all new business and renewals, with 100% employer-paid benefits

About Allegiance Insurance Company

Allegiance Insurance Company is a nationwide insurance solutions provider with more than 20 years of experience helping businesses protect what matters most. Built on a culture of coaching, accountability, continuous learning, and exceptional client service, Allegiance provides its producers with the training, resources, and support needed to build rewarding, long-term careers in commercial insurance. Through access to multiple commercial insurance carriers and a collaborative, growth-focused environment, Allegiance empowers its team to deliver tailored insurance solutions while developing lasting client relationships.

About the Role

As a Commercial Insurance Producer, you will serve as a trusted advisor to small and mid-sized business owners by identifying risks, educating clients, and designing customized commercial insurance solutions. This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced Commercial Insurance Producer or a top-performing Property & Casualty Producer looking to transition into commercial insurance with comprehensive training and mentorship.

You'll work remotely while leveraging company-provided lead sources, multiple carrier relationships, and ongoing coaching to build and manage a successful book of business. Your success will be rewarded through a competitive base salary and uncapped commission on both new business and renewals.

Key Responsibilities

  • Build and maintain long-term relationships with small and mid-sized business clients.
  • Consult with business owners to identify risks and recommend appropriate commercial insurance solutions.
  • Generate and manage a healthy sales pipeline using company-provided qualified leads and self-generated opportunities.
  • Present insurance solutions from multiple commercial insurance carriers and markets.
  • Educate clients on policy options, coverage recommendations, and risk management strategies.
  • Manage the complete sales process from prospecting through policy binding and ongoing account servicing.
  • Maintain accurate client information and sales activities within the agency's CRM and Agency Management System (AMS).
  • Learn and effectively utilize multiple commercial insurance carrier rating platforms and underwriting guidelines.
  • Collaborate with internal operations and service teams to ensure an exceptional client experience.
  • Participate in ongoing coaching, training, and professional development programs to continually improve sales performance.

Requirements

  • Active Property & Casualty Insurance License in good standing.
  • Commercial insurance sales experience preferred; exceptional Property & Casualty Producers seeking to transition into commercial insurance are encouraged to apply.
  • Proven track record of successful insurance sales performance.
  • Experience managing sales pipelines and developing long-term client relationships.
  • Ability to learn and effectively utilize multiple commercial insurance carriers and rating platforms.
  • Experience using CRM and Agency Management Systems (AMS).
  • Excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills.
  • Self-motivated with the ability to work independently in a remote environment.
  • Strong consultative selling, organizational, and relationship-building skills.

What We Offer

  • Competitive base salary of $60,000+, based on experience.
  • Uncapped commission on all new business and renewals.
  • 100% employer-paid benefits.
  • Paid Time Off (PTO).
  • Company-provided qualified lead sources.
  • Comprehensive commercial insurance training and ongoing professional coaching.
  • Access to multiple commercial insurance carriers and markets.
  • Remote work flexibility with strong operational and administrative support.
  • Long-term career advancement opportunities within a high-performance, growth-oriented organization.
  • A collaborative culture focused on accountability, continuous learning, and helping producers achieve long-term success.

Customer Success Manager
Mid-Market

Own a book of 20 to 25 mid-market accounts and help each one get real results from Balto.

Customer Success Manager, Mid-Market

Type

Full-time

Book

20–25 accounts, about $1.6M

Salary

Salary Range Base is $75k - $80k, OTE of $120k

Posted

October 1, 2026

About Balto

Balto builds AI for contact centers. We help agents in the moment, score every call so leaders don’t have to, and show teams what their customers are really saying, all in one place.

Benefits

  • Medical, Dental, Vision
  • 401(k)
  • Unlimited PTO
  • Learning Stipends

About the role

As a Customer Success Manager on our mid-market team, you’ll own the relationship with new and existing customers and make sure they have the help, resources, and insights they need to get the most out of Balto. You’ll drive renewals and expansion, and build partnerships that last.

This is a fully remote position, so you can work from anywhere in the U.S.

What you’ll own

  • Your book: 20 to 25 mid-market accounts, about $1.6M in total book of business.
  • Renewals: the full renewal process for every account in your portfolio.
  • Growth: retention, expansion, and adoption across your book. These are the numbers you’ll be measured on.

Who we’re looking for

You’re an empathetic, organized, and driven customer success professional. You build strong relationships, learn how each customer’s business works, and connect what they need to the value Balto delivers. You’re also their advocate inside Balto, working with our teams to remove obstacles and spot opportunities to grow.

You may be a great fit if you:

  • Thrive on building trust and strong, lasting customer relationships
  • Enjoy solving problems and connecting customer goals to measurable outcomes and ROI
  • Are proactive, organized, and comfortable managing multiple accounts at once
  • Work cross-functionally with product, engineering, sales, and marketing to get things done for customers
  • You use AI in your daily workflow and can point to real examples of how it’s made your work better or faster

Key responsibilities

Customer relationships

  • Build strong relationships with customers, including C-level leaders, and understand their business goals and success metrics
  • Act as a trusted advisor who turns complex technical concepts into clear business outcomes
  • Lead ongoing check-ins, business reviews, and renewal conversations

Adoption and value

  • Give new and existing customers the resources, guidance, and best practices they need
  • Find opportunities to increase adoption and usage across customer teams
  • Help customers measure and share the value they get from Balto, including ROI and performance impact

Renewal and expansion

  • Run the renewal process for your portfolio, including timelines, customer alignment, and execution
  • Spot renewal risk early, work with internal teams to resolve it, and identify expansion opportunities

Risk management

  • Track customer health, usage, and engagement to prevent churn
  • Identify roadblocks and adoption challenges before they become problems
  • De-escalate issues and coordinate solutions to keep customers on track

What you’ll bring

Must-haves

  • 4+ years in Customer Success, Account Management, or a related customer-facing role
  • Experience managing mid-market or enterprise customer relationships, including contract renewals
  • Strong business acumen and a solid grasp of Customer Success practices
  • Clear, confident written, verbal, and presentation skills
  • The ability to analyze data and summarize it clearly for senior stakeholders
  • Strong organization and time management across a full book of accounts

Nice to have

  • Experience with ChurnZero, Salesforce, Gong, or similar CRM and Customer Success platforms
  • Experience leading change management or adoption initiatives
  • Familiarity with contact centers or AI software

Benefits

  • Medical, Dental, Vision
  • 401(k)
  • Unlimited PTO
  • Learning Stipends

Career growth

This role offers multiple paths for growth at Balto:

  • Senior Customer Success Manager. Take on more complex relationships and lead higher-impact renewals and expansions.
  • Enterprise Customer Success Manager. Manage larger implementations and deepen your strategic partnership skills.
  • Leadership. Grow toward a Customer Success leadership track, mentoring other CSMs and driving retention and expansion.

Our hiring process

Our process includes virtual interviews and a take-home assessment. Together, they show us how you solve problems, how you communicate, and how comfortable you are with the tools and data a CSM works with every day.

Why Balto

Six values shape how we work:

  • Anchor on Success. We start every task by picturing what success looks like, then set ambitious goals to get there.
  • Love Every Customer. Every customer, whatever their size or complexity, should feel valued and supported.
  • Talk Things Out. We solve problems through open, honest conversations, without the barriers of hierarchy.
  • Always Be Growing. Everyone owns their professional development, and our culture backs them up.
  • Own the Work. We take initiative, solve problems proactively, and produce results we’re proud of.
  • Start with Gratitude. We recognize each other’s contributions, even in tough discussions.

Choosing Balto means joining a company where your work is meaningful, your growth is encouraged, and your contributions are valued. It’s go time.

How to apply

Visit balto.ai/careers, select See Open Roles, then choose Customer Success Manager.

Equal Employment Opportunity

Balto is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where all individuals are treated with respect and have equal opportunities to succeed. We make employment decisions without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. Balto is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities throughout the hiring process.

raw.description:
Are you a computer science expert fluent in French, eager to shape the future of AI? Large‑scale language models are evolving from clever chatbots into powerful engines of scientific discovery. With high‑quality training data, tomorrow’s AI can democratize world‑class education, keep pace with cutting‑edge research, and streamline software development for engineers everywhere. That training data begins with you—we need your expertise to help power the next generation of AI.

We’re looking for computer science specialists who live and breathe algorithms, data structures, machine learning, artificial intelligence, software engineering, computer networks, cybersecurity, cloud computing, database management, and systems architecture. You’ll challenge advanced language models on topics like algorithm optimization, model training and evaluation, network protocols, distributed systems, object-oriented design, and performance tuning—documenting every failure mode so we can harden model reasoning.

On a typical day, you will converse with the model on coding scenarios and theoretical computer science questions, verify factual accuracy and logical soundness, capture reproducible error traces, and suggest improvements to our prompt engineering and evaluation metrics.

A master’s or PhD in computer science or a closely related field is ideal; peer‑reviewed publications, software development experience, or hands-on machine learning projects signal fit. Clear, metacognitive communication—“showing your work”—is essential.

Ready to turn your computer science expertise into the knowledge base for tomorrow’s AI? Apply today and start teaching the model that will teach the world.

We offer a pay range of $8-to- $65 per hour, with the exact rate determined after evaluating your experience, expertise, and geographic location. Final offer amounts may vary from the pay range listed above. As a contractor you’ll supply a secure computer and high‑speed internet; company‑sponsored benefits such as health insurance and PTO do not apply.

Job Title:

Project Manager, Pharmacovigilance

Responsible for leading UBC Pharmacovigilance (PV) project teams to deliver contracted services and ensuring achievement of contracted project milestones for assigned projects.

Description

We’re looking for a musically literate specialist to help evaluate the quality of AI models working with music notation and audio. You’ll contribute to QA and data labeling across OMR, Audio2Score, and Autograde, helping improve our models and build high-quality golden datasets. Strong musical understanding, attention to detail, and the ability to evaluate musical outputs in a structured way are essential.

This role is offered on a contract basis, with the number of working hours to be discussed and agreed upon.

Key responsibilities

  • Expert-score every OMR and A2S release each sprint (biweekly QA: 5-20 scores for OMR, 5-10 for A2S)
  • Run deeper quarterly QA cycles with AB-tests (100-300 scores for OMR, ~100 for A2S)
  • Run quarterly competitor benchmarking against N competitors on the golden dataset (first cycle planned October 2026)
  • Provide fast sanity checks on model candidates between releases (5-10 scores/week for OMR when updates are available; 1-2 scores, 2-3 times/month for A2S)
  • Spot-check outputs against MSCZ ground truth and flag dataset/benchmark inconsistencies
  • Build and label the Autograde golden test set: record specific mistake types and annotate each recording against the score (what should have been played, what error occurred) — needed before the Oct 31, 2026 MatchMySound cutover
  • Run head-to-head comparison of Autograde vs MatchMySound on the same golden set
  • Extend the golden dataset by transcribing audio where possible
  • Extend the same labeling/QA process to adjacent projects (AutoSync, Audio2Chords) as they scale

Requirements

  • Strong musical literacy: able to read and evaluate music notation, scores, and audio performances
  • Experience judging OMR (optical music recognition) and audio-to-score transcription output for accuracy
  • Familiarity with structured/rubric-based QA scoring methodology
  • Comfortable evaluating a range of score types (multilingual lyrics, orchestral vs. ensemble vs. solo, tabs, chord notation)
  • Attention to detail for spot-checking datasets against ground truth
  • Comfortable giving structured written feedback usable by engineering/product teams

What You'll Do

raw.description:
Elation is a cloud-based clinical platform for independent primary care practices. We want doctors spending their time on patients, not paperwork.

We're hiring full-stack engineers for our billing team.

Billing is a challenging domain. We receive data from insurers and partners who each follow the standards a little differently, but we need to make billing simple for our customers regardless of their payer arrangements and chase down every dollar we can for them across denials. We're using LLMs to take over a lot of work people currently do by hand. You'll design, build, and run these systems yourself.

If that sounds interesting, apply even if you don't check every box below.

What the work looks like

  • Building systems that balance financial transactions between insurance, patients, and the practice. We’re building complex solutions that maximize reimbursement for practices and get them paid more while removing complexity for them.
  • Working with inconsistent data from outside partners and handling the edge cases well
  • Shipping AI features that real users depend on, and figuring out how to tell when they're wrong
  • Improving a mature codebase while customers are using it every day
  • Owning your work in production and working with Support when something breaks
  • Collaborating with product and design to identify improvements and make them rapidly

Your first 60 days

  • Ship something to production
  • Scope and build a new feature with Product and Design
  • Learn our stack and enough of the billing domain to be functional
  • Join code reviews and production support
  • Engage with customers and learn from their feedback

6–12 months in

  • You own big features; collaborating with design and product stakeholders all the way through deployment, monitoring, and collecting insights on adoption
  • You help set technical direction for your team on problems that you own
  • Support teams, product owners, and sales representatives know you as someone who gets production issues resolved quickly and can speak to the solutions natively

Who we're looking for

You like owning a problem from start to finish. You think about how things will fail before they ship. You can identify when a problem needs a proper fix versus when a simple bandaid will do. You don't need to know healthcare billing already, but you're happy to learn it and to ask the experts a lot of questions. You can explain technical trade-offs to non-engineers. And you already use AI tools in your own work.

How we work

Each team has several engineers, an engineering manager, a product manager, and a designer. Engineers make the technical calls and work with Product on scope and priorities.

Requirements

Essential

  • 5+ years of professional software development (8+ for Staff, including technical leadership)
  • Production experience building and running backend services and APIs
  • Comfortable working across the stack and in more than one language
  • Experience with alerting/observability/instrumentation for real production solutions
  • Clear communicator with technical and non-technical people
  • Interest in building with LLMs

Nice to have

  • Experience building production features with LLMs or machine learning
  • A data-driven mentality
  • Python and/or PHP, and MySQL
  • TypeScript and React
  • Payments, financial, or ledger systems
  • Event-driven or distributed systems on AWS
  • Observability and DevOps
  • US healthcare, especially medical billing or claims

Everyone Is Welcome

We're committed to building a diverse and inclusive engineering team. Please don't see everything in this post as a 'must have' — if you're excited about this role but don't check every box, we still want to hear from you.

We especially encourage applications from women, people of color, the LGBTQ+ community, people with disabilities, neurodivergent people, parents, carers and people from lower socio-economic backgrounds. If you have any requirements or accommodations that would help you interview or work comfortably, please let us know.

Our engineering team is fully remote and brings diverse backgrounds and experiences. This role is open to candidates in the US, Canada, and New Zealand.

We are committed to equal opportunity for all employees and applicants, and value individuals with diverse perspectives including, but not limited to: race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, age, gender identity or gender expression, national origin, disability or veteran status.

Elation also complies with all applicable national, state and local laws governing nondiscrimination in employment as well as work authorization and employment eligibility verification requirements of the Immigration and Nationality Act and IRCA. We firmly believe a strong culture that supports a diverse and inclusive workforce allows us to achieve Elation’s mission of helping independent primary care thrive.

About the role:

Joining the Medical Team at Skin + Me is an opportunity to develop your clinical expertise in dermatology within a unique, fast-moving and collaborative environment, working alongside some of the best minds in dermatology across Europe.

You will play a key role in delivering safe, effective and personalised dermatology care to our patients in Germany, while helping us continuously improve how dermatology is delivered digitally.

Previous experience in dermatology is advantageous but not essential. Structured onboarding, training and clinical support are provided for the role.

Most importantly, we’re looking for someone with clinical humility, sound judgement, strong communication skills, and the confidence to work autonomously.

Who you are:

  • Fully qualified Medical Doctor holding a full, unrestricted Right to Practise as a Physician (Prawo Wykonywania Zawodu Lekarza, PWZ), issued by your Regional Medical Chamber (Okręgowa Izba Lekarska) and listed in the Central Register of Physicians maintained by the Supreme Medical Chamber (Naczelna Izba Lekarska)

  • Hold a valid EU medical licence and are authorised to treat patients in Germany (e.g. German Approbation or recognised EU qualification permitting cross-border care)

  • Professional fluency in English, to work with our English Medical Team

What you’ll do:

  • Review patient consultations, assess medical histories and clinical images, and diagnose, prescribe and manage treatment plans for patients in Germany

  • Act as a point of escalation for patient queries, working closely with our Customer Support Team and our dermatologists to ensure we provide the best care
  • Contribute to the ongoing development of our consultation model, clinical pathways and digital workflows within a dynamic start-up environment
  • Maintain a strong focus on clinical quality, patient safety and prescribing governance
  • Work closely with our in-house medical leadership and wider clinical team, and continuously develop your clinical knowledge through regular CPD sessions with our dermatologists
  • Monitor and uphold prescribing safety and quality standards

Working pattern:

  • This is a full-time, permanent employment contract (umowa o pracę), 5 days per week
  • May include some weekend work on a rota basis (e.g. 1 weekend in every 5)
  • Fully remote, working from Poland

Why should you choose Skin + Me?

  • A daily challenge – a fast-growing, entrepreneurial environment where no two days are the same
  • Make a difference – help improve the skin health and confidence of thousands of patients across Germany
  • Support network – work alongside experienced medical leaders, investors, and advisors who have built some of the world’s best consumer health companies

raw.description:
About Uplinq

Uplinq is the AI-powered bookkeeping and tax automation platform built for small business owners. We’re re-engineering how entrepreneurs manage their finances, replacing manual bookkeeping, rules, and spreadsheets with intelligent automation that delivers real-time clarity and control. We’re a Series A startup backed by top investors, growing fast. Our team is lean, execution-focused, and allergic to fluff. We measure success in demos booked, pipelines created, and revenue influenced.

About the Role

Uplinq is hiring a Senior Tax Strategist to manage our Strategy team, reporting to the VP of Tax. The VP sets the vision and designs the strategy program. This role executes it, scales it, and improves it over time.

This is a player-coach position. You will carry a full meeting load while managing the people, systems, and partnerships that let the Strategy function scale. Tax leadership is balancing compliance and strategy and does not have the bandwidth to give this team the dedicated management and development it needs. This role fills that gap.

We are looking for a CPA who leads with credibility, builds strong client relationships, and sees AI as a tool that will change how this work gets done.

What You'll Do

Lead the Strategy Team

  • Manage and mentor a team of three: two Tax Strategy Admins and one Tax Strategy Advisor. Set the standard for quality, consistency, and client care.
  • Serve as the technical and professional escalation point for the team's most difficult strategy questions.
  • Build development plans and growth paths for direct reports, including the path from Advisor (EA-level) to CPA-level strategy work.

Own Client Strategy, Personally

  • Carry your own book of business, leading up to 12 client strategy meetings per week and modeling the standard you expect from the team.
  • Deliver advanced, holistic strategies across tax minimization, estate planning, business succession, and insurance alignment.

Execute and Scale the Strategy System

  • Partner with the VP of Tax to execute, scale, and continuously improve the strategy program, turning it into the day-to-day system the team runs on so clients get consistency rather than an ad hoc experience.
  • Incorporate ideas and input from the Tax Strategy Advisor and the rest of the team to strengthen the system as it scales.
  • Develop and drive a proactive scheduling plan that gets every client on the calendar, rather than waiting for clients to reach out.
  • Refine SOPs and playbooks so the team's output stays consistent as the business grows.

Build the Referral Partner Bench

  • Build and maintain a curated library of vetted referral partners, including debt and tax resolution, legal, insurance, and investment advisory specialists, so client needs get solved end to end even when they fall outside our core services.
  • Own relationships with key referral partners and evaluate new ones as client needs arise.

Leverage Elite Tech and AI

  • Use our strategy stack, including TaxPlanIQ and Maverick, and integrate AI tools such as ChatGPT and TaxGPT into research, communication, strategy development and champion AI adoption across the Strategy team.

Qualifications

  • Active CPA license required. This is a credibility requirement for high-net-worth client strategy work, distinct from our EA-credentialed Advisor role.
  • 5+ years of progressive tax strategy experience in public accounting or a high-growth advisory environment.
  • Demonstrated experience designing and implementing complex tax and wealth strategies for business owners, beyond return preparation.
  • Strong people-management experience required.
  • A track record of executing and scaling a process or system you built.
  • Strong interpersonal and client-facing skills, with an understanding of the challenges small business owners face.
  • A tech-forward mindset, with a demonstrated willingness to adopt and champion AI tools to increase your own and your team's efficiency.
  • The ability to thrive in a fast-paced, rapidly scaling remote startup environment.

Why Join Us

  • Competitive pay plus health, dental, vision, 401(k), and life insurance
  • Remote-first, flexible work culture
  • Clear path for career growth in a fast-growing firm
  • Modern tech stack with an automation-first approach
  • Supportive, collaborative team with strong systems and documentation

Compensation

The pay range for this role is $120,000-$140,000 USD per year (Remote, United States)
