Company :

United Concordia Dental

Job Description :

JOB SUMMARY


**Due to Department of Defense (DOD) contract requirements, the incumbent who fills this position must be a US citizen, and must also pass a background check**


ROLE PURPOSELead complex initiatives from definition through transition by creating delivery clarity, coordinating cross-functional execution, maintaining reliable evidence, and enabling timely sponsor decisions.


The Project Manager is accountable for the disciplined planning, coordination, execution, monitoring, and closure of complex initiatives. The role converts approved business objectives into an actionable delivery structure and leads cross-functional teams toward agreed scope, schedule, cost, quality, readiness, and outcome commitments.

The Project Manager partners with the project sponsor, business owner, Program Manager, Business Analysts, technology partners, operational leaders, vendors, and subject-matter experts. The role establishes and maintains the integrated project plan, facilitates productive working and governance forums, manages risks, issues, assumptions, dependencies, decisions, and changes, and provides transparent evidence of delivery health.

Within the PMO operating model, the Project Manager owns initiative-level execution. The Program Manager provides the broader portfolio context, governance connection, dependency visibility, coaching, and escalation support. The Project Manager is expected to lead proactively, surface difficult information early, frame recommended actions, and maintain momentum without substituting administration for leadership.


ESSENTIAL RESPONSIBILITIES

Project Definition, Planning, and Initiation

Establish a clear, realistic, and controlled foundation for delivery.

  • Partner with the sponsor and business owner to clarify the business need, intended outcomes, success measures, scope boundaries, assumptions, constraints, and acceptance expectations.
  • Develop and maintain fit-for-purpose project charters, integrated plans, schedules, milestone maps, resource needs, and delivery assumptions.
  • Confirm roles, responsibilities, decision rights, governance forums, escalation paths, and working agreements.
  • Identify internal and external dependencies and incorporate them into planning, sequencing, and commitments.
  • Align the delivery approach and level of control to initiative complexity, risk, regulatory exposure, and business need.

Execution and Integrated Delivery Management

Lead day-to-day delivery with structure, urgency, and accountability.

  • Coordinate cross-functional execution across business, technology, operations, clinical, regulatory, finance, data, vendors, and other delivery partners as applicable.
  • Facilitate working sessions and project meetings with clear purpose, agendas, decisions, owners, due dates, and follow-through.
  • Track progress against approved scope, schedule, cost, quality, readiness, and delivery commitments.
  • Maintain delivery momentum by resolving routine barriers, reinforcing accountability, and escalating constraints that cannot be resolved within the project team.
  • Validate that deliverables meet documented requirements and acceptance criteria before milestones or phase transitions are considered complete.
  • Coordinate implementation, stabilization, transition-to-operations, and project closure activities.

RAID, Dependencies, and Decision Management

Create early visibility and active ownership of conditions that could affect outcomes.

  • Identify, document, assess, and actively manage project risks, issues, assumptions, and dependencies in a current RAID log.
  • Define owners, mitigation or resolution actions, target dates, contingency plans, and escalation thresholds.
  • Manage interdependencies with other initiatives, teams, vendors, platforms, and operational commitments.
  • Maintain a traceable decision log and ensure decisions are translated into updated plans, commitments, and communications.
  • Escalate material risks, issues, dependencies, and decision needs early, with clear context, impact, options, and a recommended course of action.
  • Distinguish facts, assumptions, emerging concerns, and confirmed impacts in project reporting and discussions.

Scope, Schedule, Financial, and Change Control

Protect the integrity of approved commitments while enabling informed adaptation.

  • Establish and maintain approved baselines for scope, schedule, milestones, cost, and quality as applicable.
  • Assess proposed changes for impact to outcomes, benefits, resources, dependencies, readiness, timing, cost, and risk.
  • Ensure material changes follow the appropriate review and approval path before commitments are revised.
  • Communicate approved changes and update project evidence, forecasts, and stakeholder expectations promptly.
  • Monitor project financial health and partner with accountable leaders to address variances, funding concerns, or vendor impacts.

Governance, Reporting, and Portfolio Evidence

Provide accurate, decision-useful information at the project, domain, and portfolio levels.

  • Produce concise and timely status reporting that reflects actual delivery health, accomplishments, upcoming milestones, risks, issues, dependencies, decisions, changes, and support needed.
  • Prepare sponsors and governance bodies for decisions by framing implications, options, recommendations, and requested action.
  • Provide the Program Manager with current delivery evidence, dependencies, decisions, capacity concerns, and portfolio implications.
  • Participate in domain or portfolio governance when project impact, escalation, or a leadership decision requires it.
  • Maintain project artifacts as current working controls rather than static documents created only for compliance.
  • Adhere to applicable project lifecycle, governance, audit, documentation, and records-management requirements.

Stakeholder and Sponsor Leadership

Build shared understanding, timely decisions, and sustained accountability.

  • Develop and maintain a stakeholder and communication approach appropriate to the initiative.
  • Build productive relationships with sponsors, business owners, team members, delivery partners, and vendors.
  • Clarify stakeholder responsibilities, decision expectations, readiness obligations, and acceptance criteria.
  • Communicate clearly, concisely, and at the appropriate level for executives, governance groups, and delivery teams.
  • Use active listening, confirm shared understanding, surface difficult information constructively, and close the loop following decisions or changes.
  • Influence outcomes and resolve conflict professionally without relying on positional authority.

Change Readiness, Adoption, and Benefits Support

Connect technical or project completion to operational readiness and intended value.

  • Identify stakeholder, process, technology, policy, operational, clinical, contractual, and support impacts as applicable.
  • Integrate readiness, communications, training, adoption, acceptance, stabilization, and transition activities into the project plan.
  • Confirm accountable owners for operational readiness, sustained adoption, and post-delivery outcome measurement.
  • Track readiness criteria separately from task completion and escalate unresolved ownership, adoption risk, or acceptance gaps before implementation.
  • Connect project deliverables and acceptance criteria to intended outcomes and preserve evidence of changes that may affect the benefit case.
  • Ensure the transition from project delivery to business outcome ownership is explicit at closure.

Team Leadership and Continuous Improvement

Create an organized, collaborative, and accountable delivery environment.

  • Set clear expectations for team members and reinforce ownership of commitments, deliverables, decisions, and follow-up actions.
  • Promote collaboration, inclusion, transparency, and professional conduct across matrixed teams.
  • Adapt leadership and delivery practices to project complexity, team needs, and changing conditions.
  • Apply structured problem-solving and facilitate timely resolution of conflict or ambiguity.
  • Capture lessons learned and contribute reusable practices, templates, and improvements to PMO delivery standards.
  • Use approved collaboration and portfolio tools to maintain transparent, accessible, and reliable project information.
  • Perform other duties as assigned or requested.

EDUCATION


Minimum

  • High School Diploma/GED

Preferred

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, technology, healthcare administration, operations, project management, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.
  • Advanced education or professional development in project management, business, technology, healthcare administration, change management, or a related discipline.

EXPERIENCE


Minimum

  • **Due to Department of Defense (DOD) contract requirements, the incumbent who fills this position must be a US citizen, and must also pass a background check**
  • 1 - 3 years experience in a project manager role and/or in a project leadership role

Preferred

  • Five or more years of progressively responsible experience leading projects, initiatives, or complex cross-functional work.
  • Demonstrated experience developing and maintaining project charters, integrated plans, schedules, RAID logs, decision logs, status reports, and stakeholder communications.
  • Experience coordinating delivery across business and technical teams in a matrixed environment.
  • Experience managing scope, schedule, dependencies, risks, issues, decisions, changes, and resource constraints.
  • Demonstrated ability to communicate with sponsors and leaders, facilitate decisions, and present clear recommendations.
  • Experience in healthcare, insurance, regulated operations, technology-enabled delivery, or another complex environment.
  • Experience with structured project lifecycle, governance, audit, or compliance requirements.
  • Experience with both business and technology initiatives and with predictive, agile, or hybrid delivery approaches.
  • Experience coordinating vendors or external delivery partners.
  • Experience using portfolio-management and collaboration platforms to support transparent project controls and reporting.

LICENSES/CERTIFICATIONS


Required

  • None

Preferred

  • PMP certification or comparable project management training or certification. Change-management or agile certification is also valued where relevant.

SKILLS

  • Project planning and integrated schedule management
  • RAID, dependency, decision, and change management
  • Sponsor and stakeholder engagement
  • Executive and delivery-team communication
  • Meeting facilitation and action management
  • Problem-solving, negotiation, and conflict resolution
  • Financial and vendor coordination
  • Change readiness, adoption, and transition planning
  • Team leadership and accountability
  • Strong organization, judgment, and follow-through

What Success Looks Like

  • Creates a delivery structure that the team understands and actively uses.
  • Maintains reliable, current evidence of project health and does not allow key artifacts to become stale.
  • Surfaces risks, issues, dependencies, and decision needs early enough for meaningful action.
  • Brings sponsors clear implications, options, recommendations, and requested decisions.
  • Keeps the project team focused on outcomes, commitments, readiness, and acceptance rather than activity alone.
  • Balances process discipline with practical judgment and scales controls to the initiative’s complexity and risk.
  • Protects delivery momentum while maintaining transparency when commitments are threatened.
  • Completes an explicit, evidence-based handoff from project delivery to operational ownership and benefit follow-through.

ROLE DISTINCTION
The Project Manager owns initiative-level planning and execution. The role is more than meeting coordination and status administration: it requires active leadership of delivery, evidence, accountability, risk, decisions, readiness, stakeholder alignment, and transition to operations.

O Sicredi é uma instituição financeira cooperativa que acredita na força da colaboração para construir uma sociedade mais próspera. Com foco no desenvolvimento das pessoas e na geração de valor para seus associados, promove um ambiente de trabalho inovador, colaborativo e de aprendizado contínuo.

Esta oportunidade é para atuar no desenvolvimento de soluções da Plataforma de Dados e Analytics do Sicredi, utilizando uma arquitetura moderna e tecnologias de ponta voltadas ao processamento de grandes volumes de dados. A posição tem forte impacto na geração de valor para o negócio, com incentivo à troca de conhecimentos, certificações e reconhecimento do trabalho técnico. A atuação envolve construção de soluções escaláveis, governança, qualidade e segurança dos dados, em parceria com diferentes perfis de dados e áreas de negócio.

  • Desenvolvimento de framework de Dados: Criar e manter módulos da plataforma de dados escaláveis e reutilizáveis para processar e armazenar dados;
  • Armazenamento de Dados: Projetar e gerenciar os repositórios, garantindo que os dados sejam armazenados de forma eficiente e segura;
  • Processamento de Dados: Transformar dados brutos em formatos utilizáveis, utilizando ferramentas como Databricks e outras soluções de ETL (Extração, Transformação e Carga);
  • Garantia do monitoramento sobre a Qualidade dos Dados: Implementar processos para monitorar a precisão, consistência e integridade dos dados;
  • Segurança dos Dados: Proteger os dados contra acessos não autorizados através de medidas de segurança como criptografia e controle de acesso;
  • Colaboração com Equipes: Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com os perfis de dados e áreas de negócio para entender suas necessidades;
  • Monitoramento e Otimização: Monitorar o desempenho da plataforma de dados e implementar melhorias para otimizar a eficiência e a escalabilidade;
  • Documentação: Documentar processos e procedimentos de engenharia de dados para garantir que as práticas sejam replicáveis e compreensíveis para outros membros da equipe.
  • Conhecimento de linguagens de programação como Python, Java, Scala e SQL;
  • Conhecimento de bancos de dados relacionais (como MySQL e Oracle) e não relacionais, como MongoDB;
  • Conhecimento de ferramentas de armazenamento em nuvem, como Amazon S3 ou outras soluções cloud;
  • Experiência em ETL (Extract, Transform, Load) para extração, transformação e carga de dados;
  • Conhecimento em armazenamento e processamento distribuído utilizando ferramentas de Big Data, como Hadoop, Spark e Kafka;
  • Conhecimento de arquiteturas de dados, com capacidade para desenhar e implementar soluções escaláveis e robustas;
  • Comunicação assertiva e fluida com diferentes perfis de dados e áreas de negócio.
Desejáveis
  • Conhecimento ou vivência com Databricks;
  • Vivência em ambientes de Plataforma de Dados e Analytics;
  • Interesse por aprendizado contínuo, compartilhamento de conhecimento, especializações e certificações.

Job Title: Sales Development Representative - Financial Solutions
Reports to: Director of Sales, Financial Solutions

BELAY is a growing and vibrant, Atlanta, GA-based company that offers virtual staffing solutions in the areas of Virtual Assistants, Marketing Assistants, and Financial Specialists. We are a fast-paced team of high performers that work extremely hard but also know how to have a great time. Culture is a top priority and our values are lived out daily.

Who is BELAY? Click here and enjoy!

**Candidates must reside in U.S. Eastern or Central time zones due to occasional in-person meetings & travel requirements - with preference in the Atlanta Metro Area**

Job purpose

The Sales Development Representative (SDR) - Financial Solutions plays a key role in driving BELAY’s growth by reconnecting with warm and dormant financial solutions leads to generate new business opportunities. This entry-level sales position is designed to develop strong foundational sales skills while providing critical support to the inbound sales team. The SDR will proactively engage prospects who have previously expressed interest in BELAY’s services, creating authentic connections, uncovering needs, and converting qualified leads into new clients.

Duties and responsibilities

As a BELAY Corporate Team member, you will professionally represent the company in all virtual and in-person interactions. You are expected to exemplify our mission, vision, and core values daily, fostering a collaborative and positive team environment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Conduct warm outreach via phone, email, and LinkedIn to re-engage dormant leads and Marketing Qualified Leads (MQLs)
  • Lead consultative sales conversations to understand prospect needs, present tailored solutions, address objections, and close business
  • Utilize Salesforce to manage outreach activity, track pipeline progression, and maintain accurate records
  • Nurture early-stage leads through strategic, value-driven communication
  • Partner with Solutions Consultants and Marketing to enhance lead conversion rates and ensure message alignment
  • Consistently meet or exceed weekly outreach, meeting, and conversion goals
  • Provide insights and feedback on lead quality, market trends, and campaign effectiveness
  • Represent BELAY with professionalism, enthusiasm, and a brand-aligned presence
  • Manage the full sales cycle — from initial outreach through follow-up, conversion, and close

Qualifications

This role requires a motivated and trustworthy self-starter with strong communication and technological skills who thrives both independently and on a team. Our ideal corporate team member is flexible, creative, well-organized and ready to roll up their sleeves to get the job done!

  • Accounting acumen is required, with a strong understanding of accounting principles and processes, to identify opportunities within BELAY’s Financial Solutions offerings.
  • 1–2 years of experience in sales, lead generation, customer success, or related fields (entry-level candidates are encouraged to apply)
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, comfortable engaging prospects via phone and video
  • Results-oriented and motivated by metrics, growth, and achievement
  • Highly organized with strong follow-through and attention to detail
  • Experience with Salesforce or a similar CRM is a plus
  • Positive, resilient, and curious, with a desire to learn and thrive in a fast-paced environment

Working conditions

BELAY Corporate offers full-time remote work, requiring a dedicated, distraction-free home office for standard Monday-Friday business hours, with occasional travel for some roles. As a full-time, non-exempt W-2 employee, you'll join a vibrant, award-winning company culture where you're a valued, engaged team player in a thriving organization.

This position does not have any physical requirements at this time.

Direct reportsN/A

None

It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, or qualifications. Responsibilities may change from time to time based on business needs, and team members may be assigned additional duties as needed.

Health Insurance: Medical, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance are available to eligible employees. Retirement Benefits: 401(k) plan through Vanguard, with a 4% discretionary employer match. Employees are eligible after 90 days of employment.

Credit Acceptance is proud to be an award-winning company recognized both locally and nationally across multiple workplace categories. Our world-class culture is shaped by dedicated team members who are driven to succeed as professionals individually and together as a team. Backed by a strong product, exceptional people, and a stable financial foundation, we’ve grown into a leading provider of used and new car financing across the country.

Our Engineering and Analytics Team Members utilize the latest technology to develop, monitor, and maintain complex practices that help optimize our success. Our Team Members value being challenged, are encouraged to express their ideas, and have the flexibility to enjoy work life balance. We build intrinsic value by partnering with all functions of our business to support their success and make strategic business decisions. We focus on professional development and continuous improvement while enjoying a casual work environment and Great Place to Work culture!

Credit Acceptance makes vehicle ownership possible for consumers other lenders decline, through a dealer network, an originations and servicing platform, and pricing and decisioning models refined over decades. The technology estate underneath this business was built project by project over a long period, and modernizing it is the largest engineering opportunity at the company. As the Distinguished Engineer, you are the senior-most individual contributor in Technology, reporting directly to the Chief Technology Officer. You will set the multi-year technical strategy for the company while staying close enough to the code and systems to remain credible — this is not an architect role that reviews designs from a distance, nor a strong engineer role that goes deep in a single domain. Two things sit at the center of the job: the target architecture for the enterprise, and the architecture for running AI agents across it. You will not own a team; you will own the hardest technical problems the company has, and get them resolved by convincing the people who do own the teams.

Outcomes and Activities

  • Enterprise target architecture: Convene the principal and staff engineers who own each domain to define the end-state architecture across originations, servicing, marketplace, data, and AI, and use it to drive the multi-year plan. Ensure every component has a defined interface with stated inputs and outputs, every unmade decision has a written principle standing in for it, and the document states honestly how close the organization is to the end state. Publish the architecture, including the tradeoffs that were rejected and why.
  • Agentic AI architecture across the enterprise: Own the enterprise agent architecture spanning servicing and collections, the dealer side, originations, and internal engineering and back-office workflows, built on one common foundation rather than one stack per team. Establish a governed way for agents to discover and call business capabilities, data, and tools, using the Model Context Protocol as the integration layer. Define an identity and authorization model that treats an agent as a first-class actor with its own least-privilege entitlements, along with observability, evaluation, and cost controls that work consistently for every agent. Set policy on what an agent may decide independently versus what stays with a person, and define where that line moves and on what evidence. Design the architecture to produce an examiner-ready record of what each agent saw, recommended, and touched, and set the evaluation and adversarial testing approach that makes agent outcomes defensible. Ensure the same foundation and controls apply to agents built by outside firms on the company's behalf.
  • Migration off on-premises infrastructure: Own the technical strategy for migrating transactional and analytical workloads off on-premises infrastructure to the company's strategic targets — AWS for transactional workloads and Databricks for analytical workloads — determining what lifts and shifts, what replatforms, what gets re-architected on the way versus after, and what the steady-state cost looks like. Own the resilience and recovery architecture for the target state.
  • Data platform architecture: Set the architecture for change-data-capture-based ingestion, streaming where warranted, and a modern warehouse with no job-scheduling dependency, moving the organization from largely batch analytical data movement to real time. Help settle the open question of who owns the transactional and analytical data models.
  • Real-time decisioning, model serving, and experimentation: Architect for pricing and credit model and scorecard updates that drop in as a layer rather than requiring a multi-quarter rebuild, and for an experimentation platform that supports orders of magnitude more concurrent experiments than a conventional release process allows.
  • Marketplace and search architecture: Own the architecture and interfaces for a unified vehicle inventory, consumer search, and lead routing platform, ensuring the data model supports more than one class of seller from the start.
  • AI-native engineering practice: Define the golden path for how software is specified, generated, reviewed, tested, and deployed, including the analyzers and gates that enforce it, and measure the inputs to that practice rather than just the outputs. Hold the build-versus-buy bar for AI capability, building what is core competency and about to scale, and renting the rest.
  • Performance and peak readiness: Own the instrumentation, baseline, and remediation architecture needed to meet the standard that no page takes more than one second. Own peak-event headroom, including understanding the limits of each system and maintaining tested degradation levers ahead of need.
  • Operating approach: Move the organization from project-shaped systems toward owned platforms with stated contracts. Document every component's inputs and outputs, and be ready to argue why closely coupled components should not be consolidated into one. Work toward a two-week requirement-to-production iteration bar, treating architecture that cannot be delivered incrementally as unfinished. Name what comes off the plan whenever a change in direction is requested. Make the call and own the outcome on architectural recommendations. Treat security, privacy, auditability, and regulatory obligation as design inputs from the start in this regulated environment.
  • Hands-on, not hands-off: This is not optional. Stay personally engaged in the technical work rather than directing it from a distance. Join design reviews, write proofs of concept, read code, and engage in incident analysis. This hands-on time does not replace the work the teams own, and it is not a fallback when delivery slips. Every engineer in the organization will read how you write, how you argue a design, how you handle being wrong, and how you treat engineers who disagree with you as the bar. Staff and principal engineers should be measurably better at this work for having worked with you.
  • Success measures: A published target architecture the domain owners agree with and that the annual and long-range plans are actually written against; an enterprise agent foundation that internal teams and partners build on, with access controls, evaluation, and audit records in place; a credible, dated, costed migration path off on-premises infrastructure and demonstrated progress against it; measured improvement in chosen input metrics such as latency, availability, recovery objectives, deployment frequency, and experiment throughput; growth in the number of principal and staff engineers who are better at this work as a result of this role; and architectural decisions that stop being relitigated because the reasoning was written down and the interfaces were clear.

Competencies

The following items detail how you will be successful in this role. At this level, you are expected to set the standard for each.

  • Customer Empathy: Customer Empathy is the ability to understand the perspectives, pain points, and experiences of customers. It involves actively putting oneself in the customer’s shoes, comprehending their needs and challenges, and using that understanding to provide a better, more customer-centric experience.
  • Engineering Excellence: Engineering Excellence is about bringing great craftsmanship and thought leadership to deliver an outstanding product that delights customers and solves for the business. This involves the pursuit and achievement of high standards, best practices, innovation, and superior solutions.
  • One Team: A One Team mindset refers to a collaborative approach across the organization, where individuals work together seamlessly, without boundaries, as a single, cohesive team. Shared goals, open communication and mutual support create a sense of collective purpose. This enables teams to navigate challenges and pursue shared objectives more effectively.
  • Owner’s Mindset: Owner’s Mindset involves adopting a set of behaviors that reflect a sense of responsibility, accountability, strategic thinking, and a proactive approach to managing your domain. As an owner, you understand the business and your domain(s) deeply and solve for the right outcome for the domain(s) and the business.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or closely related field of study; or equivalent work experience
  • Minimum 10 years of software engineering experience or comparable depth of experience
  • A track record of setting and delivering multi-year technical strategy at enterprise scale, as an individual contributor rather than through a reporting line.
  • Depth in distributed systems architecture, and in at least two of: agentic or LLM-based systems in production; large-scale cloud migration of transactional systems; modern data platform and lakehouse architecture; machine learning platform and model serving; high-traffic consumer or marketplace applications.
  • Architecture ownership of agentic or LLM-based systems that reached production, including how tool and data access were governed, how the system was evaluated, and what its failure modes turned out to be.
  • Demonstrated ownership of a legacy-to-modern migration of systems the business runs on, including the sequencing, the cost case, and the failure modes, with production revenue at stake rather than only familiarity with the concept.
  • Hands-on credibility today: actively reads code, writes proofs of concept, joins design reviews, and participates in incident analysis.
  • Evidence of influence without authority across organizational boundaries, including work that changed direction at the executive level.
  • Strong written communication; architecture here is carried by documents that other people can act on without the author in the room.
  • Demonstrated ability to develop staff and principal engineers, and to raise the technical bar of engineers not directly managed.
  • Experience delivering in a regulated industry, or a clear ability to work inside audit, security, and compliance constraints without treating them as an obstacle.

Preferred Experience

  • Recognized contribution beyond one employer, such as open source, standards work, publications, patents, or a sustained external technical presence.
  • Consumer lending, auto finance, insurance, or payments experience; or large-scale distributed systems experience supporting a business-critical function in another high-stakes domain.
  • The Model Context Protocol or comparable agent tool-integration standards, and identity and authorization design for non-human actors.
  • AWS and Databricks at production scale.
  • Experience standing up an experimentation platform, or moving an organization from tens to thousands of experiments per year.
  • Experience building AI-native development practice across a large engineering organization, and measuring whether it worked.
  • Marketplace, search, or inventory systems with more than one class of seller.

Knowledge and Skills

  • Distributed Systems Mastery: Technical mastery across distributed systems and software architecture, with deep knowledge of current and emerging technologies and their business implications.
  • Enterprise Problem-Solving: Ability to solve enterprise-wide problems where no precedent exists and to own cross-team shared infrastructure.
  • Strategic Independence: Ability to define and execute technical strategy for the entire organization, partner closely with executives, mobilize resources, and drive consensus across stakeholders at all levels.
  • Visionary Leadership: Bold strategic thinking paired with curiosity, ingenuity, and resourcefulness; recognized industry-level thought leadership and a commitment to lifelong learning.
  • Customer and Market Insight: Company-wide expertise in customer needs, using deep customer and market understanding to shape product and technical strategy and anticipate the impact of industry trends.
  • Technical Writing: Ability to produce architecture documentation clear and complete enough for others to act on independently.
  • Executive Communication and Influence: Ability to build consensus and influence direction across organizational and executive boundaries without formal authority.
  • Talent Development: Ability to raise the technical bar of engineers across the organization, including staff and principal engineers who are not direct reports.

Target Compensation: A competitive base salary range from $232,500 - $341,000. This position is eligible for equity and annual cash bonuses. Final compensation within the range is influenced by many factors including role-specific skills, depth and experience level, industry background, relevant education and certifications.


Candidates who reside in the following major metropolitan areas may be eligible for a premium on top of the posted range based on their specific zone: San Francisco, Seattle, Boston, New York City, Los Angeles and San Diego.

Benefits

  • Excellent benefits package that includes 401(K) match, adoption assistance, parental leave, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive medical/ dental/vision and many nonstandard benefits that make us a Great Place to Work

Our Company Values:

To be successful in this role, Team Members need to be:

  • Positive by maintaining resiliency and focusing on solutions
  • Respectful by collaborating and actively listening
  • Insightful by cultivating innovation, accumulating business and role specific knowledge, demonstrating self-awareness and making quality decisions
  • Direct by effectively communicating and conveying courage
  • Earnest by taking accountability, applying feedback and effectively planning and priority setting

Expectations:

  • Remain compliant with our policies processes and legal guidelines

Advice!

We understand that your career search may look different than others. Our hiring team wants to make sure that this would be a fit not just for us, but for you long term. If you are actively looking or starting to explore new opportunities, send us your application!

P.S.

We have great details around our stats, success, history and more. We’re proud of our culture and are happy to share why – let’s talk!

Required degrees must have been earned at institutions of Higher Education which are accredited by the Council for Higher Education Accreditation or equivalent.

Credit Acceptance is dedicated to providing a safe and inclusive working environment for all. As part of our Culture of Compliance, we are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and value our culturally diverse workforce. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment regardless of the person’s age, race, color, religion, sex, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status, criminal history, or any other legally protected characteristic.

raw.excerpt: We take great strides to ensure our employees have the resources to live well, be healthy, continue learning, develop skills, grow professionally and serve our local communities.
raw.description:
We take great strides to ensure our employees have the resources to live well, be healthy, continue learning, develop skills, grow professionally and serve our local communities. We invite you to apply for a career with us.


Residency in or relocation to Louisiana is preferred for all positions.


Applicants must be authorized to work for Louisiana Blue in the United States without employer-sponsored immigration support. Louisiana Blue will not provide current or future employment-based immigration sponsorship or other immigration support for this opportunity, including H-1B, L-1, O-1, H-1B1, E-3, TN, or J-1 sponsorship or F-1 OPT/STEM OPT/CPT support. Applicants who would require such sponsorship or employer support during their employment should not pursue this opportunity.

POSITION PURPOSE


The Board-Certified Assistant Behavior Analyst (BCaBA), Utilization Reviewer role is responsible for evaluating the medical necessity and clinical appropriateness of Applied Behavior Analysis (ABA) services for LA Blue members. Working under the guidance of a BCBA Utilization Reviewer, this role conducts preliminary clinical reviews, analyzes treatment documentation, evaluates service utilization trends, and collaborates with providers to obtain and clarify clinical information to ensure compliance with payer guidelines while maintaining clinical integrity and promoting cost-effective care.


How You Contribute to the Company’s Mission In This Role

  • Conduct comprehensive clinical reviews of ABA treatment requests to determine medical necessity and alignment with evidence-based practices.
  • Evaluate treatment goals, progress metrics, and data collection methods to ensure clinical effectiveness and appropriateness.
  • Oversee and direct work activities of unlicensed clinical staff involved in the utilization management process.
  • Communicate with ABA providers to gather additional clinical information and provide feedback on documentation and treatment planning.
  • Ensure compliance with state and federal regulations, payer-specific guidelines, and internal policies.
  • Participate in the development and refinement of utilization management protocols and clinical review tools.
  • Collaborate with internal departments such as claims, provider relations, and member services to resolve clinical and administrative issues.
  • Support the appeals and grievance process by preparing clinical rationales and participating in case reviews.
  • Stay current with developments in ABA research, clinical guidelines, and payer policy changes through continuing education and professional development.
  • Represent the organization in external audits, accreditation reviews, and inter-agency meetings as needed.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Applied Behavior Analysis, Psychology, Special Education, Human Services, Social Work, or a related field. Four years of related experience can be used in lieu of Bachelor's degree.
  • Minimum of 2 years of experience working in ABA services, autism services, behavioral health, utilization management, or a related healthcare setting.
  • Board Certified Assistant Behavior Analyst (BCaBA) certification required within 1 year of hire.
  • Strong knowledge of ABA terminology, treatment planning, behavior analytic principles, and service delivery models.
  • Experience reviewing clinical documentation and treatment records.
  • Excellent written, verbal, and professional communication skills.
  • Strong analytical, organizational, and critical-thinking abilities.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications and electronic health record systems.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining attention to detail

Preferred Qualifications

  • Familiarity with medical terminology, particularly terms related to ABA therapy and developmental disorders.
  • Prior experience supporting utilization management processes.
  • Ability to type a minimum of forty words per minute with accuracy and attention to detail.

The Physical Demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the Accountabilities and Essential Functions of the job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable an individual with disabilities to perform the essential functions

  • Perform other job-related duties as assigned, within your scope of responsibilities.
  • Job duties are performed in a normal and clean office environment with normal noise levels.
  • Work is predominately done while standing or sitting.
  • The ability to comprehend, document, calculate, visualize, and analyze are required.



An Equal Opportunity Employer

All internal employees please apply through Workday Careers.

PLEASE USE A WEB BROWSER OTHER THAN INTERNET EXPLORER IF YOU ENCOUNTER ISSUES (CHROME, FIREFOX, SAFARI)

Additional Information

Please be sure to monitor your email frequently for communications you may receive during the recruiting process. Due to the high volume of applications we receive, only those most qualified will be contacted. To monitor the status of your application, please visit the "My Applications" section in the Candidate Home section of your Workday account.

If you are an individual with a disability and require a reasonable accommodation to complete an application, please contact for assistance.

In support of our mission to improve the health and lives of Louisianians, we encourage the good health of its employees and visitors. We want to ensure that our employees have a work environment that will optimize personal health and well-being. Due to the acknowledged hazards from exposure to environmental tobacco smoke, and in order to promote good health, our company properties are smoke and tobacco free.

We perform background and pre-employment drug screening after an offer has been extended and prior to hire for all positions. As part of this process records may be verified and information checked with agencies including but not limited to the Social Security Administration, criminal courts, federal, state, and county repositories of criminal records, Department of Motor Vehicles and credit bureaus. Pursuant with sec 1033 of the Violent Crime Control and Law Enforcement Act of 1994, individuals who have been convicted of a felony crime involving dishonesty or breach of trust are prohibited from working in the insurance industry unless they obtain written consent from their state insurance commissioner.

Additionally, we are a Drug Free Workplace. A pre-employment drug screen will be required and any offer is contingent upon satisfactory drug testing results.

raw.excerpt: Ready to embark on the quest of joining Hack The Box?
raw.description:
Ready to embark on the quest of joining Hack The Box?

At the end of this thrilling journey, you'll become a proud member of Hack The Box, with the ultimate mission to help cybersecurity professionals and organizations enhance their cyber-attack readiness. Get ready for an exciting adventure into the world of cybersecurity! 🚀🔒💻

✨The core mission of the EMEA Field Marketing Manager:

This is an exciting opportunity to lead Hack The Box’s field marketing strategy across Europe, with a primary focus on the commercial and enterprise markets.

You will serve as the strategic marketing partner to the EMEA Sales organization, building integrated regional programs that generate demand, deepen engagement within priority accounts, accelerate opportunities, and contribute to pipeline and revenue.

This role is broader than event marketing. Events will be one component of a coordinated regional strategy that also includes account-based marketing, digital campaigns, webinars, executive programs, partner activation, customer marketing, content, and sales plays.

During your first six months, you will focus on developing the EMEA marketing strategy, building strong relationships with Sales, identifying regional priorities and target accounts, launching initial campaigns, and establishing a consistent approach to reporting and optimization.

🏢 Location & Work Mode:

  • Europe (EoR - Employee of Record through Deel) OR Athens, Greece (we'll support your relocation)
  • If in Athens, Greece: Hybrid (2 days in office)
  • Full time

✈️ Relocation

  • We offer a 10% relocation bonus on the annual salary to support your move.
  • In addition, you would benefit from a 50% tax reduction on your income as part of the relocation.
  • We'll support you with accommodation during the first few weeks

🍺 The fellowship you’ll be joining:

Reporting to the Global Director of Field Marketing, you will join Hack The Box’s global marketing organization and collaborate closely with Demand Generation, Partner Marketing, Product Marketing, Content, Digital, Brand, Communications, Customer Marketing, and Marketing Operations.

You will be a key partner to EMEA Sales leadership, account executives, business development representatives, solutions engineers, and channel teams. You will help connect global marketing priorities with the needs of the region and operate as the marketing lead for your market.

🚀 The adventures that await you after becoming an EMEA Field Marketing Manager

  • Own the EMEA field marketing strategy from ideation and planning through execution, measurement, and optimization.
  • Partner with EMEA Sales leadership to develop quarterly and annual marketing plans aligned with regional pipeline, revenue, and account goals.
  • Build integrated regional campaigns using account-based marketing, digital programs, content, webinars, executive engagement, partner initiatives, customer advocacy, and strategic events.
  • Translate global campaigns into relevant regional programs based on EMEA market needs, sales priorities, buyer challenges, and competitive trends.
  • Develop account-based programs for priority enterprise accounts and strategic opportunities.
  • Create marketing plays that help Sales open doors, engage additional buying-group members, progress opportunities, and re-engage stalled or closed-lost accounts.
  • Partner with Business Development and Sales to establish clear lead follow-up plans, campaign activation strategies, and shared success metrics.
  • Develop audience-specific programs for CISOs, security leaders, technical practitioners, talent-development leaders, and other members of the buying committee.
  • Build regional webinar, roundtable, executive-engagement, and thought-leadership programs that position Hack The Box as a leader in cyber workforce readiness.
  • Create coordinated pre-event, onsite, and post-event campaigns that extend the value of trade shows and field programs.
  • Work with Partner Marketing to develop joint campaigns that generate demand and pipeline with strategic channel and technology partners.
  • Collaborate with Customer Marketing to feature customer stories, support expansion opportunities, and build regional advocacy.
  • Manage the EMEA field marketing budget and make investment recommendations based on strategic importance and expected business impact.
  • Establish clear goals for every program, including target-account engagement, lead quality, pipeline creation, opportunity acceleration, and influenced revenue.
  • Communicate campaign plans, performance, insights, and next steps consistently to Sales and Marketing stakeholders.
  • Analyze results and sales feedback to improve audience targeting, messaging, channel selection, and future investments.
  • Maintain visibility into regional market trends, customer needs, competitor activity, and emerging opportunities.

What success looks like

  • A clear, scalable, and measurable EMEA field marketing strategy is in place.
  • Sales and Marketing are aligned around regional priorities, target accounts, programs, and goals.
  • Integrated campaigns create qualified pipeline and influence revenue.
  • Engagement increases within priority accounts and across key buying groups.
  • Marketing programs support both new-logo acquisition and opportunity acceleration.
  • Regional events operate as part of broader campaigns with measurable pre-event and post-event outcomes.
  • Program insights are consistently used to optimize the marketing mix and regional investment strategy.

🏆 Skills, knowledge, and experience points required to unlock the role of EMEA Field Marketing Manager:

  • At least five years of B2B marketing experience, including field marketing, demand generation, account-based marketing (ABM), or integrated campaigns.
  • Experience marketing enterprise SaaS or technology solutions; cybersecurity experience is strongly preferred.
  • Demonstrated success building regional, multi-channel marketing programs that contribute to pipeline generation, opportunity acceleration, and revenue growth.
  • Strong understanding of enterprise sales cycles, account-based marketing, buying groups, and opportunity acceleration, with a track record of working closely with Sales, Business Development, Partner, and Customer Success teams.
  • Hands-on experience with marketing automation, CRM, ABM, analytics, and reporting platforms such as HubSpot. Experience using AI-powered marketing tools to improve campaign planning, content development, audience targeting, personalization, and performance analysis is highly desirable.
  • Ability to develop marketing strategies aligned with business objectives while remaining hands-on in campaign execution. Strong project-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple campaigns, stakeholders, budgets, and deadlines.
  • Excellent communication, collaboration, and stakeholder-management skills, with a creative, adaptable approach and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced global organization.

🕹️ What your Hack The Box adventure will have in store:

  • 🎯You'll have the exhilarating opportunity to contribute to a product that is highly appreciated by users and the cybersecurity community at large.
  • 🎯 You'll experience a highly supportive and caring environment, fostering growth, flexibility, and autonomy.
  • 🎯 You'll embark on an exciting journey of continuous learning and problem-solving, leveling up as our organization grows.
  • 🎯 Most importantly, you'll have a blast at HTB 🥳 because fun is an essential ingredient in our recipe for success! Just wait until you see our global meet-ups!

💰The gems you’ll be enjoying as an EMEA Field Marketing Manager:

  • Private Health Care & Life Insurance
  • Home Office Allowance
  • Ticket Restaurant Allowance
  • Paid paternity leave
  • Dedicated budget for training and professional development, participation in conferences
  • State-of-the-art equipment
  • Full access to the Hack The Box lab offerings; so you can learn how to hack 😉
  • Fully remote is an option. But we do have an office in London & Folkestone, UK

🗺️ The Quest of Becoming Hack The Box’s EMEA Field Marketing Manager:

  • Level 1 — Apply: Submit your application. Tell us why this role excites you and what you’d bring.
  • Level 2 — Talent Screen: A conversation with our Talent Acquisition team to explore your background and ambitions.
  • Level 3 — Chat with Jamie or Tom: A relaxed conversation with your future manager / department lead. Think of it as a mutual vibe check.
  • Level 4 — Complete a job-specific challenge and have a meaningful conversation with the team.
  • Level 5 — Congratulations! Not many reach this level 💪. Level’s objective: have a constructive, final conversation with senior leadership to explore the role and your future at HTB.
  • Level 6 — You've officially received an offer from HTB! To complete the last level and the Quest, all you need to do is accept the offer.
  • Quest complete. Congratulations, you’re officially one of us 🥳🎉🎇Your next quest: complete the onboarding.

Hack Your Career, Today. Join us in this epic adventure of cybersecurity at Hack The Box! 🚀🔒💻

At Hack The Box, we are on a quest to find the most exceptional and enthusiastic talent to join our team. Whether or not you consider yourself a gamer, we value what makes you unique and want to know more about you. This job post provides just a glimpse of the incredible gamified experience our business and consumer customers enjoy through our platforms. So, if you're ready to embark on a journey of disruption, growth, and adventure, we can't wait to meet you!

ABOUT HACK THE BOX

Hack The Box is the leading cyber readiness platform for the agentic era, battle-testing and upskilling both humans and AI agents to enhance organizational cyber resilience. Trusted by the Fortune 500, government agencies, and MSSPs, the platform delivers threat-informed learning paths consisting of real-world scenarios in gamified labs and live-fire simulations that build and validate offensive and defensive cyber capabilities. With a loyal community of more than 4 million members and 800+ enterprise customers, Hack The Box empowers teams and intelligent systems alike to strengthen cyber defenses and reduce breach risk effectively.

Rapidly growing its international footprint and reach, Hack The Box is headquartered in the UK, with additional offices in the US, Australia, and Greece.

🚨 News & Resources:

  • We’re incredibly proud to share that our headquarters in the UK, along with our entities in Greece and the US, have been certified as a Great Place to Work for 4 consecutive years (2023 - 2026).
  • In addition, our Greek entity has been recognized among the Best Workplaces in Greece (4th, 2nd, 3rd, 1st) and Europe (7th, 10th, 73rd) during this period — a testament to our strong culture and commitment to creating an exceptional employee experience!

Take a sneak peek at how it is to be part of HTB. Get more insights about our HTB culture and employee experience by visiting the “about us” section of our site, our career site, and Glassdoor.

At Hack The Box, we are committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive, and equitable workplace. We believe that diversity enriches our performance, services, and the communities we serve. As such, we ensure that all job applications are considered solely based on merit, skills, and qualifications. We do not discriminate on grounds of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status. We are dedicated to providing a fair and respectful work environment that reflects our values.

raw.title: Senior Software Engineer, Firefox Security
raw.excerpt: Why Mozilla? Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years.
raw.description:
Why Mozilla?

Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy-minded web browser. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we’re shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. Our work focuses on diverse areas including AI, social media, security and more. And we’re doing this while never losing our focus on our core mission – to make the internet better for people.

The Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the non-profit 501(c) Mozilla Foundation. This means we aren’t beholden to any shareholders — only to our mission. Along with thousands of volunteer contributors and collaborators all over the world, Mozillians design, build and distribute open-source software that enables people to enjoy the internet on their terms.

What you’ll do:
  • Design, build and implement security and hardening features for enterprise users: Design, implement, test, and ship cutting-edge security features that strengthen Firefox’s security posture.
  • Advance Firefox’s security architecture across multiple operating systems: Contribute to and drive cutting-edge improvements to Firefox’s core security posture, by building privilege isolation and moving trust boundaries or Strengthen Firefox’s security architecture: Improve Firefox’s core security mechanisms including cryptographic protocols, WebPKI, and security-sensitive web APIs.
  • Contribute to our security initiatives: Work across teams to investigate security issues, identify root causes, and deliver robust, maintainable fixes.
  • Improve browser reliability and performance: Diagnose and resolve issues affecting stability, correctness, performance, and memory usage in a complex, multithreaded environment.

What you’ll bring:

  • Systems programming experience and security knowledge: 3+ years of experience in low-level software engineering, strong proficiency in C and/or C++, and a solid understanding of security fundamentals.
  • Debugging and problem-solving skills: Experience diagnosing and resolving issues in multithreaded, cross-platform native applications, including memory and performance challenges.
  • Web platform and modern systems experience: Familiarity with web technologies (HTML, CSS, JavaScript) and interest or experience in Rust; ability to work effectively within large, complex, multi-language codebases.
  • Effective collaboration and communication: Experience working with distributed teams and communicating technical ideas clearly in writing and conversation.

What you’ll get:

  • Generous performance-based bonus plans to all eligible employees - we share in our success as one team
  • Generous retirement contributions with 100% immediate vesting (regardless of whether you contribute)
  • Quarterly all-company wellness days where everyone takes a pause together
  • Country specific holidays plus a day off for your birthday
  • One-time home office stipend
  • Annual professional development budget
  • Quarterly well-being stipend
  • Considerable paid parental leave
  • Employee referral bonus program
  • Other benefits (life/AD&D, disability, EAP, etc. - varies by country)

About Mozilla

Mozilla exists to build the Internet as a public resource accessible to all because we believe that open and free is better than closed and controlled. raw.description:
Job Title

Senior Director of Operations & Supply Chain (CPG)

Job Description

About the Position |Major goals and objectives and location requirements:

We’re looking for an experienced, hands-on Senior Operations Director to build and lead end-to-end operations for a new CPG beverage brand. You will own the physical life cycle of the product—from commercialization and sourcing through production, inventory, warehousing, shipping, and replenishment. You’ll work closely with Sales, Marketing, Finance, and manufacturing partners to ensure we make the right product, at the right quality and cost, and get it where it needs to go on time. This is a role for a builder and operator—someone who can create scalable systems and partnerships while staying close enough to production and supply chain execution to solve problems quickly.


What You’ll Do

  • Own end-to-end operations from commercialization through production, customer delivery and replenishment.
  • Build the supply chain, vendor network and operating processes required to launch and scale the business.
  • Translate forecasts into production, inventory and supply plans, including co-manufacturer capacity, scheduling and production readiness.
  • Manage sourcing and external partners across ingredients, packaging, co-manufacturers, warehouses, 3PLs and freight.
  • Work closely with the VP/GM on the commercialization of new products and formats across formula, packaging, specifications and production requirements.
  • Partner with quality, regulatory and technical resources on food safety, process authority and compliance.
  • Own inventory, warehousing, fulfillment and transportation across retail, distributor, foodservice and DTC channels.
  • Own key components of COGS and landed cost, while managing operational KPIs across production, inventory, service, freight and cost.

What We’re Looking For

  • 10+ years of operations, supply chain or manufacturing experience, including at least 7 years in beverage.
  • Direct beverage manufacturing experience required, ideally in RTD, non-alcoholic beverages, beer, wine, or spirits utilizing glass and aluminum packaging.
  • Experience managing products from commercialization through production, distribution, and replenishment.
  • Strong experience with co-manufacturers/co-packers, outsourced manufacturing and external supply-chain partners.
  • Deep knowledge of production planning, sourcing, ingredients and packaging, inventory, warehousing and transportation.
  • Strong financial and operational judgment, including COGS, landed cost, budgets, working capital, vendor negotiation and project management.
  • A builder mentality with the ability to move quickly between strategy and hands-on execution in a fast-moving environment where the operating infrastructure is being built rapidly.

Remote

In-office Expectations: This position is fully remote with no in-office requirements, (might require coming into an office 1 or 2x a year)

It is the policy of People Inc. to provide equal employment opportunity (EEO) to all persons regardless of age, color, national origin, citizenship status, physical or mental disability, race, religion, creed, gender, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, genetic information, marital status, status with regard to public assistance, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local law. In addition, the Company will provide reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities. Accommodation requests can be made by .

The Company participates in the federal E-Verify program to confirm the identity and employment authorization of all newly hired employees. For further information about the E-Verify program, please click here:

Pay Range

Salary: North Carolina (Remote): $145,000.00 - $180,000.00

The pay range above represents the anticipated low and high end of the pay range for this position and may change in the future. Actual pay may vary and may be above or below the range based on various factors including but not limited to work location, experience, and performance. The range listed is just one component of People Inc's total compensation package for employees. Other compensation may include annual bonuses, and short- and long-term incentives.In addition, People Inc. provides to employees (and their eligible family members) a variety of benefits, including medical, dental, vision, prescription drug coverage, unlimited paid time off (PTO), adoption or surrogate assistance, donation matching, tuition reimbursement, basic life insurance, basic accidental death & dismemberment, supplemental life insurance, supplemental accident insurance, commuter benefits, short term and long term disability, health savings and flexible spending accounts, family care benefits, a generous 401K savings plan with a company match program, 10-12 paid holidays annually, and generous paid parental leave (birthing and non-birthing parents), all of which may vary depending on the specific nature of your employment with People Inc. and your work location. We also offer voluntary benefits such as pet insurance, accident, critical and hospital indemnity health insurance coverage, life and disability insurance.

raw.description:
About Nerdio

At Nerdio, our mission is to simplify the lives of IT professionals and maximize their Microsoft cloud and end user computing investments.

We support organizations of all sizes looking to deploy, manage, and cost-optimize native Microsoft technologies. We partner with Enterprises and Managed Service Providers all over the world to add value on top of their existing native Microsoft investments like Azure Virtual Desktop (AVD), Windows 365, and Microsoft Intune.

Created in 2016, Nerdio has always taken a market-leading and collaborative approach to cloud deployment and management. In fact, our product roadmap is greatly influenced by the regular feedback we receive from having seen companies deploy AVD into production environments several thousand times using Nerdio technology.

Today, Nerdio is used in over 50 countries by more than 15,000 organizations of every size and vertical. We’re committed to delivering exceptional service and support, which starts with identifying and supporting the best staff possible.

We are a fast-moving, nimble company looking for individuals who are collaborative, empathetic, driven and who love to move at the speed of light. If you want to be part of the AVD transformation that Microsoft and Nerdio are leading, then we want to speak with you.

About the role

As a Senior Recruiter at Nerdio, you will be a strategic talent partner to leaders across EMEA and APAC, helping us hire the people who will drive our next phase of growth. Working 100% remotely from the UK as part of our global Talent Acquisition team, you will own full life cycle recruiting for every line of business in the region, from senior leadership, sales and sales engineering to product, technical support, marketing and beyond.

You will build trusted relationships with hiring managers and key stakeholders, act as their go-to advisor on talent strategy and local market dynamics, and build proactive talent pipelines so we are ready for the roles of tomorrow, not just the roles open today. This is a full-time role for an experienced recruiter who thrives in fast-paced tech environments, brings excellent sourcing skills and strong communication, and enjoys working across cultures and time zones. You will represent the Nerdio brand, culture and values throughout the hiring process.

What you’ll do

  • Own full life cycle recruiting across EMEA and APAC for all lines of business, including leadership, sales, sales engineering, product, technical support, marketing and other functions, from intake through to offer and onboarding handover.
  • Act as a strategic Talent Acquisition advisor to hiring managers and senior leaders: shape hiring plans, define role requirements, and advise on market insights, compensation benchmarks, recruiting best practices and realistic timelines.
  • Build a deep understanding of the EMEA and APAC talent markets, including talent supply, salary expectations, local hiring practices and language needs, and turn that insight into tailored, country-specific search strategies.
  • Build and nurture proactive talent pipelines for current and future roles, engaging passive candidates, talent communities, networks and referrals well ahead of demand.
  • Lead creative, high-quality sourcing using LinkedIn Recruiter, advanced Boolean and market mapping, direct outreach, events, communities and referral programs.
  • Screen candidates for skills, experience and alignment with Nerdio’s culture and mission, and partner with hiring teams to run structured, consistent and inclusive interview processes.
  • Coordinate interviews, gather and share feedback, and guide hiring teams through evaluation and decision-making.
  • Deliver an outstanding candidate experience from first outreach to offer and beyond, and manage offers and negotiations in partnership with the People team, in line with local requirements.
  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date candidate records in the ATS, and share pipeline health, funnel metrics and hiring progress with stakeholders.
  • Continuously improve our recruiting processes, tools and documentation, share best practices, and collaborate with Talent Acquisition and People colleagues across regions, including the US.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in human resources, business administration or a related field is preferred.
  • 7+ years of full life cycle recruiting experience, including at least 3 years in-house in a tech or SaaS environment.
  • Proven experience recruiting across multiple functions, including go-to-market (sales, sales engineering, marketing), technical support and product. Experience hiring senior leaders is a strong plus.
  • Demonstrated success recruiting across EMEA and/or APAC, with a solid understanding of regional talent markets, hiring practices and cultural differences.
  • Excellent sourcing skills and a track record of building proactive talent pipelines for hard-to-fill and passive talent.
  • Ability to build strong relationships with hiring managers and senior stakeholders and to act as a trusted, strategic Talent Acquisition advisor.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence and manage expectations across cultures and time zones.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple searches at once and handle confidential information with discretion.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite and HR software (e.g. HRIS, ATS)
  • (Plus) Experience recruiting for roles related to:
    • Cloud computing / Azure / Microsoft ecosystem
    • Sales engineering or technical support
    • Go-to-market teams in SaaS
  • (Plus) Fluency in an additional EMEA or APAC language.
  • Adaptability, a proactive attitude and strong problem-solving skills in a fast-paced environment.
  • Based in the UK with the right to work in the UK, and flexibility to work across time zones to support colleagues in EMEA, APAC and the US.

Benefits and Incentives

  • Competitive Base + Incentive Plan
  • Stock Options
  • Health and Welfare Plans*
  • Life and Disability Plans*
  • Retirement Plan*
  • Unlimited Flexible Paid Time Off
  • Collaborative Team Culture

* Benefits for international employees, outside the US, vary by country.

Nerdio is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace. Nerdio is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or other legally protected status.

raw.description:
1099 Contractor Opportunity

Cybersecurity Internal Auditor (ISO 27001, ISO 27701, ISO 42001)

Position Overview

We are seeking an experienced Cybersecurity Internal Audit Consultant (1099 Contractor) to perform independent internal audits of information security, privacy, and AI management systems. The consultant will be responsible for assessing organizational compliance against multiple management system standards, identifying gaps, evaluating control effectiveness, and providing actionable recommendations to support certification readiness and continual improvement.

This role is ideal for an experienced auditor who has performed internal audits for organizations pursuing or maintaining certifications such as ISO 27001, ISO 27701, ISO 42001, and related cybersecurity and compliance frameworks.

Engagement Type

  • Independent Contractor (1099)
  • Remote with occasional virtual meetings
  • Project-based with opportunity for recurring engagements
  • Flexible scheduling based on audit plans and certification timelines

Key Responsibilities

  • Plan and execute internal audits against:
    • ISO/IEC 27001 Information Security Management Systems (ISMS)
    • ISO/IEC 27701 Privacy Information Management Systems (PIMS)
    • ISO/IEC 42001 Artificial Intelligence Management Systems (AIMS)
    • Additional standards and frameworks as applicable
  • Review policies, procedures, standards, risk assessments, and supporting documentation.
  • Assess operational effectiveness of security, privacy, and AI governance controls.
  • Conduct interviews with stakeholders, control owners, and process owners.
  • Validate evidence supporting compliance requirements.
  • Identify nonconformities, observations, and opportunities for improvement.
  • Develop detailed audit reports, findings, and corrective action recommendations.
  • Present audit results to leadership and management teams.
  • Assist with remediation validation and follow-up assessments.
  • Provide guidance on audit preparedness and continual improvement activities.

Required Qualifications

  • ISO 27001 Lead Auditor certification.
  • ISO 27701 auditing experience.
  • ISO 42001 auditing experience.
  • Experience conducting cybersecurity, privacy, risk, or compliance audits.
  • Demonstrated experience auditing against ISO management system standards.
  • Strong understanding of:
    • Information Security Governance
    • Risk Management
    • Access Control
    • Incident Response
    • Vendor Risk Management
    • Privacy Programs
    • AI Governance and Risk Management
  • Experience interviewing stakeholders and evaluating control effectiveness.
  • Excellent report writing, communication, and presentation skills.
  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple audit engagements.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Certified Information Systems Auditor (CISA).
  • Certified Information Security Manager (CISM).
  • Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP).
  • Certified Internal Auditor (CIA).
  • Experience supporting accredited certification audits.

About DigniFi:
DigniFi’s Point-of-Sale financing solution helps 2,000+ partners increase revenue, drive accessory orders, and decrease deferred repairs. We partner with dealerships and service centers to offer financing products at the point of sale for auto repairs, service, parts, accessories, maintenance packages, and more.

As DigniFi continues to grow, our success depends on deep integrations with the software platforms dealerships already use every day. This role sits at the center of that strategy.
Our mission is to help auto dealers and service centers grow by offering their customers innovative, inclusive financing. Our vision is to make financing for the needs of daily life accessible and inclusive.

About The Role:
We are seeking a strategic, results-driven Chief Financial Officer to lead DigniFi’s financial strategy and support our continued growth. This executive will oversee financial planning and reporting, capital markets, fundraising, and securitization while building strong relationships with investors, lenders, and financing partners. The CFO will partner closely with the CEO and cross-functional leaders to drive product profitability, optimize risk-adjusted returns, guide capital allocation, and identify new opportunities for expansion. The ideal candidate brings significant executive finance experience, a proven track record of raising capital, and the ability to translate financial insights into strategic decisions that support sustainable, profitable growth.

What You Will Do:
  • Lead preparation of all financial statements, including income statements, balance sheets, shareholder reports, tax returns and governmental agency reports. 
  • Compare sales and profit projections to actual figures and budgeted expenses to actual expenses; oversee any necessary adjustments to future projections and budgets. 
  • Establish and lead a comprehensive unit economics and product profitability framework that drives profitable growth, optimizes risk-adjusted returns, and informs strategic capital allocation across the consumer finance portfolio. 
  • Work with the CEO and other executives to coordinate planning and establish priorities for the budget and fund-raising process. 
  • Study long-range economic trends and project their impact on future growth in sales and market share.  
  • Identify opportunities for expansion into new product areas.  
  • Drive the process of capital markets fundraising, building upon equity capital required for expansion. 
  • Understand and implement credit reserves methodology, including CECL.
  • Capital Markets oversight and the execution of securitization funding.
  • Partner with Product, Risk, and Commercial teams to establish pricing, fees, promotional structures, merchant discount rates, and customer incentives that meet targeted risk-adjusted return thresholds.

Who You Are:
  • 10+ years of experience in accounting and finance, including significant financial leadership experience.
  • Extensive experience in executive leadership roles, ideally within a growing or scaling company.
  • Demonstrated experience raising capital, securing funding, and managing relationships with investors, lenders, and other financing partners.
  • Strong strategic thinking and decision-making abilities, with the ability to align financial strategy with business objectives.
  • Proven track record of driving business growth, improving financial performance, and delivering results.
  • Strong financial acumen, including financial planning and analysis, cash flow management, forecasting, budgeting, and capital allocation.
  • Excellent communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills, including the ability to communicate financial strategy and company performance to executives, investors, and the Board of Directors.
  • Exceptional leadership and team-building capabilities, with experience developing and leading high-performing finance teams.

Why You’ll Love Working at DigniFi:
  • High-growth opportunity with terrific upside potential.
  • Founded to provide aid to people when they unexpectedly need help...responsible, respectful, and transparent access to a better financial future for our customers.
  • Excellence-driven organization that values work/life balance.
  • We’re a tight-knit team that values collaboration and genuinely loves working together.
  • Ultimate workplace flexibility.

What’s In It for You:
  • Flexible PTO
  • 12 Paid Holidays
  • Up to 80% Employer-Paid Premiums for Medical, Dental and Vision Insurance
  • Long-term Disability Insurance
  • Basic Life Insurance
  • Paid Parental Leave
  • Matching 401k
  • 100% Remote Work

Where You Will Work:
This position is remote.

Above and beyond discrimination and harassment based on “protected categories,” we also strive to prevent other subtler forms of inappropriate behavior (i.e., stereotyping) from ever gaining a foothold in our company.
