raw.description:
Fourth is the world’s largest and fastest-growing global leader of end-to-end restaurant and hospitality management technology solutions. We pride ourselves on delivering a world-class SaaS experience for our clients by building long-term partnerships starting from the first phone call. We know our recipe for success at Fourth is our amazing team... and that starts with hiring the right people!

Interested in joining our smart, fun, and talented team?

Position Overview

  • HotSchedules is the restaurant industry’s most widely used scheduling platform. Over 300,000 restaurants across North America trust HotSchedules. The SMB team is at the top of our growth funnel—introducing restaurant operators to HotSchedules.

  • As the dedicated demand gen marketer for SMB, you’ll own the pipeline programs that fuel bookings for two high-performing sales teams. Running both inbound programs and outbound sales-led campaigns to hit quarterly bookings targets.

  • Some of this GTM motion exists and needs refinement. Some of it you’ll create from scratch. You'll pull in Product Marketing, Sales, and RevOps when you need them — but you won't wait for alignment to move. You drive the work and bring people along.

  • The challenge in marketing today, the channels are crowded. The job is to find where there’s still signal, test aggressively, and scale what works. Plus, cutting what doesn’t work before it becomes a habit. That means bringing new ideas, tinkering with tools, and being willing to experiment your way to an answer. It also means knowing your customer deeply enough that your messaging cuts through. Understanding what operators care about, where they spend their time, and what makes them stop and listen.

Primary Responsibilities

Own pipeline:

  • Drive inbound and outbound demand programs end-to-end — strategy, execution, iteration — with a clear line to SAO targets each quarter. Pipeline and bookings are how we keep score.

Embed with sales:

  • Standups, call shadows, deal reviews. Short deal cycles mean fast feedback loops — you’ll know quickly what’s working and can act on it fast.

Build campaigns that earn attention:

  • Develop integrated, multi-touch programs across email, paid, content, and outbound that speak to operators’ reality.

Know your buyer:

  • Learn from regular operator interviews and sales calls to craft messaging, creative, and campaign strategy that works.

Build and evolve the stack:

  • Identify gaps, propose solutions, implement what works. You don’t wait for a better workflow — you build it.

Use AI to scale yourself:

  • Tools, workflows, agents. Use technology extends your capabilities and gain leverage.

Close the loop:

  • Partner with RevOps on scoring, routing, response times, and reporting.

Key Skills and Competencies

  • 5–7 years in B2B demand generation, ideally SaaS, with a track record of owning a pipeline number.

  • Fluent across channels: email, paid, content, events, outbound. Good enough at all of them to know which one to reach for and to connect them into programs that convert.

  • A strong writer who can speak to a small business owner’s daily reality.

  • Someone who embeds with sales rather than operating at arm’s length. Low ego, high output.

  • A tinkerer. You’ve built workflows, tested tools, played with agents — and you have real examples to show for it.

  • Comfortable being accountable. You track pipeline/ SAO targets like it's your own money. When the pipeline is short, you figure out why and fix it.

  • You've pulled your own pipeline and conversion data, found the problem before someone told you about it, and changed your program because of what you saw.

  • You've killed your own programs when the data said so — even ones you built and liked.

  • A curious, life-long learner

Why This Role

  • Restaurant operators run some of the hardest businesses in the world. When HotSchedules works, it makes their lives meaningfully easier. This role puts you at the front of that pipeline—it's how you get there, but the operator on the other end is why it matters.

Fourth Benefits

🏖 Unlimited PTO!

🏥 Medical, Dental, Vision Insurance!

🏦 401k Match!

👥 Parental Leave

💻 Laptop and equipment.

Remote employment limited to: AZ, CA, CO, CT, DC, FL, GA, ID, IL, IN, LA, MA, MD, ME, MI, MN, MS, NC, NE, NJ, NM, NV, NY, OH, OK, OR, PA, SC, TN, TX, UT, VA, & WA


Our Story

In July 2019, Fourth joined forces with HotSchedules to become the global leader in end-to-end restaurant and hospitality management technology solutions. Together, the merged company now represents the world’s largest and only provider of end-to-end restaurant and hospitality management solutions for customers across the globe and of all sizes—from a single location or franchisee restaurant to a global restaurant or hotel chain. The combined company’s complete software-as-service (SaaS) solution suite, including scheduling, time & attendance, applicant tracking, training, inventory management/procurement, HR/benefits, and payroll services, now serves customers in 120,000 locations worldwide and is supported by a dedicated, unified team across offices in the US, UK, Bulgaria, China, Australia, and UAE.

Fourth is an Equal Opportunity Employer

All qualified applicants will receive consideration without discrimination because of sex, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, marital status, race, color, age, national origin, military status, religion, or disability or any other legally protected status.

Bold es una fintech que provee una solución de pagos a los microempresarios para recibir pagos con tarjetas débito, crédito y billeteras a través de datáfonos y links de pago. Sin embargo, la visión de Bold es más ambiciosa que ser una empresa de pagos y estamos trabajando para volvernos una plataforma de servicios financieros y tecnológicos para las pequeñas empresas en el país complementando las soluciones de pagos y banca con otros productos de software conexos a toda nuestra propuesta de valor. En Bold creemos firmemente que podemos ayudar a los pequeños emprendedores a desarrollar sus negocios ofreciendo servicios financieros y tecnológicos hechos a su medida, que sean amigables y cercanos. En Bold definimos los siguientes valores como los pilares de nuestra cultura organizacional: Maestría, Pensamiento crítico, Trabajo en equipo, Sentido de urgencia, Somos abiertos y el cliente el centro de lo que hacemos. raw.title: Product Enablement Lead
raw.excerpt: Member Access Processing (MAP) is a trusted leader in payment processing solutions.
raw.description:
Member Access Processing (MAP) is a trusted leader in payment processing solutions. We provide secure, efficient, and tailored services to financial institutions and businesses, enabling seamless transactions for their customers. With a focus on innovation, reliability, and customer satisfaction, MAP is committed to delivering cutting-edge technology and exceptional service in the ever-evolving world of payments. We pride ourselves on creating a positive, collaborative work environment where our employees can grow and make a meaningful impact.

Overview

The Product Enablement Lead is responsible for designing, developing, maintaining, and delivering product learning experiences that help credit unions and MAP employees confidently adopt, use, and optimize MAP products and supporting Visa DPS platforms. This role owns the product enablement content lifecycle, from evaluating the learning impact of new products and enhancements through curriculum development, delivery, measurement, and ongoing content maintenance.

The ideal candidate combines practical credit and debit card processing experience with knowledge of fraud and dispute operations, credit union core environments, instructional design, and adult learning. The role translates complex product and operational information into clear, practical, hands-on learning experiences that support client readiness, product adoption, operational consistency, and a strong client experience.

This role helps shift MAP’s learning model from presentation-based training to experiential enablement focused on system proficiency, workflow execution, troubleshooting, decision-making, and operational readiness. Success is measured not only by training delivery, but by whether learners can confidently perform the work, navigate applicable systems, troubleshoot common scenarios, and apply their knowledge after training.

Role and Responsibilities

Product & Systems Expertise

  • Maintain current, working knowledge of MAP products and services, including MAP Defense, MAP Data, card processing solutions, Visa DPS systems, and related operational tools.
  • Monitor the Visa DPS product roadmap, release communications, product enhancements, and changes to existing products to determine training and enablement impacts.
  • Partner with internal subject matter experts and Visa DPS resources to validate product information, workflows, dependencies, and client-facing guidance before training content is released.
  • Understand how MAP and Visa DPS products interact with credit union core systems and processing environments and translate those differences into practical training guidance.
  • Conduct ongoing research across MAP, Visa, and Visa DPS documentation to keep learning materials accurate, relevant, and current.
  • Maintain practical knowledge of end-to-end credit and debit card processing, including authorization, clearing and settlement, transaction lifecycle, disputes, fraud, card servicing, transaction controls, and common exception scenarios.
  • Develop working proficiency within relevant processor tools and environments sufficient to demonstrate workflows, recreate common scenarios, and guide learners through system-based exercises.
  • Understand the relationship between issuer configuration, processor functionality, network requirements, core systems, and downstream operational impacts.
  • Maintain knowledge of common payment terminology, transaction flows, response codes, authorization behavior, and processing concepts necessary to effectively train and support MAP employees and clients.
  • Partner with operational subject matter experts to understand recurring support issues and incorporate those scenarios into training and reinforcement materials.

Curriculum & Content Development

  • Develop role-based learning paths, instructor-led programs, virtual learning, tutorials, workflow guides, playbooks, job aids, knowledge articles, videos, assessments, and Membership.io learning hub content.
  • Create complete product enablement packages for new product launches and material enhancements, including facilitator guides, participant materials, demonstrations, exercises, practice scenarios, knowledge checks, and post-training resources.
  • Establish and maintain a curriculum roadmap that aligns planned training development with the Visa DPS roadmap, MAP product priorities, release timing, client readiness needs, and required content refresh cycles.
  • Customize training content to reflect different client processing environments, core-system considerations, operational workflows, user roles, and levels of product maturity.
  • Develop hands-on exercises, case studies, simulations, and realistic scenarios that reinforce product functionality, operational best practices, troubleshooting, product value, and client adoption.
  • Maintain version control, content ownership, review dates, approval status, and change history for training materials to ensure learners receive the most current guidance.
  • Transition training from primarily presentation-based delivery to active learning that uses demonstrations, guided practice, workflows, playbooks, and performance-support tools.
  • Design training around learn, demonstrate, practice, and validate principles so learners apply concepts through realistic system and operational scenarios.
  • Build scenario-based labs that require learners to investigate transactions, navigate systems, interpret results, resolve common problems, and explain recommended next steps.
  • Develop progressive learning paths that build from foundational payment concepts to product proficiency, troubleshooting, and advanced operational knowledge.
  • Incorporate real-world support scenarios, implementation lessons learned, recurring client questions, and production issues into curriculum development.
  • Create reusable sandbox, simulation, or guided-practice exercises where appropriate so learners can safely practice workflows before performing them independently.
  • Design training that connects system functionality to the business reason behind the process, helping learners understand both how and why.

Training Delivery & Facilitation

  • Deliver engaging product training for new and established clients across MAP products, card processing capabilities, fraud and dispute solutions, and supporting Visa DPS platforms.
  • Lead training activities throughout the client lifecycle, including discovery and scoping, pre-training preparation, onboarding, go-live readiness, reinforcement, and follow-up learning.
  • Facilitate new-hire and ongoing product education for MAP employees, with emphasis on systems, workflows, client use cases, and operational responsibilities.
  • Use clear storytelling, product demonstrations, guided practice, and real-world scenarios to make complex technical and operational concepts easy to understand and apply.
  • Adapt delivery methods based on audience knowledge, role, learning needs, processing environment, and business objectives.
  • Facilitate hands-on labs, guided system exercises, troubleshooting workshops, and workflow-based practice sessions for internal and external learners.
  • Coach learners through real-world processing scenarios rather than simply providing answers, reinforcing critical thinking and independent problem solving.
  • Assess learner proficiency through practical demonstration of skills in addition to traditional knowledge checks.
  • Adjust the depth of training based on the audience’s processing experience, job responsibilities, operating model, and level of system access.
  • Reinforce learning after formal training through office hours, practice sessions, knowledge refreshers, targeted coaching, and performance-support resources.

Internal Knowledge Enablement

  • Partner with Client Services, Training, Implementation, Product, Operations, and other subject matter experts to identify internal knowledge gaps and prioritize enablement needs.
  • Strengthen internal subject-matter expertise by developing structured learning paths for foundational, intermediate, and advanced product and processing knowledge.
  • Create ongoing knowledge-development opportunities that extend beyond new-hire onboarding, including scenario workshops, product deep dives, troubleshooting sessions, and release education.
  • Capture tribal knowledge and subject matter expertise and convert it into repeatable learning resources, playbooks, troubleshooting guides, and practical exercises.
  • Help establish consistent baseline knowledge expectations by role and identify mechanisms for validating proficiency over time.

  • Measure learner readiness through demonstrated proficiency, scenario completion, workflow execution, and the ability to independently apply learned concepts.

  • Use post-training feedback from clients, Client Services, Implementation, and operational teams to continually improve learning experiences.

Qualifications & Experience

Preferred Qualifications

AI Infrastructure Engineer – Remote

Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States.
This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

Job Title: AI Infrastructure Engineer
Location: 100% Remote (U.S.)
Position Type: Full-time, Direct W2
Salary Range: $100,000–$160,000 Annually
Experience Required: 10+ years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary:
We are seeking an AI Infrastructure Engineer to design, build, and operate the platform layer that powers large-scale AI training and inference workloads. The role focuses on GPU clusters, distributed training frameworks, scheduling, storage performance, and developer experience for ML engineers and researchers, with strong emphasis on reliability, efficiency, and cost control. The ideal candidate has built or operated production AI infrastructure at scale, understands the interaction between hardware, kernel, scheduler, and ML framework, and brings strong software engineering discipline to platform work.

Key Responsibilities
  • Design and operate GPU and accelerator infrastructure for training and inference, spanning on-prem clusters, cloud-managed services, and hybrid configurations.
  • Build scheduling, queueing, and resource-sharing systems that maximize accelerator utilization across many teams.
  • Integrate frameworks such as PyTorch, JAX, DeepSpeed, FSDP, Megatron-LM, and Ray Train into a unified platform offering.
  • Operate high-performance storage systems and data pipelines that keep accelerators fed with training data at near-line-rate.
  • Design networking architectures supporting RDMA, InfiniBand, NCCL, and high-bandwidth collective communication.
  • Build observability for AI workloads including utilization, throughput, training stability, and failure-mode analytics.
  • Implement checkpointing, restart, and fault-tolerance patterns for long-running training jobs at scale.
  • Drive cost optimization across compute, storage, and networking through scheduling, spot capacity, and right-sizing.
  • Develop developer tooling and paved-road workflows that let researchers launch experiments safely and efficiently.
  • Partner with research and applied ML teams to plan capacity for upcoming training runs.
  • Implement security controls, isolation, and access management for multi-tenant AI infrastructure.
  • Drive automation across cluster provisioning, lifecycle management, and configuration enforcement.
  • Maintain runbooks, capacity dashboards, and operational documentation for the AI platform.
  • Stay current with AI infrastructure research, accelerator hardware, and emerging open-source AI tooling.
Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science or a related field.
  • Ten or more years of experience in infrastructure, platform, or HPC engineering.
  • Hands-on experience operating GPU clusters or large-scale ML training infrastructure.
  • Strong proficiency in Python and at least one systems language such as Go or C++.
  • Deep understanding of distributed training, accelerator architectures, and collective communication.
  • Experience with Kubernetes, Slurm, Ray, or similar scheduling systems for ML workloads.
  • Strong understanding of Linux internals, networking, and high-performance storage.
  • Experience with at least one major cloud provider’s ML infrastructure offerings.
  • Strong software engineering practices including testing, CI/CD, and code review.
  • Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience operating InfiniBand or RDMA networking at scale.
  • Contributions to open-source ML infrastructure projects.
  • Familiarity with custom orchestrators or research-grade training stacks.
  • Exposure to frontier model training operations.
  • Experience with FinOps for AI workloads.

raw.description:
Principal AI Strategists on the PACE team guide customers through their AI transformation by leading business alignment, strategic advisory, and value realization for ServiceNow's AI platform. That platform includes Now Assist, AI Agents, Autonomous Workforce AI specialists, and ServiceNow Otto, the unified AI experience that brings conversational AI, enterprise search, voice, and data exploration into one governed front door.

You will operate independently as the lead strategist on customer engagements. You will drive AI roadmapping, governance advisory, and organizational change management planning so that customers move beyond pilots to sustained, expanding consumption and measurable business outcomes. As customers shift from AI that assists to AI that completes work across systems, you will help executives decide where autonomous execution fits, how to govern it with AI Control Tower, and how to measure what it delivers.

You will partner closely with AI Architects in the PACE pairing model. Strategists own the business strategy workstream ("the why and what"). Architects own technical architecture and implementation ("the how"). Together you deliver integrated service offerings that drive measurable customer outcomes. You will also build trusted relationships with CIOs, department heads, and executive sponsors, and scale your expertise through reusable assets, enablement, and thought leadership.

Responsibilities

  • Operate independently as the lead AI strategist on customer engagements, driving business alignment and value conversations
  • Develop AI roadmaps that move customers from first activation to scaled adoption across Now Assist, AI Agents, AI specialists, and the Otto experience as it rolls out, sequencing quick wins against longer-term transformation milestones
  • Lead AI value discovery and realization conversations, translating usage and adoption data into executive-ready business outcomes and building the case for continued AI investment
  • Build AI business cases and adoption roadmaps with the account team, monitor consumption, and intervene proactively when adoption stalls
  • Advise customers on the Assist consumption model, including how agentic and headless activity affects forecasting and expansion planning
  • Provide AI governance advisory (responsible AI policy frameworks, data classification guidance, executive steering committee charters), including how to govern agents and external AI integrations through AI Control Tower and AI Gateway, aligned to regulatory, privacy, and compliance requirements
  • Lead organizational change management planning for AI initiatives, including stakeholder impact assessments, adoption communications, and role-based training, with attention to how roles change as AI agents take on end-to-end work
  • Partner with AI Architects to shape the joint solution approach, with strategists leading business alignment and architects leading technical implementation
  • Build trusted relationships with senior business executives and own executive stakeholder alignment on AI strategy
  • Support sales activity proactively, including contributing to presales strategy documents and driving Expert Services leads for AI strategy engagements. PACE is a post-sale organization, so this role influences sales rather than owning it
  • Contribute to thought leadership, white papers, knowledge base articles, and strategic advisory frameworks that scale AI strategy expertise
  • Develop and refine techniques, including ROI models, business case frameworks, and outcome dashboards, that demonstrate AI value to business stakeholders
  • Contribute to reusable digital assets, playbooks, and enablement tools for internal teams, partners, and customers

Required

  • 5+ years as a consultant or advisor in software or technology industries
  • 5+ years of experience on the ServiceNow platform, with working knowledge of ServiceNow's AI capabilities (Now Assist, AI Agents, and related offerings)
  • 3+ years of hands-on experience with multiple AI tools and large language models, including evaluating where they create, or fail to create, business value
  • Demonstrated ability to lead executive-level conversations and build business cases, roadmaps, and value realization frameworks for technology adoption
  • Experience advising on AI governance, change management, or adoption in complex enterprises

  • Comfort working at production speed in a high-volume, structured environment while staying accurate
  • A builder’s mindset: when something is slow or repetitive, you build a fix instead of working around it

Strongly Preferred

  • Experience building or optimizing ChatGPT Ads or other emerging ad platforms

Requirements

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or a related field
  • 2+ years of experience in paid digital advertising, campaign execution, or digital marketing support
  • Experience building, launching, and optimizing lead-generation paid ad campaigns

ReminderMedia is a leading marketing services provider that has helped over 100K small businesses grow their client base through a powerful suite of digital and direct-mail marketing tools. raw.title: Team Lead, Senior Instructional Designer
raw.excerpt: Who we areSamsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations.
raw.description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

Samsara’s Customer Education is looking for a creative Senior Instructional Designer. You’ll be part of an energetic team that will play a key role in Samsara’s growth and our customers’ long-term success. Opportunities and challenges include developing learning strategies to support our key customer personas and industries, innovating in AI-driven instructional development, contributing new ways for us to scale our process and our reach, and being a thought leader across Samsara. Learn more below!

This is a remote position open to candidates residing in the US except the San Francisco Bay Metro Area, NYC Metro Area, and Washington, D.C. Metro Area.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: The training you build helps customers use Samsara to keep drivers safe, get goods delivered on time, and keep critical operations running. When your content works, customers adopt faster, see value sooner, and keep their people safer on the road and on the job.
  • You thrive on turning complexity into clarity: Our product is expanding quickly, and our customers range from fleet managers to frontline drivers to executives. You’ll take technical, fast-changing features and turn them into learning experiences that are clear, engaging, and effective for each audience.
  • You’re a natural collaborator: You’ll partner with Customer Success, Product, Sales, and Implementation teams to understand what customers struggle with and build content that closes the gap. You’ll also work closely with a program manager who prioritizes the team’s quarterly roadmap, and you’re comfortable juggling multiple projects at once.
  • You’re excited about how learning is built now: You like to experiment with new tools, AI-assisted authoring, and faster development models, and you’re energized by iterating quickly rather than perfecting slowly. You’ll help shape how our team scales content across on-demand courses, video, in-app learning, live sessions, and certifications.
  • You are the architect of your own career: Our Customer Education team is still shaping its future, so you’ll have real autonomy and ownership. You’ll own the learning journey for a product area, starting with Safety, and can grow as the team and product portfolio grow.

In this role, you will:

  • Work with stakeholders across the company to define training requirements, learning goals and user needs for both customers and partners
  • Craft and build learning & credentialing experiences in different formats (online learning, audio, video, in-app, etc.), working within the constraints of different templates and business requirements
  • Leverage a wide range of tools (AI-based content authoring, multimedia) to develop content rapidly and iteratively
  • Push yourself and the team to evolve and improve upon our processes, and to discover and test new instructional development models and tooling
  • Solicit reviews from partners and SMEs, and review others’ content and assessments for effectiveness
  • Own an assigned Samsara product area, by monitoring updates, maintaining its curriculum, and partnering with leadership on incoming requests
  • Build product expertise through self-directed research, available AI tools, and targeted collaboration with SMEs to validate content
  • Design and write engaging and effective assessments
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s values and operating principles as we scale globally and across new offices

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 3-5+ years learning design or instructional design experience in a software/Saas setting
  • Knowledge of Instructional Design standard methodologies and a proven ability to craft learning content that is effective and engaging
  • Ability to communicate abstract or technical information to both technical and non-technical audiences (visually and in writing)
  • Ability to identify the best learning delivery formats (e.g., online learning, assessments, audio-based lessons) for a specific set of objectives
  • Collaboration skills and teamwork
  • Attention to design aesthetics and visual detail.
  • Knowledge of legacy and emerging content development tools such as: , Articulate, Camtasia, Zoom, Clueso etc.

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Comfort working within an AI-driven content development process, including AI-assisted authoring, review, and iteration
  • Experience developing in-app training or contextual product education

The compensation range shown spans approved pay zones for this role. Your primary work location determines the range applicable to you, which may be narrower than the full range displayed.

The range of annual base salary for full-time employees for this position is below. Please note that base pay offered may vary depending on factors including your city of residence, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Learn more about our total rewards and benefits below.

Annual Base Salary
$76,457.50—$115,650 USD

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us-greenhouse-mail.io or @mail3.guide.co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

raw.description:
We are excited to speak to you about this opportunity. If you are interested in joining our growing team, please apply to this link directly.

Who we are

At Aquila, we invest in category-defining B2B/B2G software companies globally, acting as a thought-partner, striving for the success of our companies in the long term. We are a well-managed, profitable company that operates like a startup with the financial backing of a parent company. For our people, this means limitless possibilities.

We are unapologetically unique, pivoting to respond to the needs of the multiple markets we operate in. We have ambitious goals, and we are looking for genuine contributors with integrity, energy, flexibility, and loyalty. We are investing in building future leaders who can take an idea and make things happen.

At Emphasys HFA (Housing Finance Agency), a division of Emphasys, we build and support the only end-to-end financial software in the U.S. dedicated to affordable housing. As the largest full-service provider in this space, we enable State Housing Finance Agencies and other public organizations to administer programs that help families access affordable homeownership or rental housing. Our solutions power the financial backbone that processes funding, manages compliance, and ensures every dollar of support is tracked and maximized.

Who we need

Reporting to the Strategic Account Executive, we are hiring a Business Development Representative to support Emphasys HFA's growth and expand the capacity of our sales function. As our new Business Development Representative, you will combine targeted business development with hands-on support across RFPs, contracts, customer opportunities, and the early stages of the sales process. You will research the HFA market, identify new contacts and opportunities across existing and prospective accounts, coordinate information across Product, Client Services, Marketing, and other teams, and help move opportunities forward. Over time, as you build your knowledge and confidence, you will have the opportunity to take ownership of smaller product sales opportunities from initial conversation through close.

This is a full-time, remote role based in the United States. Eastern or Central Time zones are preferred.

What’s in it for you

Purpose and impact. You will represent technology that supports Housing Finance Agencies and public organizations delivering affordable homeownership and rental housing programs. Your work will help connect these organizations with the software they rely on to manage the financial and operational backbone of their programs, giving you a clear connection between the relationships you build, the solutions you introduce, and the communities those organizations serve.

A foundation for a long-term sales career. You will gain experience well beyond prospecting, working alongside experienced Sales, Marketing, Client Services, and Product teams and gaining exposure to customer relationships, RFPs, contracts, cross-sell opportunities, and the full sales cycle. As you build your knowledge and demonstrate your ability to manage opportunities, you will have the opportunity to take ownership of smaller product sales from start to close and continue expanding your responsibilities. As part of Constellation Software, you will also be joining a broader organization with opportunities to grow your career over time.

Specialized expertise in an evolving technology market. Emphasys has an established presence in a highly specialized market, with relationships across Housing Finance Agencies and multiple solutions that create opportunities to deepen and expand customer partnerships. You will build valuable expertise in affordable housing technology and public-sector sales while working for a business that is becoming increasingly AI-forward, giving you the opportunity to use modern tools in your research and sales work and learn how emerging technology can support customers and shape the market.

How you will make an impact

  • Create new opportunities. You will research the HFA market, identify prospective contacts and untapped opportunities, and use targeted outreach to create meaningful conversations. You will also work with existing customer relationships to identify opportunities to introduce additional Emphasys HFA products to teams and departments that may not currently use them.
  • Move opportunities forward. You will qualify interest, understand customer needs, identify the right stakeholders, and connect opportunities with the Strategic Account Executive when they are ready for deeper sales engagement. You will nurture relationships with longer timelines and continue building knowledge until an opportunity is ready to progress.
  • Coordinate RFP responses. You will help identify relevant RFP opportunities and coordinate the information needed to respond. You will work with Product Managers and other internal teams to gather answers, build response matrices, organize documentation, and keep the process moving through detailed and complex government procurement requirements.
  • Support contracts and customer opportunities. You will help organize contract documentation and follow up on items such as insurance certificates and other required materials. You will support the process without owning pricing or final commercial decisions, ensuring the right information is gathered and the opportunity continues moving toward completion.
  • Take ownership of smaller opportunities. As you build your product knowledge and demonstrate your ability to manage the process, you will have the opportunity to take smaller, lower-value product opportunities from initial conversation through close. This will give you hands-on experience managing the full sales cycle and building confidence as a technology sales professional.
  • Bring market insight back to the team. You will listen carefully to prospects and customers, stay curious about changing HFA needs, and share what you are learning with Sales, Marketing, Product, and Client Services. Your observations will help the team understand where opportunities exist and how Emphasys can better engage the market.
  • Use technology to work smarter. You will use CRM, LinkedIn, sales and research tools, and AI-enabled technology to research accounts, organize information, prepare outreach, and work more efficiently. You will look for practical ways technology can improve your approach to business development.

You bring

  • The sales foundation. You have experience in business development, sales development, lead generation, inside sales, account development, or a related customer-facing role. You may also be earlier in your sales career with other professional experience that demonstrates your interest in building a career in technology sales.
  • The curiosity and critical thinking. You ask thoughtful questions, listen carefully, and genuinely want to understand how a customer operates before deciding how to engage them. You can look at a complex situation, identify what needs to happen next, and work through the steps rather than stopping at the first obstacle.
  • The drive. You are comfortable creating opportunities rather than waiting for them to appear. You can handle unanswered outreach and rejection without losing momentum, while staying persistent, professional, and thoughtful in your follow-up.
  • The organization. You can manage multiple opportunities, follow up with different stakeholders, keep documentation accurate, and stay on top of details. You are comfortable coordinating information across teams and know that moving an opportunity forward often requires persistence and follow-through.
  • The communication and collaboration. You can build rapport with different types of stakeholders and communicate clearly in writing and conversation. You enjoy working with Product, Client Services, Marketing, and Sales rather than operating independently, and you know how to seek out the right person when you need information or support.
  • The technology mindset. You are comfortable learning new technology and interested in using AI and digital tools to improve how you research, communicate, and work. Experience with CRM, LinkedIn, sales engagement platforms, or software sales is an asset.
  • The market knowledge. Experience in housing, affordable housing, Housing Finance Agencies, government, or technology is an asset. We are also open to someone with strong sales potential who wants to develop expertise in this specialized market.

Join us.

As an Aquila company, Emphasys Software brings together bright, talented people who aspire to excellence and share a commitment to upholding our mission: To be a company of outstanding people delivering vertical market software solutions through long-term partnerships with clients.

Our entrepreneurial culture, lean environment, and people come together to form a dynamic organization where purpose drives our growth. With the autonomy to be creative and curious, we collaborate and iterate to achieve real impact in the communities we support.

Apply now.

Diversity and inclusion are not mere words on paper to us. We welcome and appreciate candidates with a range of backgrounds and experiences. If you have 70% of the qualifications we are looking for and want to play an integral role in changing an industry, apply to express your interest.

What you can expect from our interview process:

  • A virtual interview with a Talent Advisor discussing your interest in the role, the team’s culture and your experience. The conversation will be recorded using BrightHire, an AI-powered video interview tool. More details will be shared when you are invited to interview.
  • A virtual interview with the Hiring Manager focused on your sales experience, approach to business development, curiosity, and ability to work through complex opportunities.
  • A final virtual interview with the General Manager, focused on your approach to collaboration, growth, and the opportunity to contribute to the sales function.

Aquila and Emphasys Software promote equal employment opportunities for all. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, disability, national origin, veteran status, marital status or any other basis covered by appropriate law. All employment decisions are made based on qualifications, merit, and business needs. We welcome and encourage applications from people with disabilities and accommodations are available on request.

raw.description:
Workday Technical Consultant - Remote

Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States.
This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

Job Title: Workday Technical Consultant
Location: 100% Remote (U.S.)
Position Type: Full-time, Direct W2
Salary Range: $100,000–$150,000 Annually
Experience Required: 6+ years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary
We are seeking a Workday Technical Consultant with broad expertise across Workday configuration, reporting, calculated fields, business process design, and Workday Extend application development. The role spans technical configuration, custom report design, integration support, and lightweight application extension work, helping HR, finance, and IT stakeholders get more value from the Workday platform. The ideal candidate combines strong Workday platform knowledge with practical engineering discipline and the ability to translate business requirements into clean, maintainable Workday configurations. In this role you will work closely with cross-functional partners — product, design, engineering, operations, and business stakeholders — to translate ambiguous requirements into well-engineered solutions, and will be expected to raise the bar through code review, design review, and mentorship of more junior engineers. The successful candidate brings strong engineering discipline, a clear communication style, and a track record of shipping meaningful work that holds up well in production.

Key Responsibilities
  • Design and develop complex calculated fields, custom reports, and advanced reports using the Workday report writer.
  • Build composite reports, matrix reports, and dashboards supporting business decision-making.
  • Configure and maintain business processes, condition rules, and approval routing across HCM and Finance.
  • Develop Workday Extend applications and PRISM analytics where appropriate, packaging custom logic in supported platform extensions rather than fragile customizations that complicate future upgrades.
  • Build report-as-a-service integrations and support data export needs for downstream systems.
  • Configure security domains, role-based security, and segment-based security across complex tenants.
  • Partner with HR, payroll, and finance stakeholders to translate requirements into Workday configurations.
  • Develop and maintain documentation for business processes, calculated fields, and security models.

About the Role

We are looking for a proactive, creative and results-driven Marketing Specialist to execute multi-channel B2B marketing campaigns for an established Australian technology business.

This is a hands-on, internal-facing role focused on translating marketing strategy into impactful campaigns across paid advertising, HubSpot, content creation, digital marketing, events and technology partner programs.

Working closely with the Chief Growth Officer and senior leadership, you will take ownership of campaign execution, marketing automation, creative production and performance reporting. You will play a key role in strengthening brand visibility, generating qualified leads and ensuring marketing investment delivers measurable commercial results.

The ideal candidate combines creative thinking with strong analytical skills, commercial awareness and the confidence to recommend campaign improvements while maintaining established brand standards and business objectives.

About the Client

You will be working with an established Australian technology solutions provider dedicated to delivering practical, reliable and business-focused IT outcomes.

The organisation operates within a broader technology group and has a well-defined brand identity, target market and strategic positioning. With a strong commitment to collaboration, professional development and continuous improvement, the business fosters a supportive environment where individuals are encouraged to take ownership, share ideas and deliver exceptional results.

Its culture is built around three core values: Comradeship, Fulfilment and Pursuit of Excellence, creating an environment that balances high performance with teamwork, accountability and professional growth.

Ideal Profile

Essential Experience & Skills

  • Approximately 5 years of hands-on marketing experience in a Marketing Specialist, Marketing Coordinator or similar role.

  • Proven experience managing LinkedIn Ads and HubSpot, including campaign execution, marketing automation, lead nurturing and performance reporting.

  • Strong understanding of paid digital marketing, campaign attribution, return on investment (ROI) and sales pipeline contribution.

Campaign Development & Execution

Paid Media, Content & Creative

Position: Supply Chain SpecialistSalary: up to $4,450 NZD per month – Depending on experience
Working Hours & Conditions: Full-time, remote position working New Zealand business hours
Holidays: TBC – Client Discretion

About the Business

The Business is dedicated to inspiring creators of great design and enabling exceptional interior spaces across Australia and New Zealand.

The company searches globally for leading trends, premium materials, hardware, surfaces and specialist expertise. These products are carefully curated for developers, architects, interior designers and other design professionals delivering high-quality projects.

As Architectural Merchants, it focuses on international quality standards, design excellence and reliable service, providing an exciting environment for professionals passionate about design-led products and supply chains.

Role Overview

We are seeking a capable and detail-oriented Supply Chain Specialist to coordinate the end-to-end supply chain activities supporting the company's curated product portfolio.

The successful candidate will manage inventory levels, coordinate procurement and replenishment, track international and domestic shipments, and ensure products are available to meet customer and project requirements.

This role requires close collaboration with suppliers, logistics providers and internal teams. The Supply Chain Specialist will also maintain accurate ERP records, monitor supply chain performance and identify opportunities to improve cost, efficiency and service delivery.

The key objective is to ensure the company’s products move through the supply chain reliably, accurately and cost-effectively.

Key Responsibilities

Inventory Planning & Replenishment

  • Monitor inventory levels across the company’s product portfolio.
  • Coordinate replenishment activities to maintain appropriate stock availability.
  • Review demand, current stock, committed orders and expected deliveries when planning purchases.
  • Identify potential stock shortages, excess inventory and slow-moving products.
  • Maintain appropriate reorder points, safety-stock levels and replenishment settings.
  • Work with sales, customer service and project teams to understand upcoming demand.
  • Support stocktakes, inventory reconciliations and the investigation of stock discrepancies.
  • Provide clear updates regarding product availability and expected delivery dates.

Procurement & Supplier Coordination

  • Prepare and manage purchase orders in accordance with approved requirements.
  • Liaise with local and international suppliers regarding pricing, availability, production and delivery schedules.
  • Confirm order quantities, specifications, costs and expected dispatch dates.
  • Monitor outstanding purchase orders and proactively follow up delayed or incomplete orders.
  • Maintain accurate supplier, product and purchasing information in the ERP system.
  • Communicate supply risks, pricing changes and delays to relevant internal stakeholders.
  • Develop positive and professional relationships with suppliers.
  • Support supplier-performance reviews and sourcing activities where required.

Logistics & Shipment Management

  • Coordinate and track inbound shipments from suppliers through to delivery.
  • Liaise with freight forwarders, transport providers, warehouses and other logistics partners.
  • Monitor shipping schedules, transit times and expected arrival dates.
  • Maintain accurate shipment records and supporting documentation.
  • Assist with basic import and export documentation and processes.
  • Identify potential delays or disruptions and communicate their likely impact.
  • Follow up damaged, incomplete, delayed or incorrectly supplied orders.
  • Support efficient and cost-effective freight and distribution decisions.

ERP, Data & Record Management

  • Maintain accurate product, supplier, inventory, purchase-order and shipment information in the ERP system.
  • Use NetSuite or Orcale ERP platform to manage and monitor supply chain activity.
  • Ensure records are updated promptly and consistently.
  • Review system data for errors, duplicate records and incomplete information.
  • Maintain accurate supporting documents for purchasing, inventory and logistics transactions.
  • Produce operational reports and data extracts as required.
  • Help improve data quality and consistency across supply chain systems.

Supply Chain Reporting & Analysis

  • Monitor supply chain metrics including inventory availability, order fulfilment, lead times, supplier performance and freight costs.
  • Prepare regular reports for management and relevant internal teams.
  • Analyse inventory and operational data to identify trends, risks and opportunities.
  • Investigate recurring delays, stock discrepancies and process inefficiencies.
  • Provide practical recommendations to improve supply chain performance.
  • Track agreed improvements and report on their outcomes.
  • Support forecasting, purchasing and operational planning with accurate data.

Internal Collaboration & Customer Support

  • Work closely with sales, customer service, finance, warehouse and project teams.
  • Provide accurate information regarding inventory availability, incoming stock and delivery expectations.
  • Support the resolution of supply chain issues affecting customers or projects.
  • Communicate clearly when timelines, availability or costs change.
  • Coordinate priorities where multiple customer or project requirements are competing for available stock.
  • Maintain professional communication with all internal and external stakeholders.

Process Improvement

  • Review existing procurement, inventory and logistics workflows.
  • Identify opportunities to improve accuracy, visibility, efficiency and cost control.
  • Help develop and document supply chain procedures, templates and checklists.
  • Support improvements to ERP processes and system usage.
  • Contribute to projects designed to strengthen inventory planning and supplier performance.
  • Apply a continuous-improvement mindset to day-to-day activities.

Tools & Systems

  • NetSuite / Oracle ERP – strong previous experience necessary
  • Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets
  • Purchasing and inventory-planning tools
  • Freight, logistics and shipment-tracking platforms
  • Microsoft 365 or Google Workspace
  • Reporting and data-analysis tools

Requirements

Key Requirements

  • At least three years of relevant supply chain, procurement, inventory or logistics experience.
  • Strong supply chain and inventory-management capability.
  • Experience coordinating purchasing, replenishment and stock availability.
  • Experience working with suppliers and logistics providers.
  • Practical experience using an ERP or inventory-management system.
  • Strong Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets skills.
  • Ability to interpret operational data and monitor relevant KPIs.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent attention to detail and data accuracy.
  • Strong written and spoken English.
  • Professional communication skills when working with suppliers, logistics partners and internal teams.
  • Ability to manage multiple orders, shipments, priorities and deadlines.
  • Ability to work independently and take ownership of assigned responsibilities.
  • Comfortable working remotely and communicating regularly with the client.
  • Reliable internet connection and a professional home-office environment.
  • Availability to work full-time during New Zealand business hours.

Qualifications

  • A degree or diploma in supply chain management, logistics, operations, business or a related discipline would be advantageous.
  • Equivalent practical experience in a relevant supply chain role may be considered.

Highly Desirable

  • Hands-on experience using NetSuite.
  • Experience managing inventory for a wholesale, distribution, architectural-products or design-led business.
  • Experience working with internationally sourced products and overseas suppliers.
  • Understanding of import and export processes, shipping documentation and international freight.
  • Experience monitoring supplier performance, lead times and stock availability.
  • Exposure to demand planning, forecasting and inventory optimisation.
  • Experience supporting customers or projects with deadline-driven product requirements.
  • An interest in architecture, interior design, premium materials or design-led products.

raw.description:
About Lydian Energy

Lydian is an established energy development company specializing in the development and construction of utility-scale solar and battery energy storage system (BESS) projects in North America.  Lydian owns 14 assets in development, construction or under operation, consisting of both solar and storage, which reached or are expected to reach FNTP from 2024-2028.

Lydian is backed by Excelsior Energy Capital (“EEC”), a leading private equity fund manager with more than $1.5B in assets under management, that is exclusively focused on north American middle market renewables investing.  Lydian’s relationship with EEC provides several critical advantages, including access to (i) a specialized team of value-add investor-operators with decades of renewables development, construction, and transaction experience and (ii) committed discretionary equity capital, strong relationships with debt and tax equity investors, and deep experience structuring tax equity and project financings.

Lydian has built a team of seasoned, passionate energy infrastructure professionals with deep expertise in project development, construction, financing, and M&A. This is an opportunity to join a fully capitalized development platform that is running at full capacity, but still at an early-enough stage for you to have a real impact on company culture and commercial outcomes.

Job Scope

The Manager, Schedule and Cost Control is responsible for the implementation and training of best practices for project planning and scheduling, cost estimating and monitoring, progress measurement, risk management, and reporting at Lydian Energy. This role is responsible for ensuring open communication and information flow from project teams to leadership.

Responsibilities

  • Serve as the lead for schedule and cost control on Lydian’s utility-scale solar and BESS projects in construction, including reviewing EPC contractor baseline schedules, monthly updates and pay applications.
  • Ensure all project deadlines and deliverables are met.
  • Ensure that all project controls processes are compliant with company procedures and best practices. Develop and implement new processes as needed. Conduct regular audits to ensure compliance.
  • Provide timely and accurate project controls reporting and communication to management on the status and key performance indicators of the renewable energy project portfolio throughout all phases of the project lifecycle, including preparation, construction, and completion.
  • Oversee the project's schedule and cost analysis during the construction phase to ensure accurate progress tracking and reporting. Ensure that the project cost distributions are aligned with the actual project progress.
  • Collaborate with the Finance and Accounting team and lead the effort to maintain a cost forecast that aligns current and future payments with all applicable financial arrangements. Ensure that the forecast is accurate and up to date, and that it is communicated to all relevant stakeholders on a regular basis.
  • Coordinate with the Procurement team to ensure that all new purchase requisitions have accurate traceability and cost allocation. Review and approve all purchase requisitions before they are submitted for final approval.
  • Collaborate with the Project Management and Finance teams to ensure the accuracy, completeness, and compliance of all project schedule and cost documentation with applicable Tax Equity, ITC, and PTC requirements.
  • Assist the Project Management team with developing and documenting change requests to scope, budget, or schedule.
  • Collaborate with the Project Management team to ensure that all contractor and owner deliverables related to cost and schedule are submitted on time and in compliance with contractual requirements.
  • Assist the Project Management team in developing cost estimates for technical investment memos. Ensure that the information is comprehensive and accurate, and that it is based on historical actual data.
  • Proactively work with the Project Management and Legal teams during commercial negotiations, contract preparation, and closing. Provide expertise on schedule and cost control to ensure that contracts are aligned with the project's objectives.
  • Identify and assess potential risks associated with milestone schedules and invoicing terms, and propose mitigation strategies.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in engineering, construction management, or equivalent experience.
  • 5 to 7 years of experience as a project scheduler and cost controller in the renewable energy and/or construction industry.

About Relativity

Legal technology is having its moment, and Relativity is at the centre of it.

In Asia, the momentum speaks for itself: RelativityOne adoption jumped 46% year-over-year, a sign that organisations have moved beyond experimentation and are now applying AI in production environments to modernise how legal work gets done at scale.

To meet this moment, we’re expanding our Singapore team and on-the-ground presence. This is an opportunity to be part of an exciting growth story. You’ll have the backing of an established industry leader and the opportunity to help grow our customer base across Asia.

If you’re ready to help write the next chapter of legal AI in Asia, we’d love to hear from you.

Job Description and Requirements

The Legal AI Advisor is a practising or former lawyer who brings deep legal expertise and a passion for technology to help customers understand, adopt, and realise value from Relativity’s AI platform and claiR, our conversational AI experience purpose-built for lawyers.


The Legal AI Advisor will report to the Director, Legal AI Transformation in Asia, with a strong dotted-line relationship to the Senior Director, Legal AI Consulting, based in the United States.


Working across the full customer lifecycle, this role sits at the intersection of legal practice, customer engagement, and product innovation, with a primary focus on driving lawyer adoption of AI at scale.


Your Role in Action

  • Engage lawyers as primary users: Build trusted relationships with lawyers across law firms, corporate legal teams, service providers, and public sector organisations. Understand customer workflows, pain points, and opportunities for transformation, and engage partners, associates, and in-house counsel as a credible peer.
  • Drive pre-sales and adoption conversations: Partner with Pre-Sales Engineers and Account Executives on discovery, positioning, and solution alignment. Lead tailored product demonstrations that connect Relativity’s AI capabilities to real legal use cases and help secure the legal win.
  • Enable post-sales adoption and value realisation: Support onboarding, training, and ongoing engagement to drive sustained usage. Guide customers through workflow transformation and AI integration, partnering with Customer Success Managers to translate adoption into growth and measurable impact.
  • Act as the voice of the legal customer: Provide structured feedback to Product Marketing, Product, and Engineering on customer needs, usability, and adoption barriers. Help refine product capabilities and contribute to playbooks, best practices, and scalable customer-engagement assets.
  • Bridge legal and technical workflows and knowledge: Translate complex AI capabilities into practical insights for legal professionals. Help customers understand how RelativityOne’s claiR and aiR products affect specific practice areas and workflows, and support internal teams in understanding legal user needs and behaviours.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Qualified lawyer currently admitted and in good standing to practise in at least one EMEA or APAC jurisdiction. Candidates must hold an active practising licence, not solely an academic law degree.
  • 3+ years of experience practising law at a law firm and/or in-house legal team; litigation experience is preferred.
  • Strong understanding of legal workflows and the challenges faced by lawyers.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to engage both legal and executive audiences.

  • Hands-on experience with legal AI tools, including Relativity aiR.
  • First-hand knowledge of litigation and regulatory investigations workflows.

  • Experience in client-facing roles such as client advisory, legal technology, or business development.

About the job

We have launched Keet Mobile on iOS and Android, bringing our full P2P technology stack to everyone. Keet Mobile is not your average app: it’s heavy lifting is performed by a custom JS runtime specially designed for peer-to-peer usage (in fact, it reuses 100% of Keet Desktop’s code!). The UI logic, on the other hand, is 100% React Native, giving us flexibility and the ability to iterate quickly.

We believe this pattern opens the door to huge possibilities in the future, and we need your help getting there!

Responsibilities

In this role, you will develop and maintain Keet Mobile, our peer-to-peer chat and calling app for iOS and Android. Keet Mobile is built with React Native and Expo, and its P2P core runs on the device itself in a Bare worklet. You'll own features end to end, from UI/UX implementation to using the P2P core apis.

You will:

- Build and polish features across chat, voice and video calls, media sharing, device pairing and identity backup
- Integrate native platform capabilities such as push notifications, camera, bio-metrics and background tasks on both iOS and Android
- Profile and optimise performance on real devices, including startup time, long chats, media handling, battery and network use
- Write unit and end-to-end tests, and help keep releases stable through CI and crash reporting
- Work closely with the core P2P, design and product teams, and review code with a high bar for quality

Requirements

  • Significant experience with React Native, Redux for state management and Redux-Saga

  • Highly proficient in JavaScript and ES6+.

  • Experienced with WebSockets, RESTful based APIs.

  • Experience working with a remote team

  • Interested in modernizing and optimizing different mobile or web applications.

  • Bonus points if you have any built something amazing on any p2p frameworks .

Important information for candidates

  • Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

  • Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.

  • Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ or @

  • We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

  • Ausarbeitung des Gesamtkonzepts für das Lieferanten- und Qualitätsnetzwerk (Beschaffungsstrategie, Lieferantenqualifizierung, QM-System, IFS-Zertifizierung, Regulatory Governance); in operativer Kooperation mit Lead Buyer & Quality Manager

  • Regelmäßiges Reporting der Team-Performance an Head of Operations sowie Kommunikation relevanter Themen mit proaktiven Lösungsvorschlägen

das bringst du idealerweise mit*

  • Fundierte Kenntnisse in Supply Chain Management (Demand Planning, 3P Manufacturing, Produktionsplanung) und hast Erfahrungen oder Einblicke in Qualitätsmanagement/Regulatory Affairs, idealerweise im FMCG- oder Lebensmittel Umfeld gesammelt

  • Erfahrung in der Steuerung von Lieferanten-Netzwerken

  • Tiefes Prozessverständnis der Value Chain und Fähigkeit sich in bereichsnahe Themen schnell reinzudenken und zu koordinieren

  • Kompetenz in KPI basierter Steuerung und Performance Monitoring

  • Erste Führungserfahrung, idealerweise funktionsübergreifend gepaart mit starkem Analytik-Denken und Kommunikationsbewusstsein

  • Deutsch mindestens auf C1 Niveau in Wort und Schrift, Englisch mindestens B1/B2

das möchten wir dir bieten

  • Corporate Benefits, Fitnesszuschuss, mentale Gesundheits-Plattform (Nilo Health)

bist du überzeugt?

title: Director, Research & Insights, Quantitative

raw.title: Director, Research & Insights, Quantitative
raw.excerpt: Konovo is a global healthcare intelligence company on a mission to transform research through technology - enabling faster, better, connected insights.
raw.description:
Konovo is a global healthcare intelligence company on a mission to transform research through technology - enabling faster, better, connected insights. 

Konovo provides healthcare organizations with access to over 2 million healthcare professionals and patients—the largest network of its kind globally. With a workforce of over 300 employees across 5 countries: India, Bosnia and Herzegovina, the United Kingdom, Mexico, and the United States, we collaborate to support some of the most prominent names in healthcare. Our customers include over 300 global pharmaceutical companies, medical device manufacturers, research agencies, and consultancy firms. 

As we transition from a service-oriented model to a product-driven platform, we are expanding our remote team. We are looking for a Director, Research & Insights, Quantitative to contribute to our mission by leading full-service quantitative primary market research for brand, insights and commercial leads at pharmaceutical companies, from framing the business question and designing the study to delivering the recommendations brand teams act on. Our Life Sciences brand is Konovo's full-service primary market research practice: we partner directly with pharmaceutical brand teams on fully custom ad hoc projects and ongoing programs, not as a sample or fieldwork vendor. Konovo's fulfillment and data/analytics teams run feasibility, data collection, and reporting so you spend your time on design, analysis and insightand room to shape how Konovo does research.

In this role you’ll directly manage one team member and indirectly coordinate and manage internal teams to delivery high-quality results for your clients. If you’re excited to build long-term partnerships with our clients across diverse therapy areas and project types using your expertise and Konovo’s technology-enabled research platform, this job is for you!

How You’ll Make an Impact:

  • Lead quantitative primary market research end-to-end for brand, insights and commercial leads at pharmaceutical companies, turning their business questions into recommendations they act on.
  • Design fit-for-purpose studies among Healthcare Providers (HCPs), patients and payers, including pulse surveys, message and concept testing, Target Product Profile (TPP) and demand assessments, conjoint and awareness, trial and usage (ATU) tracking, from proposals/protocol memos through questionnaires, sample frames and analysis plans.
  • Direct and conduct analysis, from crosstabs and significance testing to conjoint and demand modeling, and synthesize findings into a clear story for director and VP-level clients.
  • Partner with Qualitative Directors to deliver integrated quant and qual programs with a single point of view.
  • Reporting to a Senior Director / Team Lead, manage, coach and develop 1 to 3 analysts and managers, building their skills in study design, analysis and storytelling.
  • Direct Konovo's fulfillment and reporting teams so studies field on time, to specification and in line with pharmaceutical industry standards
  • Grow client partnerships by identifying new research needs within existing accounts, writing proposals and cost estimates, and tracking revenue, margin and forecasts for your portfolio.
  • Raise the bar for research quality by building repeatable processes, templates and AI-enabled approaches to design, analysis and reporting that the wider team adopts.

What We’re Looking For:

  • Proactive research leader with strong strategic, creative and analytical thinking skills.
  • 3-5 years of experience leading full-service quantitative primary market research in healthcare or pharmaceuticals, at a full-service agency or consultancy, or on the client side.
  • A track record of personally authoring research deliverables: questionnaires, analysis plans and final reports with strategic recommendations.
  • Hands-on ownership of study design, analysis and reporting; experience limited to fieldwork, sample or panel management does not meet this requirement.
  • Deep expertise in quantitative methods, including questionnaire design, sampling, weighting and statistical analysis, plus enough familiarity with qualitative research to co-lead integrated projects.
  • Experience presenting findings and recommendations directly to pharmaceutical brand, insights or commercial leadership.
  • Relevant experience managing and developing researchers.
  • Working knowledge of the US pharmaceutical market, including brand planning, launch dynamics, access and HCP decision-making.
  • Excellent storytelling, writing and presentation skills, with the presence to lead senior client conversations.
  • Ability to lead many concurrent studies under tight timelines, adapting well to changing priorities without losing attention to detail.
  • Comfortable leveraging AI-enabled tools to streamline study design, analysis and reporting, and increase speed without compromising data integrity or research quality.
  • Bachelor's degree required, and ability to travel as required for client meetings and team events.
  • Bonus points for: immunology, respiratory, dermatology, oncology or rare disease; balancing ad hoc projects with ongoing or retainer-based client programs; advanced methods such as conjoint, MaxDiff and demand forecasting; and global (ex-US) research.

Why Konovo?

  • Work on cutting-edge AI-powered solutions and industry leading services that transform healthcare insights.
  • Be part of a mission-driven company that is revolutionizing healthcare decision-making.
  • Join a fast-growing global team with career advancement opportunities.
  • Thrive in a collaborative, remotework environment that values innovation and flexibility.
  • Make a real-world impact by helping healthcare organizations innovate faster.

Our job titles and range posted may span more than one career level for a given job title. The actual base pay is dependent upon many factors, such as: training, transferable skills, work experience, business needs and market demands. The base pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. This role will also be eligible for a variable plus employee benefits. The estimated cash compensation range for this US based role is: $95,000-$115,000 USD.

If you’re eager to build a meaningful career in healthcare market research — and you’re smart, nice, and driven to make an impact — we’d love to hear from you!

Apply now to be a part of our journey.
